chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 270: Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir (High Level)
paragraphs: The crystals on the ground are Shadow Crystals.
Calculating at a ratio of one-tenth, that’s at least 500,000 pieces!
It’s truly a massive haul!
On the battlefield at this moment, the Demon Elephant War Chariot is slaughtering fiercely!
Buzz!
Wherever it goes, countless Shadow Fangs are directly blasted!
In Ten Thousand Stars City, the Hellfire Missile Silo is also busy.
Boom boom boom!
Hellfire constantly bombards.
The number of the Shadow Legion is decreasing at a terrifying rate.
This is Han Xing’s current confidence.
As long as they don’t encounter a Legendary Level expert, Ten Thousand Stars City is invincible!
At this moment.
There’s no need for the Witch Race People to take action.
Just the giant Sky Island in the sky is enough to sweep the entire battlefield.
Originally appearing precarious, Warhawk City was relieved of its crisis due to the addition of this powerful force.
Ten minutes later.
Over 16 million Shadow Monsters have already died under the terrifying artillery of the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
The Shadow Lords are anxious.
However, they do not dare to intercept once again.
After all, the previous scene where ten Lords were blasted is still vivid in memory.
These Lords can only watch as the Demon Elephant War Chariot continues its massacre of the Shadow Army.
And at that moment.
Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City appears above Warhawk City.
Its vast territory directly covers Warhawk City.
At this time, those Lords seem to remember something.
They vaguely recall that those Demon Elephant War Chariots flew out from this Sky Island.
In other words, the owner of the Sky Island is the true possessor of the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
As long as they eliminate the personnel on this Sky Island, all problems will be solved!
In the next moment.
A Shadow Creature resembling a werewolf and over thirty meters tall suddenly lets out a long howl!
"Awoo~
Then, at least fifteen Shadow Creatures as large as this werewolf unite together.
And they charge straight towards Ten Thousand Stars City.
This seems like the last wave of assault organized by the Shadow Legion!
Meanwhile, numerous aerial troops in the sky begin a desperate assault on Ten Thousand Stars City.
They even disregard the Warhawk City below.
Fifteen Fourth Transformation Lords plus the raid of a flying monster swarm.
Facing such a scene.
Even the Witch Race Commander Gus can’t guarantee he can withstand it completely.
He also realizes the purpose of this group of Shadow Lords.
At this moment, Gus’s expression changes drastically.
"Quick! Fall back! Fall back!"
"This group of Shadow Lords intends to conduct a decapitation strike,"
On the battlefield, Witch Race officers also perceive the severity of the situation.
They mobilize their firepower at the first opportunity, attacking the flying monsters heading towards Ten Thousand Stars City!
However, Han Xing does not feel a trace of panic.
Because until now, Ten Thousand Stars City has not shown all its strength.
When those monsters enter the attack range.
Han Xing smirks disdainfully.
At this moment, all Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City unleash terrifying energy waves.
Spiritual Shock Tower, Thunderbolt Tower.
Including tens of thousands of Corrosion Towers, Ice Arrow Towers, and so forth.
They all exhibit their power at this moment!
The dazzling blue arcs of electricity, along with tens of thousands of arrow tower attacks!
Led by fifteen Lord-level creatures, plus a million flying monsters making up the Shadow Army.
They are instantly covered by the overwhelming firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City!
Ch-ch... ch-ch...
Poof, poof, poof!
The sound of Thunderbolt Towers eroding flesh, the sound of arrows piercing flesh keep echoing.
One by one, powerful Shadow Monsters are hit in the sky, then fall down.
However, more of them are turned into black powder by the terrifying firepower of the Thunderbolt Tower.
In just a few seconds, this flying army of over a million, plus those fifteen Lords, all vanish in mid-air.
They struggle to gather power for a decapitation strike.
Yet, before even touching the Sky Island, they are completely wiped out.
At this time, the Witch Race soldiers are almost stunned!
What kind of existence is this?
Such powerful means, one wave after another, nearly endless!
How strong are they?
What is the limit of this Sky Island?
No one among these Witch Race soldiers knows!
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, along with others, have joyful expressions on their faces.
Because until now, Han Xing has only demonstrated a portion of Ten Thousand Stars City’s strength.
As the strongest five, they haven’t even made a move.
Including another major force in Ten Thousand Stars City, millions of Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs are also standing by.
Therefore.
Even when faced with this two to three million-scale Shadow Army, Ten Thousand Stars City remains unperturbed.
When the decapitation strike prepared by the group of Shadow Lords fails, they realize that today, they will not be able to take the Witch Race Sky Island.
But nonetheless, they still won’t retreat.
This is the difference between Shadow Monsters and Blood Tide Monsters.
They won’t feel fear, they won’t flee.
Even when facing unilateral slaughter, they will fight to the last moment.
Of course, Han Xing doesn’t indulge them.
He directly starts with relentless bombardment.
Five minutes later.
Only one Shadow Monster remains in place.
Surrounded by dozens of Demon Elephant War Chariots in the sky, no matter how insane, it feels a bit trembling now!
Han Xing’s lips curl into a smile.
"Blast it!"
Upon receiving Han Xing’s order.
One of the Demon Elephant War Chariots raises its trunk.
Then, a terrifying shell instantly falls!
At this moment, faced with the bombardment of the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
The Shadow Monster feels immensely speechless.
I am just a Third Transformation Level ordinary monster, and you use ancient weapons to bombard me?

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 270: Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir (High Level)
paragraphs: Are you human?
Han Xing ignored the resentment of the monster.
When the terrifying dust settled, the battle was declared over.
Han Xing controlled Ten Thousand Stars City to slowly descend.
Ignoring the million-strong Witch Race soldiers in Warhawk City who looked on with shock and a hint of fear.
Han Xing directly ordered the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs to go down and clean the battlefield.
In just half an hour of slaughter, they had taken down over thirty million shadow creatures.
Below, scattered shadow crystals covered the battlefields in all directions.
Intense joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
By calculation, he could harvest at least three million shadow crystals from this wave, enough to exchange for three Bright Moon Treasure Chests!
Just as Han Xing was preparing to go down and help clean the battlefield.
In the distance, a man wearing a Witch Race officer’s uniform, with an excited smile on his face, walked quickly towards Han Xing.
This man was Ausbu.
Upon seeing the battle resolved on Han Xing’s side, Ausbu came immediately.
Looking at Han Xing, he said excitedly, "Warriors of the Human Race, I didn’t expect to see you again so soon!"
"You just saved us in Anmo City, and now you’ve saved the billions of civilians in Warhawk City!"
"Such combat power and vision, truly worthy of my acknowledgment!"
He became more excited the more he spoke.
At this moment, Han Xing received a system prompt.
"Due to your outstanding performance, you have received recognition from Ausbu, the commander of the Witch Race’s 37th Legion. The task affinity interface is now unlocked."
Hearing this system prompt, Han Xing felt somewhat surprised.
Since unlocking Wu Ling’er’s affinity last time, he hadn’t encountered NPCs from this world.
It seems he can unlock the affinity interface by doing things that move them.
Han Xing checked the affinity interface.
[Wu Ling’er’s Affinity]: 80 (Trust)
[Ausbu’s Affinity]: 63 (Friendly)
Only two names were listed above.
Compared to Wu Ling’er’s high affinity of eighty points, treating him as a trustworthy partner.
Ausbu currently only sees Han Xing and others as decent friends.
This affinity interface only reflects the good impression natives have of him, with no substantial rewards.
So Han Xing didn’t pay much attention to it.
However, just as he thought of this, he noticed Ausbu taking out a yellowed piece of paper from his pouch.
Looking at Han Xing, he said excitedly, "Great benefactors, words cannot express my gratitude. Here is a treasured secret elixir recipe, I hope you will accept it!"
At this moment, Han Xing was taken aback.
What the heck?
Is this a reward for unlocking the character’s affinity?
Upon hearing that what Ausbu mentioned was a treasured secret elixir recipe, Han Xing’s breathing became a bit rapid.
Previously, they had heard about it.
The Witch Race excels in crafting secret elixirs, some of which can even affect a legend.
However, Han Xing never knew how to obtain these elixir recipes.
Now, he was provided with a path.
That is, by unlocking character affinity, these Witch Race natives can reward him with recipes.
Of course, this path is just Han Xing’s speculation.
Whether it’s true would need further validation.
At this point, seeing the yellowed paper in Ausbu’s hand, Han Xing didn’t stand on ceremony and directly took it.
A system prompt appeared.
"Acquired Witch Race secret elixir recipe: Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir (High-Level)"
Seeing the name of this elixir, Han Xing squinted his eyes.
Then, he checked the introduction on the blueprint.
[Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir (High-Level)]: After consumption, enhance survivor’s fire element affinity, all fire-related damage increased by 25%, effect lasts for 180 seconds.
Note: High-level elixir, effective only below Level 50, ineffective for those at or above Level 50.
Note 2: Due to elemental chaos in the drug, a survivor can only consume one elixir at the same time.
Han Xing thought for a moment.
The effect of this elixir is quite unique, boosting only single element damage.
Among the five, only Zhang Lianmeng and himself could use it.
Elemental Mage, naturally undoubted, with so many fire-related skills.
The reason Han Xing thought he could also use it was that he also had a fire damage skill: Blast Flame Arrow.
For powerful beings of their level, a 25% increase is significant, enough to elevate their damage to a higher level.
As for those Life Secret Elixir Formulas and Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir Formulas obtained previously.
They became ineffective as everyone’s level increased.
This recipe would provide significant help.
Han Xing was satisfied and clicked to learn it immediately.
Then, he looked at Ausbu in front and said, "Officer Ausbu, thank you very much, this elixir recipe is of great help to me."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s thanks, Ausbu hurriedly replied, flustered, "Benefactor, you’re too kind!"
"A recipe pales in comparison to the help you have given us!"
"It’s my honor to assist you, please don’t hesitate!"
After hearing, Han Xing nodded and smiled.
As he and Ausbu conversed.
A Demon Elephant War Chariot cautiously approached them.
The person on it was the war commander, Gus.
Initially, upon seeing Han Xing and the others, he still harbored fear and dared not approach.
Other soldiers also had a trace of fear and vigilance in their hearts.
They noticed Han Xing and his team were from the Human Race.
But before they could process the information.
They saw Ausbu had already approached and was having a cheerful conversation with these humans.
Gus, unable to contain his curiosity, gathered the courage to approach them.
"Ausbu, who are these people?"
Gus’s voice came from behind, interrupting the chatting Ausbu.
Hearing the familiar voice.
Ausbu quickly turned around, introducing Han Xing and the others’ situation to Gus.
During Ausbu’s narrative, Gus nodded repeatedly, occasionally casting a shocked look at Han Xing.
When he heard Ausbu say these humans also rescued Anmo City.
Admiration had already filled his eyes.
At that moment, Gus strode past Ausbu and saluted Han Xing.
"Thank you, warriors of the Human Race, for your righteous assistance!"
"I, Gus, commander of the Witch Race’s Seventh Legion, offer you the utmost respect!"
Han Xing waved his hand, about to say it was nothing.
Only to see Gus directly addressing the soldiers behind him.
"Warhawk City, all soldiers of the Seventh Legion, heed my command!"
"These humans just saved tens of millions of civilians in Anmo City, and now billions more in our Warhawk City!"
"Their noble character deserves our utmost respect!"
"Everyone, salute!"
Gus stood straight, saluting Han Xing and the others.
The Witch Race soldiers initially hesitated.
However, upon hearing that these individuals had already saved a city and rushed to rescue Warhawk City.
Even the Witch Race soldiers who were initially resistant towards them as members of the Human Race were moved.
Thus, they followed Gus’s lead, giving a standard military salute!
Swish! Swish swish swish!
The movements of millions of Witch Race soldiers were perfectly synchronized.
Including the special forces led by Ausbu.
All offered their utmost respect to Han Xing.
They stared at Han Xing and his team with fervent eyes.
Being watched by so many eyes.
The fervent gaze made Han Xing, despite his seasoned demeanor, feel a bit embarrassed.
Han Xing coughed twice, about to say that the commander need not be so polite.
Just then, he suddenly heard a system prompt.
"Due to your outstanding performance and merit in killing the enemies this time, you have obtained the acknowledgment of all from the Witch Race’s Seventh Legion, Witch Race overall affinity +732."
"Witch Race affinity level has increased, current: 2695 (Respect)"
At this moment, those Witch Race soldiers looked at Han Xing with eyes full of strong admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 271: Frenzied Affinity Farming!
paragraphs: No matter what race or status Han Xing and his companions belong to, everyone admires the strong.
Moreover, these humans rescued so many of them.
They deserve the highest respect from this group of soldiers!
Upon hearing the system prompt.
Han Xing was delighted at heart. This war effort truly is a great place to increase affinity.
Gained over seven hundred points of affinity.
Even comparable to the task of escorting Wu Ling’Er.
Although excited inside, Han Xing maintained a calm demeanor and said, "Commander Gus, you’re too kind."
"We are close friends with your race’s Saintess, and seeing her people in crisis is simply unbearable."
"Dealing with these Shadow Legion is precisely our duty."
Prior to this, Ausbu had already introduced everyone’s identity, so Han Xing knew his name.
After listening, Gus immediately exclaimed excitedly, "You human warriors, noble and righteous, lending a hand when needed!"
"Meeting you is truly a fortune for our Witch Race!"
System prompt appeared.
"Your actions have impressed the Witch Race Commander: Gus, successfully gaining his recognition, character affinity has been unlocked."
Upon hearing this system prompt, Han Xing’s face lit up.
It seems my guess was correct, it’s possible to unlock these natives’ affinity through certain dialogues and actions.
The affinity interface displayed a third name.
[Gus Affinity]: 67 (Friend)
points of affinity, even higher than Ausbu.
However, Han Xing thought about it and found it reasonable.
After all, rescuing Warhawk City is of a completely different level of difficulty compared to Anmo City.
It’s quite normal for Gus to add a few more points of affinity.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at Gus with some anticipation.
Seeing Han Xing’s eager eyes, Gus seemed unsure of what was happening.
So he asked, "Han Xing Warrior, were you injured during the recent battle?
"Your complexion seems a bit unwell?"
Upon hearing this, everyone looked at Han Xing.
Even Ausbu on the side showed a concerned expression in his eyes.
Han Xing was quite speechless upon hearing this.
Do these Witch Race people lack any insight?
Didn’t they see I practically have ’I want benefits’ written all over my face, and they can’t even notice?
However, for the sake of rewards, Han Xing continued to act.
"Indeed, I suffered a little injury, I accidentally got hit by the Shadow Lord’s Mental Attack, and my head still feels a bit woozy..."
After saying this, Han Xing even held his forehead.
He portrayed it so earnestly, as if he had suffered some serious trauma, occasionally glancing at Gus out of the corner of his eye.
However, Zhang Lianmeng and others who had been by Han Xing’s side had somewhat peculiar expressions.
They knew that from the start to the end of the battle, Han Xing didn’t even move a step, let alone got injured.
Seeing Han Xing like this, Gus’s eyes showed a worried expression.
Gus exclaimed, "Han Xing Warrior has indeed sacrificed too much for our Witch Race..."
"You have rescued not only millions of our Warhawk City’s Witch Race warriors but also billions of civilians and countless happy families."
"If it weren’t for Han Xing Warrior..."
Han Xing couldn’t help but show a touch of joy at the corner of his mouth.
Yes, that’s it.
Keep going, I love hearing this!
Han Xing didn’t mind having these officers praise him more.
It’s just, don’t just focus on praising.
Where’s the reward? When will I receive it?
However, the more Gus spoke, the more admiration filled his eyes without the slightest sign of giving out anything.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
"Your behavior has impressed Commander Gus, character affinity has increased."
"Current Affinity: 71 (Close Friend)"
Upon hearing this prompt, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
What does this mean? Affinity increased?
Han Xing suddenly thought of something.
Is it possible that to get Gus’s reward, I need to raise his affinity to a certain level?
The more Han Xing thought, the more he felt his guess made sense.
After all, Ausbu granted him a reward at an affinity level of over sixty.
Because his status was far inferior to Gus’s.
And as a legion commander, Gus’s rewards must be more precious.
Therefore, requiring a higher affinity is normal, right?
Thinking of this, Han Xing became increasingly convinced of his hypothesis.
So, he continued with his act.
At this moment, he was like an old lady exaggerating her woes, feeling discomfort here and pain there, trying to gain Gus’s sympathy.
The crowd’s expressions grew more peculiar.
But this Gus was truly going along with it.
Not only was he continuously showing concern for Han Xing, but system prompts also followed suit.
"Due to your actions, Commander Gus’s affinity has increased..."
"Due to your actions..."
Gus’s affinity was continuously rising.
Soon it broke through the 80 mark!
It officially reached the level of ’Trust’, equal with Wu Ling’Er.
Han Xing subtly let out a breath.
At this point, you should give me a reward, right?
However, as affinity increased, Gus’s gaze towards him grew more unusual.
From the original admiration, it had morphed into mixed feelings with some other emotions.
Whenever Han Xing made eye contact with him, that sympathetic look would give him goosebumps.
But for the sake of rewards, for the secret elixir formula, Han Xing endured it!
However, Gus still showed no sign of taking anything out.
This made Han Xing a bit puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 271: Frenzied Affinity Farming! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Could it be that not all NPCs reward you for unlocking affinity?
He felt that the officer’s gaze was becoming increasingly unsettling.
Han Xing decided to give up on the rewards from him, so he interrupted.
"Commander Gus, I don’t seem to have anything else to do."
"I see many cities on your Sky Island are still in danger."
"If things are fine here, I’ll go support other cities first."
He changed the subject, as if trying to divert Gus’s attention with this.
Upon hearing this, Gus immediately exclaimed, "Han Xing Warrior, even when injured, you care about the safety of other Witch Race members!"
"Such spirit, even I can’t match it."
"Han Xing Warrior, please accept my bow once more!"
System Notification: "Due to your actions, you have impressed Commander Gus, affinity increased, current affinity 82 (close friend)."
At this moment, Han Xing’s mouth twitched again.
What the hell, isn’t this a bit much?
I just said a few words, and you raised the affinity so much?
Are all Witch Race people this easy to fool?
An affinity of 82 has already surpassed Wu Ling’Er!
At this moment, Commander Gus suddenly stepped forward two steps, wanting to get closer to Han Xing.
Watching the Witch Race Commander’s actions, Han Xing instinctively stepped back half a step.
Damn!
You’re talking, why come so close?
Could it be you really want something to happen between us?
Seeing Han Xing’s terrified gaze, Gus seemed to realize he was being a bit too enthusiastic.
So, he sighed in disappointment.
Han Xing couldn’t help but complain internally.
What are you sighing for now?
Beside them, Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, and others had already figured out Han Xing’s intentions.
However, this officer seemed a bit slow, still not understanding his meaning.
They also saw Han Xing’s constipated expression and couldn’t help but laugh.
Gus then said, "Han Xing Warrior, it’s indeed wartime, as you said, there’s still many Witch Race civilians awaiting our rescue."
"I won’t disturb you here any longer."
At this point, Gus took out a yellowed book page from his pocket and handed it to Han Xing, saying.
"This time, Han Xing Warrior saved hundreds of millions of civilians in my Warhawk City, great gratitude is beyond words."
"Here is a unique Witch Race high-level secret elixir recipe, I hope you will accept it."
Han Xing, who was just about to give up, suddenly had his eyes light up.
Whoa!
It’s finally here?
Indeed, perseverance pays off!
Han Xing quickly coughed twice and said, "Commander Gus, you’re too kind,"
"But since you’re so earnest, I will accept it without declining, let’s call it making a friend."
Hearing Han Xing say this, Gus’s expression shifted.
After gifting the secret elixir recipe to Han Xing, a system notification appeared.
"You’ve obtained Witch Race Secret Elixir Recipe: Gale Wings Secret Elixir (High-Level)"
[Gale Wings Secret Elixir (High-Level)]: After consuming, it can increase the Survivor’s agility by 25%, and grants floating ability, the effect lasts for 180 seconds.
Note: High-Level Secret Elixir, it only works on creatures below level 50, invalid for level 50 and above.
Note 2: Due to chaotic elixir elements, Survivors can only consume one type of secret elixir at a time.
Seeing the attributes of the secret elixir recipe, Han Xing’s pupils shrank!
This is indeed the secret elixir recipe he wanted the most to increase agility attributes!
For Han Xing, this elixir offers far more than a 25% increase, with various effects stacking, it could even boost his attack power by over 50%!
If before, Han Xing could only barely injure Legendary Powerhouses with full power bursts.
Then now, he truly has the power to threaten Legendaries.
Not to mention, in just over an hour, his other Divine Artifact Equipment will be completed.
By then, Han Xing’s strength will truly transform!
Han Xing was so thrilled he even wanted to find a Legend and shoot an arrow at them.
Just then, Gus’s words interrupted Han Xing’s thoughts.
"Han Xing Warrior, do you all have our Witch Race dedicated Communication Jade?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, why?"
Gus said, "If it’s convenient, please give your Communication Jade to me."
Without thinking much, Han Xing directly handed the Communication Jade to Gus.
Gus also smiled.
A moment later, he returned the jade to Han Xing and said.
"Thank you Han Xing Warrior, the jade now has my communication number stored."
"In the future, if you encounter any trouble or difficulties within the Witch Race Territory, you can contact me at any time."
"Although, my abilities may be somewhat trivial compared to you."
"But as long as you ask, I will do my best to help you all!"
Feeling the jade in his hand, Han Xing sensed that it indeed had an additional communication number.
Although, as Gus said, his power isn’t significant to Han Xing.
But this promise from Gus doesn’t just represent himself.
As the Commander of the Seventh Legion, Gus has the authority to mobilize millions of Witch Race soldiers.
In other words, Gus also has significant influence within the Witch Race.
Next, Han Xing was planning to establish a transaction channel with the Witch Race.
With Gus’s support, it would undoubtedly be much smoother.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly put away the jade and thanked him solemnly.
"Thank you very much, Commander Gus.
Upon hearing this, Gus immediately cupped his hands and said, "It’s just a small effort, no need to be polite, Han Xing Warrior."
"After all, aren’t we friends?"
He spoke the last few words with a hint of unexplainable meaning in his tone.
Unable to help it, Han Xing shivered and quickly coughed twice.
Gus smiled and shook his head, saying, "Since the Human Race Warrior still has things to do, I also need to make post-war adjustments to Warhawk City, so I won’t disturb you all any longer."
After speaking, Gus tactfully left with Ausbu.
At this moment, Han Xing also quietly wiped the sweat from his forehead.
For the sake of this affinity reward, he really went all out.
Fortunately, the final harvest wasn’t bad.
The Witch Race, truly, lives up to being a race with Secret Medicine Grandmasters.
Their secret elixirs are truly effective.
Han Xing clicked and learned both secret elixir recipes.
After glancing over the required materials, Han Xing felt a surge of joy.
"Great, they’re all just some common materials."
"This means I have two more ways to make money!"
Han Xing’s lips curled up with excitement.
Once most Survivors reach level 30, they’ll realize just how powerful these two secret elixirs are!
No, later on, once I gather more Witch Race secret elixir recipes, I can make a business out of this, setting up my own line of secret elixirs!
And these elixirs won’t be available on trade channels, if you want them, you’ll have to buy them directly from Xingyu City."
This way, I have two more lucrative streams of revenue!"
Feeling a sense of pride, Han Xing’s face lit up with excitement.
As he was contemplating these thoughts.
The Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs had already seen to the cleanup of their first battlefield.
Collectively they brought back 2.74 million Shadow Crystals, and 18 Shadow Divine Stones.
Looking at the resources in his warehouse, the corners of Han Xing’s mouth curled upward.
This was like getting twice the yield of Shadow Divine Stones for exchanging them all.
Even changing them all into Shadow Divine Stones would yield more than two hundred!
No doubt, this was as profitable as it got.
He knew that his actual battling and traveling time was less than an hour anway.
Presently, Han Xing looked towards the mist-covered area in the distance.
He hurried to the next location to take down more Shadow Creatures.
This next hour.
The Ten Thousand Stars army moved rapidly, finally extinguishing the flames in a dozen Witch Race cities around the entire Witch Race Sky Island.
In this battle, they eliminated a total of several million Shadow Crater and 18 Shadow Divine Stones.
Not to mention the overall increased affinity that rose by over two thousand more for the Witch Race.
It has now broken five thousand!

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 272: Binding the Divine Artifact, the Aura of the Human King
paragraphs: The overall affinity of the Witch Race is close to surpassing 5000.
However, a new level of affinity has yet to be unlocked.
Han Xing also knows that unlocking the next stage isn’t so easy.
After all, the current affinity level with the Witch Race has reached the respect level.
Going further, wouldn’t it be worship?
At that time, even if Han Xing does not hold any position among the Witch Race,
His status would probably rival that of Zefer or Ausbu as heads of the special forces team.
This time’s gains are quite significant.
Moreover, there’s more than one piece of good news.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly received a system notification.
"Your equipment: [Oracle Throne (Red)] has been successfully forged."
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"Finally, it’s completed!"
He came to the street outside the Lord’s Mansion.
The next moment.
A towering red pillar of light suddenly descended in Ten Thousand Stars City!
This pillar of light was similar to the previous commotion when a divine artifact was revealed, only even more imposing.
The red light pillar stretched to the horizon, as if connecting to another world.
Everyone was drawn to the commotion near the Lord’s Mansion.
They all gathered at the center of Ten Thousand Stars City.
At this moment.
Five people stood at the edge of the light pillar, raising their heads in unison, watching the spectacle in the sky.
They vaguely saw something about to descend within the light pillar!
Before it even landed, a sense of unparalleled sanctity and solemnity was felt.
The gem-like radiance shimmered brilliantly.
When that object fully descended and presented itself completely before everyone,
The red light pillar vanished instantly.
Everyone could see the shape of that object clearly.
Suspended about two meters above the ground,
Was a huge throne approximately three meters tall and two meters wide.
The throne was towering and majestic, with gems inlaid at the top, and intricate patterns etched in every corner.
Its entirety emitted a splendid sheen.
Gazing upon the exaggeratedly styled giant throne, a strong sense of awe appeared in everyone’s eyes.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Brother Xing, is this the divine artifact item?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes it is!"
The throne emitted waves of divine power, within which Han Xing felt an attraction.
He couldn’t wait to sit on it.
At the moment Han Xing sat on the throne,
It was like a coronation ceremony.
The gigantic throne suddenly emitted a dazzling radiance, illuminating the entire sky of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Around everyone, whispers of angels and the salute of millions echoed faintly in their ears.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
"Bind special equipment: Oracle Throne (Red)?"
"Yes!"
"Binding successful, your attributes have been enhanced."
"In flight, the throne’s movement speed increases by 1000%, Survivor’s defense increases by 100%, and attack power increases by 100%."
Han Xing’s heart surged with excitement!
This is exactly the effect he wanted.
A 100% increase in defense and attack power!
Allowing his strength to transform again!
At this moment.
All the holy light surged into Han Xing’s body.
Everyone felt a powerful and dignified aura burst from Han Xing’s body!
Han Xing lifted his eyes.
Two beams of tangible light burst forth from his pupils!
Facing Han Xing’s gaze, everyone felt as if they were truly facing a king.
The King of the Human Race!
If any ordinary survivor saw Han Xing at this moment, they might not be able to resist kneeling.
Han Xing seemed to notice everyone’s somewhat rigid expressions.
Thus, he quickly retracted this aura.
The pressure on everyone’s hearts eased slightly.
Cheng Jianyong patted his chest at this moment, letting out a breath and saying, "Wow, finally back to normal."
"I was scared to death just now; I thought Brother Xing was truly becoming the Human Emperor."
"I, Old Cheng, almost kneeled!"
Shen Yun exhaled, nodding in deep agreement, "The commotion from binding this divine artifact was too much."
"Brother Xing, how do you feel now?"
Han Xing sat upright on the throne, smiling lightly.
"Feels, quite excellent... "
"As long as I sit on it, I can feel a powerful force continuously emerging from within."
"Now, at full power, I should be able to spar with a true legend level."
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
No wonder they felt that level of pressure from Han Xing.
Now it seems, he is truly reaching legendary level power!
While feeling shocked, they were also joyful for Han Xing.
On the side, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s gazes at Han Xing showed strong admiration.
They never minded Han Xing reaching higher heights.
Because they knew, no matter how high he rose, he would never forget everyone.
And what they needed to do was to strive to keep up with Han Xing’s pace, not to hold him back!
Next, Han Xing continued to familiarize himself with the control of the Oracle Throne.
He discovered that ever since binding with the Oracle Throne, he could almost levitate off the ground at will.
This thing was like a core territory he could command as easily as his own limbs.
As long as he stood on it, Han Xing could go wherever he wanted, as freely as with his legs.
Furthermore, the moving speed of the Oracle Throne had reached a truly terrifying level.
After all, a tenfold movement speed boost is no joke.
Even more frightening than when Han Xing activates the Breath of the Wild effect and Instant Shadow Flash skills.
Moreover, with a 100% increase in both defense and attack power, it’s a comprehensive enhancement.
Now, even saying Han Xing is a legendary powerhouse, probably no one would deny it.

The gigantic throne suddenly emitted a dazzling radiance, illuminating the entire sky of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Around everyone, whispers of angels and the salute of millions echoed faintly in their ears.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
"Bind special equipment: Oracle Throne (Red)?"
"Yes!"
"Binding successful, your attributes have been enhanced."
"In flight, the throne’s movement speed increases by 1000%, Survivor’s defense increases by 100%, and attack power increases by 100%."
Han Xing’s heart surged with excitement!
This is exactly the effect he wanted.
A 100% increase in defense and attack power!
Allowing his strength to transform again!
At this moment.
All the holy light surged into Han Xing’s body.
Everyone felt a powerful and dignified aura burst from Han Xing’s body!
Han Xing lifted his eyes.
Two beams of tangible light burst forth from his pupils!
Facing Han Xing’s gaze, everyone felt as if they were truly facing a king.
The King of the Human Race!
If any ordinary survivor saw Han Xing at this moment, they might not be able to resist kneeling.
Han Xing seemed to notice everyone’s somewhat rigid expressions.
Thus, he quickly retracted this aura.
The pressure on everyone’s hearts eased slightly.
Cheng Jianyong patted his chest at this moment, letting out a breath and saying, "Wow, finally back to normal."
"I was scared to death just now; I thought Brother Xing was truly becoming the Human Emperor."
"I, Old Cheng, almost kneeled!"
Shen Yun exhaled, nodding in deep agreement, "The commotion from binding this divine artifact was too much."
"Brother Xing, how do you feel now?"
Han Xing sat upright on the throne, smiling lightly.
"Feels, quite excellent...
"As long as I sit on it, I can feel a powerful force continuously emerging from within."
"Now, at full power, I should be able to spar with a true legend level."
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
No wonder they felt that level of pressure from Han Xing.
Now it seems, he is truly reaching legendary level power!
While feeling shocked, they were also joyful for Han Xing.
On the side, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s gazes at Han Xing showed strong admiration.
They never minded Han Xing reaching higher heights.
Because they knew, no matter how high he rose, he would never forget everyone.
And what they needed to do was to strive to keep up with Han Xing’s pace, not to hold him back!
Next, Han Xing continued to familiarize himself with the control of the Oracle Throne.
He discovered that ever since binding with the Oracle Throne, he could almost levitate off the ground at will.
This thing was like a core territory he could command as easily as his own limbs.
As long as he stood on it, Han Xing could go wherever he wanted, as freely as with his legs.
Furthermore, the moving speed of the Oracle Throne had reached a truly terrifying level.
After all, a tenfold movement speed boost is no joke.
Even more frightening than when Han Xing activates the Breath of the Wild effect and Instant Shadow Flash skills.
Moreover, with a 100% increase in both defense and attack power, it’s a comprehensive enhancement.
Now, even saying Han Xing is a legendary powerhouse, probably no one would deny it.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 272: Binding the Divine Artifact, the Aura of the Human King (Part 2)
paragraphs: However, this item has a limitation, which is if it is put into the backpack, or if someone knocks it off the throne, the amplification effect will disappear.
To avoid this situation, assistance from teammates is required.
After testing the attributes of the Oracle Throne, Han Xing was very satisfied.
Just as he was about to lead the group to find a Sky Island monster to test his strength.
They suddenly saw that on the Witch Race Sky Island where Gus and others were located,
Over a hundred Witch Race battleships, plus thousands of transport ships, flew out of the Sky Island and then gathered together.
These ships had gathered nearly eighty percent of the manpower on this island.
Even nine Demon Elephant War Chariots were mobilized.
Led by the Demon Elephant War Chariots, the fleet behind set off closely following.
Watching their mighty appearance, everyone looked on with some curiosity.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what are they getting ready to do?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not quite sure."
"But, we can just ask."
After saying that, Han Xing directly took out a piece of jade from the backpack and found Gus’s communication number.
As the Commander of the Seventh Legion, he is already considered the most influential person on this island.
The movements of these troops are likely related to him.
So, Han Xing decided to ask him directly.
At this moment, Commander Gus, who was inside a Demon Elephant War Chariot, quickly replied after receiving Han Xing’s message.
"Hanxing Warrior, the orders for their move were issued by me."
"We are mobilizing the troops, preparing to support the Witch Race Main City."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing frowned and asked, "The Witch Race Main City? Is it the main city where Wu Ling’Er is located?"
Gus replied, "Yes."
"The Saintess just sent us a message, saying that a massive Shadow Legion has appeared in the Witch Race Main City, including some terrifying entities."
"The Saintess is currently fighting alone against two Shadow Legion Legendary Powerhouses, and the situation is barely manageable."
"She has requested our remaining available forces to support the main city now."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s face suddenly turned grim, "Wu Ling’Er is handling two Legendary Powerhouses simultaneously? Can she manage that?"
Upon hearing this, Gus laughed, "Hanxing Warrior might be mistaken."
"The number of Legendary Level powerhouses in the Shadow Legion is numerous, seemingly created by some special method."
"But compared to other races, the Legendary Level powerhouses of the Shadow Legion are much weaker."
"And as you all might know, the Saintess is incredibly powerful, even amongst the Legendary ones, she stands out."
Han Xing and the others nodded.
He indeed knew this.
Wu Ling’Er’s strength is really formidable, as seen when she single-handedly trounced Feienna before.
At this moment, Gus coldly sneered, "These idiots, they really picked the wrong opponent this time!"
"With the Saintess’s power, dealing with two Shadow Legends is a piece of cake."
"Once the Saintess finishes off the enemies and has her hands free, these Shadow Fangs will be no match at all!"
At this point, Gus turned his tone.
"However, before the Saintess finishes the battle there, we need to help the Witch Race soldiers in the main city withstand the Shadow Legion’s invasion."
"As long as we hold on, the victory of this war will undoubtedly belong to us!"
Listening to Gus’s confident tone, Han Xing frowned slightly.
Wu Ling’Er is indeed very strong.
However, the Shadow Legion has fought against the Witch Race for so many years, they must have some understanding of Wu Ling’Er’s strength.
Knowing they would be outmatched, would they really send two Legends to their death? Is that possible?
Han Xing vaguely felt that things might not be that simple.
Thus, he directly said, "I’ll go with you guys."
Hearing that Han Xing wanted to join them, Gus’s eyes suddenly showed disbelief.
He tentatively asked, "Hanxing Warrior, do you mean you want to accompany us to the Witch Race Main City and join the battle?"
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes, your Saintess is also our friend."
"Helping a friend is a given!"
At this moment, Gus’s face once again showed deep admiration.
"Hanxing Warrior, I knew I wasn’t wrong about you!"
"You are indeed the hope of our Witch Race!"
Saying this, Gus appeared somewhat regretful.
"It’s a shame that Hanxing Warrior is not one of our Witch Race people."
"If you were one of us, I would immediately lead the Seventh Legion to pledge full loyalty to you today!"
Saying this, Gus’s tone was filled with regret.
"With Hanxing Warrior’s capabilities, you would undoubtedly become a pivotal figure in the Witch Race, perhaps even the eighteenth priest."
"It’s a pity..."
After a moment of regret,
Ten Thousand Stars City set off together with the Witch Race fleet towards the Sky Island where Wu Ling’Er was located.
Just as everyone anticipated.
Now the entire Witch Race Territory is erupting in wars everywhere.
Here, over tens of thousands of kilometers away from the Witch Race Main City.
No one can guarantee that they won’t encounter other Shadow Legion enemies next.
On the way, they indeed encountered two or three waves of quite large Shadow Legions.
Before the Witch Race fleet had a chance to take action,
Han Xing’s side already solved everything with one Hellfire bombing, plus a round of harvesting by the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
Commander Gus opened his mouth.
He knew that if it weren’t for Han Xing leading the way in front,
Their advancement speed would have significantly slowed down, and they might even have been held back by these Shadow Legions.
An hour later.
They gradually saw the Witch Race’s main city Sky Island.
More than a month ago, Han Xing and the others had visited once.
At that time, this gigantic Sky Island, comparable to the area of a country, left everyone deeply shocked.
On the Sky Island, those prosperous cities also made Han Xing marvel at its advanced civilization.
But now, the Sky Island has been completely shrouded in patches of Shadow Mist.
The cities, mountains, and rivers have all disappeared.
Seeing this scene,
Commander Gus in the rear fleet had his pupils contract.
He exclaimed, "The Shadow Legion’s move this time is too grand!"
"Even the massive main city has been fully covered by Shadow Mist.
"With such a terrifying scale, the number of Shadow Monsters born every moment inside has reached a truly frightening level!"
Commander Gus could hardly imagine.
Previously, from Wu Ling’Er’s tone, there didn’t seem to be any sign of urgency.
But now, upon closer inspection, he realized the Witch Race Main City was indeed bearing almost unimaginable pressure.
However, Han Xing frowned and said, "Where did Wu Ling’Er go?"
He could sense that the Witch Race soldiers were fighting all around.
However, he couldn’t feel the aura of any Legendary powerhouses fighting inside.
Gus had said that Wu Ling’Er was fighting two Shadow Legends.
Could it be that their battlefield is not on the main city Sky Island?
After pondering for a moment,
Han Xing suddenly heard from Gus behind him.
"Hanxing Warrior, the scale of the Shadow Legion’s invasion has somewhat exceeded our imagination."
"There’s no time to lose, I must enter the Shadow Mist now to support our companions,"
"I suggest you continue to act with us."
"If we encounter danger next, we can look out for each other."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing declined, "No need, Commander Gus, we have our own way of operating."
Commander Gus was taken aback upon hearing this.
However, when he recalled the formidable combat power of Ten Thousand Stars, he understood.
With the strength of Han Xing’s group, they were indeed stronger than them.
Given Han Xing’s group strength, they were indeed superior.
Dozens of thousands of Witch Race soldiers had witnessed how easily this group of five had taken down a Fourth-turn Lord.
For a moment, as he felt admiration, Gus’s understanding of Han Xing’s strength went up another notch.
Gus sighed for a moment.
Ten Thousand Stars City then set off together with the Witch Race fleet towards the Sky Island where Wu Ling’Er was located.
As everyone expected.
Now, war is breaking out all over the Witch Race Territory.
They were tens of thousands of kilometers from the Witch Race Main City.
No one can guarantee that they will not encounter other Shadow Legion enemies next.
Indeed, they encountered two or three waves of fairly large Shadow Legions along the way.
Even before the Witch Race fleet took any action,
Han Xing had already resolved everything with a wave of Hellfire bombing, along with a sweep by the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
Commander Gus opened his mouth.
He knew that if Han Xing acted alone, with his terrifying power,
He could indeed become a crucial figure in the Witch Race, even potentially become the eighteenth Priest.
But alas...
After a moment of reflection,
Ten Thousand Stars City then set off along with the Witch Race fleet for the Sky Island where Wu Ling’Er was located.
As everyone anticipated.
Now the entire Witch Race Territory is erupting into war.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 273: The Invincible Ten Thousand Stars City
paragraphs: It’s like breaking through the atmosphere of a planet.
After passing through layers of mist, the scene of the Sky Island appeared before everyone.
Below, it seemed to be a mountain range.
However, the plants on this mountain range had already disappeared.
Now, it was covered by Shadow Monsters.
As expected by everyone.
The scale of the Shadow Mist, the Shadow Monsters spawned within, had already reached a number beyond their imagination.
Within the mist, there was a swarm of flying creatures swiftly sweeping across.
Their numbers were no less than ten million.
Adding to that, the number of Shadow Monsters in the mountain range below was at least sixty million.
And this was just a corner of the Witch Race Sky Island.
There were no signs of Witch Race People active on it.
If it were city areas, the number of Shadow Monsters would only be more.
With a little speculation, it was clear that the number of Shadow Monsters on Wu Ling’Er’s Sky Island had reached an astronomical figure.
However, in Han Xing’s eyes, these were not Shadow Monsters, but each one a Shadow Crystal.
Han Xing’s eyes sparkled as he calculated secretly in his mind.
"Just this one mountain range has at least tens of millions of Shadow Monsters."
"Calculating on this scale, the total number of Shadow Monsters on the entire Witch Race Sky Island must exceed several billion! Even ten billion!"
"If I could wipe them all out, at least I would collect over a billion Shadow Crystals.
The more Han Xing calculated, the more excited he became.
Because, as long as he killed all the Shadow Monsters on this main island, it would be equivalent to finishing nearly one-fifth of the progress for that High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint!
That astronomical number of a hundred billion Shadow Crystals now seemed not so unreachable!
Of course, not all Shadow Monsters would be there for him to kill.
After all, the Defense Towers on this main city and those Witch Race Soldiers were not to be underestimated.
In terms of Defense Towers alone, the Witch Race Main City was much stronger than Xingyu City.
So, Han Xing could kill a portion of the monsters, harvesting quite nicely.
Han Xing clenched his fist.
He looked at the Shadow Monsters in the mountain range below.
The next moment, he directly clicked launch!
Boom! Rumble!
Terrifying flames soared, reaching tens of thousands of meters into the sky!
After a series of earth-shattering commotions.
Everyone also saw the scene below.
Originally, that vast mountain range covered with vegetation disappeared, turning into a giant pit.
Along with it, nearly ten million Shadow Monsters vanished!
On the spot, a large pile of Shadow Crystals was left.
Han Xing maneuvered Xingyu City to descend slowly, then immediately dispatched the Wolf Cavalry to sweep the battlefield.
A total of 540,000 Shadow Crystals were brought back.
The harvest was quite decent.
Having tasted the sweetness, Han Xing maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City to leave and started bombing all the way.
Without the restraint of Legendary Powerhouses.
Now, Ten Thousand Stars City was invincible!
No matter how gigantic the battlefield, Han Xing feared nothing.
Upon spotting monsters, Han Xing directly activated the Hellfire Missile Silo to aim and then pinpoint bombardment.
Boom!
Following a burst of terrifying fire.
Countless Shadow Monsters perished!
Along with them, various terrains on this Sky Island vanished.
Such as mountains, rivers, forests, plains.
After each bombing, a massive number of Shadow Crystals appeared on the ground.
And a series of pits thousands of meters long.
Looking at the scene below, Han Xing involuntarily thought.
Using Ancient Weapons and the Hellfire Missile Silo to clear Shadow Monsters, the efficiency was high.
But at the same time, the damage to this Sky Island was also severe.
If Han Xing continued bombing, many Shadow Monsters would be killed, but Wu Ling’Er’s Sky Island would also suffer vast destruction.
However, Wu Ling’Er probably wouldn’t blame him, right?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing quickly tossed this concern aside.
Ten Thousand Stars City continued forward.
Moving from the wilderness straight to the Witch Race’s populated cities.
The next moment, Han Xing saw a small town appeared on the plains ahead.
The military force on it didn’t seem strong, only ten to twenty thousand Witch Race Soldiers defending.
Faced with them, however, were hundreds of thousands of Shadow Monsters.
The terrifying pressure penetrated to the bone.
The threat of death forced this group of Witch Race Soldiers to squeeze out all the potential from their bodies, to contend with an enemy dozens of times their count!
In the town, a Squad Leader wielded a Wide-Blade Axe, chopped down over a dozen Shadow Monsters with one swing, and shouted loudly: "Fellow soldiers, please hold on a little longer!"
"I have reported to Kathy, the Commander, requesting the mobilization of the ’True Spirit Tower’ for remote fire support."
"Believe in the firepower of the main city’s Defense Towers, these hundreds of thousands of Shadow Fangs are not to be feared!"
Upon hearing this, the other soldiers gritted their teeth and said: "Understood!"
They began a more valiant resistance!
While that group of Witch Race Soldiers were doing their utmost to hold out.
Han Xing on his side had already chosen a position and immediately began bombing!
Rumble!
Two hundred Hellfire Missile Silos fired simultaneously!
The ghastly green flames engulfed the entire battlefield.
After the terrifying explosion, it took away the lives of hundreds of thousands of Shadow Monsters!
Since Han Xing hadn’t given prior notice.
This time, not only were those Shadow Monsters stunned by the bombing, but the other Witch Race Soldiers were also dumbfounded.
They all looked up, then saw that vast expanse of Sky Island.
"Whose Sky Island is it...?"
In the bewildered eyes of that group of Witch Race Soldiers.
Han Xing quickly dispatched the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur to clean up the battlefield.
At the same time, that group of Witch Race Soldiers also saw the humans standing on the Sky Island, issuing commands.

"Believe in the firepower of the main city’s Defense Towers, these hundreds of thousands of Shadow Fangs are not to be feared!"
Upon hearing this, the other soldiers gritted their teeth and said: "Understood!"
They began a more valiant resistance!
While that group of Witch Race Soldiers were doing their utmost to hold out.
Han Xing on his side had already chosen a position and immediately began bombing!
Rumble!
Two hundred Hellfire Missile Silos fired simultaneously!
The ghastly green flames engulfed the entire battlefield.
After the terrifying explosion, it took away the lives of hundreds of thousands of Shadow Monsters!
Since Han Xing hadn’t given prior notice.
This time, not only were those Shadow Monsters stunned by the bombing, but the other Witch Race Soldiers were also dumbfounded.
They all looked up, then saw that vast expanse of Sky Island.
"Whose Sky Island is it...?"
In the bewildered eyes of that group of Witch Race Soldiers.
Han Xing quickly dispatched the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur to clean up the battlefield.
At the same time, that group of Witch Race Soldiers also saw the humans standing on the Sky Island, issuing commands.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 273: The Invincible Ten Thousand Stars City (Part 2)
paragraphs: They remained vigilant but did not act rashly.
Although these Witch Race soldiers did not recognize the humans.
They couldn’t help but feel a sense of respect toward these humans.
As if these humans were extremely significant figures within the Witch Race.
This was naturally due to Han Xing’s influence with a friendly index of 4900 points.
Even these Witch Race soldiers, who had not seen him before, involuntarily felt respect for Han Xing.
And this was also why Han Xing dared to use Hellfire without restraint.
Moreover, these Witch Race soldiers weren’t blind.
They could naturally see that these humans were here to help them.
For a moment, many Witch Race soldiers and civilians in the city looked at Han Xing and his companions with gratitude.
A system notification appeared.
"Due to your outstanding performance, you have gained the recognition of the soldiers of the Witch Race’s Thirty-second Legion, Witch Race Affinity +53..."
Only gaining 53 affinity points was within Han Xing’s expectations.
This time, they simply rescued a small city in the wilderness.
The population inside was not large, at most tens of thousands.
However, Han Xing discovered a mechanism.
The more Witch Race civilians rescued through battle, the higher the affinity gained.
According to Wu Ling’Er, there are billions of Witch Race people living on this Sky Island year-round.
If Han Xing wipes out all the shadow monsters here, how much affinity would he gain?
After roughly calculating, he could at least break through the ten thousand mark.
Han Xing pondered, "Once surpassing ten thousand, it’s estimated the affinity will reach a new level."
"Calculating like this, as long as the Shadow Legion continues to battle the Witch Race, I’ll have the opportunity to keep rapidly increasing my Witch Race affinity."
"Possibly up to fifty thousand, or even a hundred thousand!"
The more he thought about it, the more feasible it seemed to Han Xing.
He exclaimed in surprise, "Well... in that case, wouldn’t the Witch Race’s affinity for me surpass Wu Ling’Er?"
"What would they call me then, Saint Lord?"
Han Xing chuckled to himself with some pride in his heart.
Then, Ten Thousand Stars City began indiscriminately bombing along the way.
Eliminating shadow monsters and harvesting shadow crystals.
Then boosting the overall Witch Race affinity.
The cycle continued like this.
In just an hour.
Ten Thousand Stars City fought its way over ten thousand kilometers, encountering no fewer than a hundred battles of various sizes!
More than a billion shadow monsters were killed!
While also rescuing many Witch Race soldiers.
Han Xing discovered.
The main island of the Witch Race indeed has a much stronger defense capability compared to other Sky Islands.
It can even be said, it’s not even on the same level.
Just before, they saw those high-level defense towers in the central main city.
Such as ’True Spirit Tower,’ ’Tower of Witch Soul,’ etc.
All of which have a range of several thousand kilometers, even up to ten thousand kilometers.
In other words.
These defense towers can cover the entire Witch Race Sky Island.
With someone conducting overall command, it’s possible to provide remote firepower support to cities in relatively urgent situations.
Hence, there won’t be a scenario where troops are insufficient and the situation is about to collapse.
As it stands, the whole main island is ablaze with war, although a bit difficult, it can barely sustain.
The premise is.
The Shadow Legion doesn’t have any other backup plans.
During this time, many Witch Race soldiers heard a rumor.
There is a mysterious and powerful Sky Island constantly moving across the entire Witch Race main island.
Bombarding countless shadow monsters and rescuing tens of millions of Witch Race civilians along the way.
Such grand actions of Ten Thousand Stars City naturally attracted the attention of many on this Sky Island.
Including Wu Ling’Er’s personal guard.
They are using all means to frantically investigate the information about this Sky Island.
At this time.
In Wu Ling’Er’s Royal Palace.
A Witch Race woman, dressed in a black robe with a cold aura, had a serious expression.
"Did you find out? The background and identity of that Sky Island, and their objectives."
Beside her, a Witch Race woman holding a projection screen replied, "Commander Kathy, I am very sorry, we haven’t found the background of this Sky Island."
"But what can be confirmed is, this Sky Island wasn’t sent by the Elves or Giants."
"Recently, the Witch Race border hasn’t had any information regarding the entry of these major races."
"It’s as if, that terrifyingly powerful Sky Island was birthed out of thin air."
Up to this point, Han Xing had only used the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City.
He and Cheng Jianyong and others hadn’t intervened personally.
In other words, most Witch Race soldiers hadn’t even seen the appearances of Han Xing and others.
The cold-breathed female commander furrowed her brows.
Kathy pondered softly, "Not those major races... Strong firepower."
"Currently, this Sky Island is friendly, albeit having caused some damage to our main island, they’ve also annihilated many shadow fangs, relieving much pressure."
"It’s better to let them continue their movements."
At the same time, the Witch Race woman next to her said, "Commander Kathy, just now, Commander Gus sent over a message saying the people on the Sky Island are here to aid us."
"Moreover, he also said it’s several humans controlling that Sky Island."
Kathy’s eyes instantly showed a shocked expression.
"Humans!?" Her tone marked her immense surprise.
The Witch Race woman nodded, "Yes.
"Also, Commander Gus said you know these people..."
The Witch Race woman continued talking about Han Xing and others’ identities.
Moments later, Commander Kathy took a deep breath, appearing to digest the information.
She nodded and said, "Understood, announce this."
"Tell all Witch Race soldiers that when they see this Sky Island, do not attack."
"They are our Witch Race allies."
Across, the Witch Race woman nodded and swiftly communicated Commander Kathy’s orders.
In just a few minutes.
Han Xing’s name was spread among hundreds of millions of Witch Race soldiers and billions of Witch Race civilians in the main city.
Even though it’s wartime now, many Witch Race soldiers discussed Han Xing’s name.
"Have you heard? Several humans are controlling a terrifyingly powerful Sky Island, strafing the Shadow Legion, and have killed several billion monsters!"
"I heard it too. The firepower on their Sky Island is terrifying. Someone even saw dozens of ancient weapons on it!"
"My God... dozens of ancient weapons?"
"If there’s a round of bombardment, wouldn’t it wipe out one of our cities?"
"Yeah, fortunately, these humans are here to help us..."
Other Witch Race soldiers also nodded in agreement, saying.
"Thank these humans for their help!"
Some Witch Race soldiers appeared puzzled.
"Humans? One of them named Han Xing?"
"Could they be the group the Saintess brought back over a month ago?"
Everyone thought of this matter.
After all, over a month ago, Han Xing stirred up quite the commotion in the Witch Race main city, and many Witch Race soldiers and civilians heard about it.
A Witch Race officer said, "It should undoubtedly be these humans."
"But I remember at that time they were only a few people entering the city, not controlling any other Sky Island."
"How long has it been? They’ve developed such a terrifying Sky Island?"
The others listened, eyes filled with disbelief.
They found it hard to imagine.
How these humans managed to develop a Sky Island with such powerful firepower in just one or two months?
Han Xing was not aware of their discussions, as Ten Thousand Stars City continued to advance.
This time, his target is the central main city.
Where they previously had a great battle with Malik.
There, the largest number of civilians are found.
Likewise, a vast number of shadow monsters are assaulting this city.
Han Xing eagerly wants to acquire more shadow crystals.
Where the monsters are densest, can naturally accelerate his collection rate.
Ten Thousand Stars City started flying towards the Witch Race main city...

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 274: The Arrival of the Shadow Demon Venerable!
paragraphs: The Ten Thousand Stars City is advancing rapidly towards the Witch Race Main City.
And above the main city, in a region nearly a million meters high.
Three formidable auras are engaged in a fierce battle!
Among them.
There’s an energy domain purely constructed from blue secret patterns, forming a sea of secret patterns, covering the sky.
On the other side of the view.
There are two dark domains formed by black crystals, occupying the other side of the sky.
This is the battlefield of Wu Ling’Er and those two Shadow Legends.
At this moment, the sea of blue secret patterns radiates terrifying might and is constantly expanding.
Almost compressing the two shadow crystal domains to a size less than a basketball court.
Wu Ling’Er’s strength is no joke, at this moment of full burst, these two Shadow Legends are no match for Wu Ling’Er.
Nearly beaten into a retreat!
From the endless sea of secret patterns comes a soft chuckle from Wu Ling’Er.
"Two creatures neither human nor ghost, even after absorbing the Shadow God’s power, are barely at the legendary level."
"Did the Shadow Monarch send you here to die?"
The opposite Shadow Legends, hearing Wu Ling’Er mock their monarch, suddenly have their auras surge!
"Insulting the monarch, a death sentence!"
They suddenly lunged at Wu Ling’Er.
Wu Ling’Er saw this, and instead of feeling a sense of crisis, she sneered.
The next moment!
The sea of secret patterns again exploded with dazzling blue light.
Buzz!
After this wave of energy collision, the two dark domains collapsed!
In the endless high sky appeared two figures of differing sizes.
Among these two figures, one is an eerie monster towering a hundred meters, with three lion heads.
Its body surface is covered with crystalline scales, blocking most of the damage.
Otherwise, just that collision just now was enough to seriously injure it.
The other is less than two meters tall, clad in black crystal armor.
It appears to be a humanoid creature.
Although their appearances differ, they share a common feature: a ghastly green pupil!
At this moment, they fiercely fixate their gaze on the figure ahead.
In the high sky.
Wu Ling’Er stands suspended in the air.
Nearly two meters of long green hair dances like spirit snakes, combined with her icy pupils, giving a markedly different sense of killing intent!
At this time.
The humanoid monster opposite Wu Ling’Er suddenly spoke: "Wu... Ling’Er..."
"The present-day Witch Race Saintess... gifted, incredibly strong..."
This humanoid creature spoke haltingly, its voice shockingly unpleasant and piercing, like fingernails on glass.
"The monarch said, you have, the potential to break through to a demigod,"
"Must... be eliminated quickly..."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er sneered, "Just the likes of you?"
This humanoid creature remained silent, exchanging a glance with the adjacent three-headed lion monster.
Then, they absorbed all the black crystal from their bodies.
At the same time, these two Shadow Legends erupted with a series of terrifying auras.
And, their figures instantly disappeared from their original positions, rushing towards Wu Ling’Er at high speed.
Wu Ling’Er, seeing this, remarked with interest, "Interesting, is this a new method your Shadow Legion invented?"
"To actually elevate in such a short time, from initial-stage legend to mid-tier."
"Your monarch usually likes to tinker with these little tricks."
In the next moment, Wu Ling’Er changed her tone.
"But still too weak!"
Buzz!
Three figures clashed once more.
The cooperation ability of the two Shadow Legends was quite good.
Behind, the humanoid creature raised a black great sword in its hand, ferociously swinging it towards Wu Ling’Er’s head!
In front.
The three lion heads simultaneously opened wide bloody mouths, biting fiercely at Wu Ling’Er from three directions: upper, middle, and lower!
At this moment, all positions around Wu Ling’Er were blocked by legendary powerhouses.
No matter where she ran, she would suffer a heavy blow!
However, in the face of the close assault by two legendary powerhouses.
Wu Ling’Er neither dodged nor evaded.
A head of green hair suddenly condensed together at this moment.
Sensing the whistling wind behind her.
Instantly, Wu Ling’Er’s green hair surged.
Then directly climbed onto the black crystal great sword, tightly wrapping it.
Moreover, the strands of hair quickly grew within a short time.
Completely binding the movement of that Shadow Legend!
And just at this moment.
The bloody mouth of the three-headed lion monster appeared less than a centimeter in front of Wu Ling’Er.
Wu Ling’Er reached out with her delicate jade hand.
Directly grabbed one of the lion heads, causing the three-headed monster’s charge to stall.
Then, Wu Ling’Er began to exert force!
Crack! Crack crack!
With a terrifying shattering sound, suddenly in Wu Ling’Er’s hand appeared a lion’s head the size of a water tank.
The monster with only two heads left flew backward in a sudden retreat!
The remaining four pupils of the monster still held a strong sense of fear.
That horrifying brute force is enough to strike terror in anyone!
In the next moment.
The humanoid monster bound by Wu Ling’Er’s hair suddenly broke free.
However, as it regained its sight, it witnessed this shocking scene.
At this moment, the humanoid monster murmured, "High-tier legend..."
"The monarch estimated wrongly, you already possess high-tier legendary combat power..."
Wu Ling’Er chuckled lightly.
The next moment, she stretched out her right hand again.
This humanoid monster saw a small palm swiftly covering its entire view!
It knew that if caught by Wu Ling’Er, it would at least be severely wounded, if not dead.
Didn’t it see that terrifying woman still gripping a head?

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 274: The Shadow Demon Venerable Descends! _2
paragraphs: A critical moment.
The black aura on this Shadow Legend surged!
In an instant, it was about to retreat.
However, Wu Ling’Er seemed to have anticipated its move.
As the Shadow Legend violently retreated, she directly grabbed onto its shoulder.
The Legendary Powerhouse showed a look of shock in his eyes.
A terrifying force was transmitted from the shoulder!
Crack! Crack!
He couldn’t imagine how Wu Ling’Er’s small body could possess such a terrifying power?
Yet, Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t give him time to think.
Her long black hair suddenly burst forth at this moment.
At the crucial moment, the Shadow Legend’s eyes flashed decisively.
He directly swung his sword at his own shoulder!
The sound of crystalline shattering echoed.
Wu Ling’Er looked at the piece of black crystal arm in her hand and coldly said, "You really have the nerve."
After speaking, Wu Ling’Er directly threw away the arm and the lion’s head.
At this moment, the Shadow Legend having barely escaped Wu Ling’Er’s grip looked grim.
He clutched his arm and said with difficulty, "The intelligence was wrong, Wu Ling’Er possesses the combat power of a High-tier Legend."
"Prepare to initiate the next phase of the plan ahead of schedule."
"Release all Shadow Sources and destroy the Witch Race Main City!"
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er, usually indifferent to honor and disgrace, showed a slight change in expression.
She knew what the so-called Shadow Sources were.
They are entities even more terrifying than Fourth-turn Lords, Dominators!
As a rule, Lords are already the most formidable creatures at each level.
But in this world, there always exist some who are exceptionally gifted.
They have strength far surpassing their peers and can even break the limits of ordinary cognition.
Such beings are called Dominators.
Typically, a Third Transformation Dominator can rival a Fourth-turn Lord.
And a Fourth-turn Dominator’s strength isn’t inferior to those just entering the Legendary Realm!
However, no matter how many Fourth-turn Dominators there are, with Wu Ling’Er’s power, there is no need to worry.
But these Dominator-level monsters are not coming for her; they aim to attack the Witch Race Soldiers below!
In the Main City, although there is strength to deal with legends,
there is also an overwhelming number of Shadow Monsters below, many Lords and Leaders to confront.
If several Dominator monsters appear at this time, the already precarious situation might collapse instantly!
Wu Ling’Er felt a sense of urgency in her heart.
She took a deep breath, the blue Secret Pattern on her body suddenly expanding!
Seemingly wanting a swift battle so she could then support the Witch Race Main City!
The two Shadow Legends opposing her seemed to detect Wu Ling’Er’s intention.
A person and a beast suddenly erupted with a black Crystal Domain!
Then, the humanoid Legend shouted aloud, "Salute the arrival of the Shadow Demon Venerable!
A Dark Mist instantly covered the sky and earth!
And these dark mists quickly condensed into the form of a giant.
Feeling the formidable presence, Wu Ling’Er murmured, "High-tier Legend..."
"So, your Shadow Legion had already prepared for this!"
Wu Ling’Er had reached the level of a Middle-tier Legend, relying on some means to possess the combat power of a High-tier Legend.
But now, a genuine High-tier Legend appeared!
Even Wu Ling’Er felt an overwhelming pressure!
Besides the pressure, more was the urgency.
Wu Ling’Er worried whether the Witch Race Sky Island below could withstand the Shadow Legion’s raid without her!
The next moment.
Four presence-laden entities collided heavily.
Down in the Witch Race Main City.
After Han Xing blasted away billions of Shadow Monsters, the Witch Race Soldiers suddenly felt the pressure lighten.
Victory seemed within sight.
And at this moment.
Within the shadowy sky, huge shadows suddenly appeared.
At this time, some powerhouses within the Witch Race noticed the shadows as their pupils contracted.
"Quick, look what’s over there?"
After speaking, everyone looked towards the distance.
Amidst the shadowy mist, horrifying creatures more than a kilometer in size, flat-bodied with long thin tails appeared.
"What a terrifying presence, are these Shadow Lords?"
The presence of those creatures even slightly exceeded the limits of the Fourth-turn!
The dreadful pressure made everyone tremble.
At this moment, one Witch Race officer exclaimed in horror, "No...not Lords, they’re Dominators!"
"What!?"
Simultaneously.
The dark mist stirred again.
In the sky, like raindrops, terrifying presences descended one after another.
After landing, they quickly gathered together.
Upon closer inspection.
These beings all exude an aura not less than a Four-star Lord!
At this moment!
Fifteen Dominators, plus over three hundred Lords.
Plus a vast number of Elites, Leaders suddenly appeared!
Moreover, their target was clearly the largest Main City on this Sky Island!
Above, millions of soldiers felt a stifling terror.
An ear-piercing alarm suddenly sounded over the city.
"Attention! Everyone, attention!"
"Numerous Shadow Dominators and Shadow Lords are attacking."
"All soldiers, prepare for battle!"
Inside the Main City, all Witch Race Soldiers’s expressions changed dramatically!
"Oh, god, why are there so many Dominators at once?
"As many as fifteen! Even Legendary Powerhouses are not guaranteed against so many Dominator beings!"
At this time, some soldiers with good vision hurriedly said, "It’s not just Dominators, there are hundreds of Lords too!"
"The Shadow Legion is really making a big move this time!"
"Not even in the war seventy-eight years ago were there so many Dominators and Lords at once!"
At this moment, other soldiers hearing their discussion also realized the situation was extremely grave.
"We’re done for, Lady Saintess hasn’t returned, relying on us, we definitely can’t hold out!"
During their conversation.
The Shadow Army was already approaching the vicinity of the Main City.
Within the Main City, the morale of millions of Witch Race Soldiers was constantly fluctuating.
At this time, an officer said, "Don’t be nervous!"
"Trust the city’s defense, it can definitely obstruct these monsters."
"Don’t forget, there’s an Advanced Defense Tower built with countless resources by the Saintess, not to mention numerous Ancient Weapons!"
"Even Legendary Powerhouses would suffer a heavy blow!"
Upon hearing this, the fear in the soldiers’ eyes gradually dissipated.
After the war seventy-eight years ago.
Two of the Witch Race Main Cities were taken, over ten billion Witch Race civilians slaughtered by the Shadow’s claws.
Since then, all the Main Cities learned from the mistake and began to build various Advanced Defense Towers and Ancient Weapons regardless of cost.
In these decades, there hasn’t been a case of Shadow Legion capturing the Main City again.
These soldiers were just startled by the number of Dominators and Lords.
Actually, with the firepower of the Witch Race Main City, it’s entirely possible to block, even kill this group of monsters!
At the same time.
Throughout the Main City, those Advanced Defense Towers all emitted dazzling lights.
At this moment.
The True Spirit Tower and the Tower of Witch Soul released their attacks.
Thousands of Energy Beams burst forth.
Buzz!
The soldiers watched with hopeful eyes!
They knew these Advanced Defense Towers had destructive power comparable to Ancient Weapons, and so many firing at once could even destroy a true Legend.
The Witch Race Soldiers clenched their fists and shouted, "That’s it, take them down!"
"Let this group of Shadow Monsters taste the might of the Witch Race!"
However, Kathy sitting in the command center frowned deeply.
Contrary to the optimism of the Witch Race Soldiers, Kathy’s expression was extremely serious.
Previously, during numerous Shadow Legion invasion incidents, they were repelled by the defense towers and Ancient Weapons within the Main City.
This time, the Shadow Legion came with greater force than ever before.
She knew these Shadow Monsters must have come prepared.
But now, even Kathy couldn’t figure out what moves they had.
The next moment.
Thousands of Energy Beams instantly traversed over a hundred kilometers, appearing directly above the Dominators!

sentences.text: A critical moment.

In an instant, it was about to retreat.
However, Wu Ling’Er seemed to have anticipated its move.

The Legendary Powerhouse showed a look of shock in his eyes.
A terrifying force was transmitted from the shoulder!
Crack!
Crack!
He couldn’t imagine how Wu Ling’Er’s small body could possess such a terrifying power?
Yet, Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t give him time to think.
Her long black hair suddenly burst forth at this moment.
At the crucial moment, the Shadow Legend’s eyes flashed decisively.
He directly swung his sword at his own shoulder!
The sound of crystalline shattering echoed.
Wu Ling’Er looked at the piece of black crystal arm in her hand and coldly said, "You really have the nerve."

"Prepare to initiate the next phase of the plan ahead of schedule."
"Release all Shadow Sources and destroy the Witch Race Main City!"

They are entities even more terrifying than Fourth-turn Lords, Dominators!
As a rule, Lords are already the most formidable creatures at each level.
But in this world, there always exist some who are exceptionally gifted.
They have strength far surpassing their peers and can even break the limits of ordinary cognition.
Such beings are called Dominators.

there is also an overwhelming number of Shadow Monsters below, many Lords and Leaders to confront.

"So, your Shadow Legion had already prepared for this!"
