chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 275: Death Charge!
paragraphs: Felt the threat coming from above.
In the past, these dominator-level creatures would have certainly used their speed or other means to dodge.
But today is different.
These black creatures that look like mantas not only did not evade but gathered all together!
In the next moment, a circular hole appeared above their heads.
Suddenly, a large amount of shadow powder erupted from those holes.
This powder, with a crystalline luster, fell into the air and in an instant formed a black mist!
This black mist enveloped these dozen dominators, as well as the leaders and leader monsters below.
At the moment when the mist appeared,
Kathy suddenly sat up from her chair, a look of astonishment in her eyes.
Then, she saw with her own eyes.
The attacks from the defense towers, capable of instantly killing dominators and even severely injuring a legend, all fell into the mist.
Then, they vanished.
The energy beams, as if cast into an endless deep sea, were devoured and neutralized.
When the first wave of concentrated fire ended, the mist gradually dissipated.
The anticipation in the eyes of the Witch Race soldiers turned into horror in an instant!
Because they saw.
Not only were those dominator-level creatures unharmed, but even the shadow lord below was not damaged at all!
Their proud defense towers seemed to have been cracked by this group of shadow dominators!
"Oh my god... what kind of method is this?"
"Why are those shadow mists different from before? How can they neutralize the attacks from the defense towers?"
The words of the soldiers were filled with deep despair and confusion.
Even Han Xing, watching from the air, frowned slightly.
The power of these dominator-level creatures exceeded their imagination.
Shen Yun frowned beside him, "A bit troublesome, these shadow creatures actually have means against the defense towers."
"This way, not only is the firepower of the Witch Race main city restricted, but even Brother Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City cannot inflict effective damage on them."
Upon hearing this, everyone also frowned deeply.
Cheng Jianyong asked at this time, "Is there any way?"
"At this rate, if the Shadow Legion charges into the main city, those Witch Race soldiers will have to engage in close combat."
"With their strength, they can’t hold on, can they?"
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, they can’t hold on."
"Most of the combat power of the Witch Race main city is based on those defense towers."
"Once the defense towers lose their effect,"
"However, it’s not that there’s no other way."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up, and they quickly asked, "Brother Xing, what way?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, shook his head, and said, "Let’s see what those Witch Race soldiers do first."
At this moment, Kathy, sitting in the command post, issued a second command.
"All defense towers, demon elephant war chariots, witch pattern battleships, continue outputting maximum firepower."
"Targets are the shadow leaders, elites, and other ordinary monsters!"
This time, she changed the targets of the attack.
Those fifteen dominators together can block the firepower from a thousand Witch Soul Towers.
Even if there’s another round, the effect will be about the same.
Therefore.
Kathy decided to pick the softer targets first.
First, take out this group of leaders, and then find a way to deal with those dominators.
In terms of numbers, the strong ones in the Witch Race are far less than the Shadow Legion.
However, they have many advanced defense towers to make up the gap.
This is their advantage.
Han Xing saw.
Suddenly, two hundred demon elephant war chariots and over a hundred witch pattern battleships flew out from the Witch Race main city!
The number of these ancient weapons far exceeds those in Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City.
And this is not all.
Along the way, Han Xing saw a few more demon elephant war chariots and witch pattern battleships appear sporadically in other cities.
With this calculation, the number of ancient weapons on the entire Sky Island has at least broken through a thousand, dozens of times more than Han Xing’s.
And this is the Witch Race’s foundation.
In the sky,
those demon elephant war chariots and witch pattern battleships are now unleashing a tidal wave of firepower!
Boom!
A muffled sound rang out across the sky.
One by one, shells containing terrifying power burst instantly!
And at this moment.
The group of shadow dominators seemed well prepared.
When they saw the attack of those ancient weapons about to fall into the horde of monsters,
they opened their triangular mouths, then spat out a mass of crystalline powder again, which appeared over the heads of those leader and elite monsters.
Shadow mist reappeared.
The hearts of those Witch Race soldiers sank.
Because they had just witnessed firsthand.
That group of shadow dominators used these mists to block the attacks of a thousand advanced defense towers!
The next moment!
Shells from the demon elephant war chariots and witch pattern battleships blasted into the mist and exploded instantly!
Rumble!
Towering flames shot up.
The concentrated bombardment from so many ancient weapons created a momentum that penetrated layers of shadow mist, shooting straight up to tens of thousands of meters high!
Even outside the Sky Island, one could see that tens of thousands of meters high flame.
When the towering flame and mist simultaneously dissipated.
The Witch Race soldiers saw that the batch of shadow leaders that were bombed indeed suffered some casualties.
However, compared to the momentum created by hundreds of demon elephant war chariots in one wave of bombardment,
the number of monsters killed in front of them was far below their expectations.
At this time.
Commander Kathy’s face was as dark as water, "The Shadow Legion has been sparring with our Witch Race for so many years."
"It seems they have really found a way to counter the defense towers and ancient weapons!"

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 275: Death Charge!
paragraphs: "This is troublesome now!"
Commander Kathy forcibly suppressed her inner agitation and opened the city broadcast, saying, "All soldiers, this is Chief Commander Kathy."
"As you can see, the Shadow Legion already has means against our defense towers and ancient weapons."
"Next, the Shadow Legion will madly assault our main city."
"Please do your utmost to hold the line and do not let these monsters rush into the city!"
The already somewhat shaken Witch Race soldiers felt a sinking feeling in their hearts upon hearing Kathy’s broadcast.
They knew that when Kathy said these words, it meant the situation had reached a very dangerous level.
For a moment, the Witch Race army fell into an atmosphere of despair.
Morale wavered slightly.
However, what Kathy said next gave these Witch Race soldiers a bit of confidence again.
"Everyone, do not be pessimistic."
"Although the Shadow Legion approaches menacingly, do not forget, we have the even more powerful Lady Saintess!"
"The Saintess is currently engaged in legendary battles with two Shadow Legends."
"With her strength, she can definitely resolve the opponents effortlessly."
"By then, once the Saintess returns, all dangers will be resolved!"
Upon hearing Kathy say this, those Witch Race soldiers seemed to remember this fact.
Indeed.
Wu Ling’Er, being a Legendary Powerhouse, her strength is evident to all!
As long as she finishes the battle, the crisis caused by the Dominators will collapse without a fight.
For a moment, the Witch Race soldiers were buoyed with confidence.
The next moment.
Led by hundreds of Shadow Lords, along with tens of thousands of Leaders and Elite Monsters, and countless Shadow Fangs.
They launched a fierce assault on the Witch Race Main City!
The terrifying pressure made all soldiers feel their scalps tingle.
But the only good news is that those fifteen Dominator Level creatures did not move.
They seem to be used by the Shadow Legion specifically to target those ancient weapons and defense towers.
Once they saw a defense tower preparing to focus fire,
these Dominator Level creatures would release a large amount of Shadow Mist ahead of time, blocking the attacks from the defense towers.
Even though those fifteen Dominators did not act, the threat they posed was even more terrifying than a single Shadow Legend.
They nearly half crippled the city’s thousand defense towers and ancient weapons.
However.
After several rounds,
Kathy also discerned the strategies of these Dominators.
She quickly thought of a countermeasure.
That is, to launch irregular bombardments.
A large number of Shadow Monsters rushing near the main city were bombed, even though those Shadow Dominators constantly spewed mist, they couldn’t cover so many areas.
In this way, the precarious situation of the main city was given a slight respite.
Nevertheless, the situation was still not favorable.
Han Xing and others frowned as they observed the battle below.
Clearly.
The Witch Race Main City’s combat power wouldn’t last long before collapsing.
After all, even though those Dominator creatures did not act, there are still over three hundred Lords below.
This force is equally capable of posing a significant threat to the Witch Race Main City.
Earlier.
Warhawk City faced a dozen Lords and felt completely helpless.
And here, the numbers are nearly tenfold!
Even Ten Thousand Stars City would not dare say it can completely withstand the charge of so many Lords.
Additionally, the defense towers are currently restricted.
Han Xing knew that to break this situation,
the key was to unleash the combat power of those defense towers in the main city.
In other words,
they must first eliminate those Dominators.
But now, beside each of those Dominators, countless Shadow Monsters gathered,
including nearly two hundred Lords, and numerous Leaders and Elites.
To eliminate these Dominators means having to break through the defense of these Lords.
Clearly, this is a rather challenging task.
It’s even no less difficult than when they first destroyed the Evil God Altar.
Kathy, being the chief commander of this war, also understood the crux of breaking the impasse.
Meanwhile, she sent a message to all the Leader Level powerhouses in the city.
Or rather, an order.
The group of leaders who received the order immediately looked incredulous.
"Is she joking?"
"These are hundreds of Lords and over ten Dominators!"
"Executing a decapitation strike is practically a death sentence!"
Beside them, another: "Indeed, there aren’t even a hundred leaders throughout the whole main city."
"How can we be a match for those Dominators?"
However, Kathy disregarded their doubts and told them plainly.
This is a military order and must be executed!
Because Kathy has a hunch that there might be complications on Wu Ling’Er’s side.
After all.
With Wu Ling’Er’s strength, taking so long without successfully resolving the battle seems impossible.
Therefore, they cannot place all hope in Wu Ling’Er.
At this moment.
Seeing some officers hesitating,
an aged voice echoed in their ears: "What’s the meaning of this from all of you?"
"One by one, you’re all shrinking back. Have you sat as leaders for too long and now are afraid to die?"
Speaking was an old Witch Race officer, his hair was already gray but his expression was utterly firm.
Facing his questioning, the group of Witch Race officers dared not utter a sound.
Witnessing this scene, the old officer laughed coldly.
"It seems that staying in high positions for too long nearly made you all forget what a battlefield looks like."

And here, the numbers are nearly tenfold!
Even Ten Thousand Stars City would not dare say it can completely withstand the charge of so many Lords.
Additionally, the defense towers are currently restricted.
Han Xing knew that to break this situation,
the key was to unleash the combat power of those defense towers in the main city.
In other words,
they must first eliminate those Dominators.
But now, beside each of those Dominators, countless Shadow Monsters gathered,
including nearly two hundred Lords, and numerous Leaders and Elites.
To eliminate these Dominators means having to break through the defense of these Lords.
Clearly, this is a rather challenging task.
It’s even no less difficult than when they first destroyed the Evil God Altar.
Kathy, being the chief commander of this war, also understood the crux of breaking the impasse.
Meanwhile, she sent a message to all the Leader Level powerhouses in the city.
Or rather, an order.
The group of leaders who received the order immediately looked incredulous.
"Is she joking?"
"These are hundreds of Lords and over ten Dominators!"
"Executing a decapitation strike is practically a death sentence!"
Beside them, another: "Indeed, there aren’t even a hundred leaders throughout the whole main city."
"How can we be a match for those Dominators?"
However, Kathy disregarded their doubts and told them plainly.
This is a military order and must be executed!
Because Kathy has a hunch that there might be complications on Wu Ling’Er’s side.
After all.
With Wu Ling’Er’s strength, taking so long without successfully resolving the battle seems impossible.
Therefore, they cannot place all hope in Wu Ling’Er.
At this moment.
Seeing some officers hesitating,
an aged voice echoed in their ears: "What’s the meaning of this from all of you?"
"One by one, you’re all shrinking back.
Have you sat as leaders for too long and now are afraid to die?"
Speaking was an old Witch Race officer, his hair was already gray but his expression was utterly firm.
Facing his questioning, the group of Witch Race officers dared not utter a sound.
Witnessing this scene, the old officer laughed coldly.
"It seems that staying in high positions for too long nearly made you all forget what a battlefield looks like."

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 275: Death Charge!
paragraphs: "You even dare to defy military orders."
The tone of the elderly officer grew increasingly serious.
At this time, one of the officers hesitated and said, "General Buri, we are not defying orders. We just feel that Commander Kathy’s orders are somewhat unreasonable..."
"I think you can see it too; the number of Dominator Lords is several times ours, and there’s simply no chance to complete the mission."
"Going over now is just sending ourselves to death!"
He spoke very directly.
The elderly officer immediately shouted angrily, "So what if we die?"
"I’ll tell you. Now that the Saintess is not here, everyone must fully obey Commander Kathy’s orders. This is an order personally given by the Saintess."
"Even if she tells us to go to our deaths now, everyone must carry it out!"
"If you don’t dare to, this old man will lead the charge."
"Otherwise, we’ll really let other clans think that our Witch Race are a bunch of cowards afraid of death!"
After speaking, the elderly officer directly jumped onto the Demon Elephant War Chariot and led the charge out.
The group of middle-aged officers, scolded by the elderly officer’s words, felt ashamed.
Watching General Buri’s fearless charge, they felt even more ashamed and simultaneously, their blood began to boil.
The next moment, the group of officers gritted their teeth and shouted, "Kill!"
"Charge out, it’s just a bunch of Lords. I killed them when I was young!"
"Follow me!"
Meanwhile.
Hidden within the Shadow Mist, Ten Thousand Stars City, suddenly saw.
Below, in the Witch Race Main City.
Dozens of Demon Elephant War Chariots suddenly flew out, heading straight for the Dominator’s location.
They seemed to want to target these dozens of Dominators.
The officers controlling the Demon Elephant War Chariots soon engaged with the Shadow Monsters.
The Demon Elephant War Chariots once again demonstrated their formidable combat power, charging through relentlessly!
Thump! Thump thump thump!
One by one, Shadow Fangs were sucked into the saw blades on both sides, then directly shredded into fragments!
Dozens of Golden Light streaks forcefully entered the Shadow Mist, about to contact the Lords’ location.
However.
Though the Demon Elephant War Chariots were strong, their enemies were no pushovers.
Soon, they encountered the obstruction of those Leaders and Elites.
Boom!
With a dull thud of ground impact.
Two Shadow Lords, as large as mountains and resembling horned bulls, suddenly appeared in front of a Demon Elephant War Chariot.
They snorted hot air from their noses.
At this moment.
Other Demon Elephant War Chariots that also charged into the Shadow Monster horde saw this scene.
Several Witch Race officers urgently shouted warnings.
"Mircha, be careful!"
The Witch Race officer controlling this Demon Elephant War Chariot also sensed the imminent danger.
However, it was too late to evade now.
The next moment.
They saw the two Shadow Lords suddenly lower their bodies.
Two crystal-like horns thrust forward!
Bang!
A terrifying impact resounded.
The sharp horns hit the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
The charge of the Golden Light came to an abrupt halt, actually forced to stop!
The defense of the Demon Elephant War Chariot was extremely formidable, almost equivalent to a creature of the same level as the Lord Creatures.
However now, this chariot was facing enemies several times its own size!
In the instant the Demon Elephant War Chariot was stopped.
Those Shadow Lords, Leaders, all seized the opportunity.
Various attacks came crashing down simultaneously!
In the hopeless eyes of the Witch Race officers.
This Demon Elephant War Chariot suffered unimaginable damage in a short time.
Then, with an explosion, the entire Demon Elephant War Chariot was blasted into fragments.
The operator inside the chariot, a Witch Race officer with Lord-level strength, was also blown apart on the spot!
Thump!
Blood and metal fragments mixed and scattered in the air.
This scene filled the Witch Race officers with grief and anger!
"Mircha!"
"These damned Shadow Monsters! I’ll tear you to shreds!"
They all shouted in fury!
The death of their comrade stirred the Witch Race officers.
Previously, they had stayed in high positions for so long, they had forgotten that they too had fought their way up from the bottom.
The bloody scene before them reminded them of their younger selves, igniting the bloodlust in their hearts!
Then, one by one, they charged recklessly, controlling the Demon Elephant War Chariots, heroically into the Shadow Monsters’ formation.
However, their actions seemed to play right into the Dominators’ hands!
The next moment.
The Shadow Monsters that had gathered together suddenly parted.
Among them, five Dominators floating in mid-air suddenly turned their gaze.
From their triangular mouths, a different black mist suddenly erupted.
Covering all these dozens of Demon Elephant War Chariots.
The next moment, the five Dominators instantly disappeared from the scene, diving into the mist.
A deathly sense of oppression loomed.
Kathy, who had been intensely observing the battlefield, suddenly realized something was wrong.
She frantically sent out warning messages.
"Return quickly! This is a plot of the Shadow Dominators!"
"All chariot controllers, retreat back to the Witch Race Main City immediately!"
Her voice was urgent and anxious.
But it was already too late.
At this moment.
All the Shadow Dominators, including those hundreds of Lords, all prepared their attacks.
And bombarded the mist region trapping dozens of Demon Elephant War Chariots.
If this concentrated fire hits, it would undoubtedly explode all these Demon Elephant War Chariots!
The Witch Race officers inside would suffer at least half casualties!
For the Witch Race, it would be a catastrophic blow!
Kathy’s face was pale as paper, she clenched her fists tightly, her nails dug into her flesh.
"Damn it...I misjudged, the intelligence of these Dominators is beyond imagination!"
At this moment, within the Witch Race Main City, the despair was suffocating for the millions of Witch Race soldiers, including the commanders.
If these officers die, the Witch Race will never have a chance of victory in this war!
A million soldiers, including the cool and aloof Commander Kathy, all showed expressions of despair.
And just then.
In the sky, suddenly appeared a large golden figure!
Han Xing took action!

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 276: The Strongest Legend in History!
paragraphs: Looking at the golden shadow, all the Witch Race soldiers raised their heads.
Those are Demon Elephant War Chariots, a full fifty of them!
Before these Lords and Dominators launched their attack, they had already raised their trunks and fired dozens of destructive shells!
Flaming Strike!
At the same time.
With a sound of breaking through the air.
Five hundred ghastly green flames swiftly shot up into the sky.
The target was clearly those dozen Dominator Level creatures.
The terrifying range of destruction even enveloped the hundreds of Lords below!
When these ancient weapons and Hellfire appeared.
The entire Shadow Legion, including the millions of Witch Race soldiers, were stunned.
They seemed unaware of where these Demon Elephant War Chariots had come from.
But undoubtedly, this was a formidable power.
Forcing these Dominator creatures to abandon their attack on the Witch Race generals.
Instead, they hastily spewed smoke again to block the attacks of the Demon Elephant War Chariots and Hellfire!
At this moment.
In the air, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Haha, it turns out Brother Xing was waiting for this opportunity."
"Waiting for these Dominators to launch their attack, unable to release that strange smoke, then hit them hard!"
Everyone laughed along with him.
However, although the Dominators were caught off guard, their actions were truly swift.
A wave of black crystal powder spread and quickly gathered into a cloud of smoke.
All attacks fell into that black mist and, as before, resulted in no effect at all.
Witnessing this, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Damn, are these Dominators’ methods so abnormal?"
"If they can keep releasing this smoke, wouldn’t the Shadow Legion be invincible?"
At this point, Han Xing smiled and said, "Invincible?"
"These Shadow Dominators are far from it."
Cheng Jianyong looked over in confusion.
Han Xing then said, "As long as we take down these Dominators, the remaining Lords will pose no significant threat."
Everyone’s expressions changed.
They understood Han Xing’s intent.
He planned to move against those Dominators!
After speaking, Han Xing’s figure disappeared from the spot.
The next moment.
Millions of soldiers simultaneously raised their heads.
Because they saw a magnificent light appearing above them.
In the sky, a grand and lavish throne appeared.
On the throne stood a male figure with an imposing aura, whose features were unclear.
He stood on the throne.
Slowly drawing the orange great bow in his hand!
An intangible aura of an Emperor seeped from his body.
At this moment.
All beings at or above Lord level sensed that aura.
Involuntarily, they raised their heads.
Commander Kathy raised a brow and exclaimed, "This aura is... the Saint Master?"
"No, that’s not right. Compared to the Saint Master, it’s much weaker."
"Who is this person emitting such an aura?"
Before Kathy could think further.
Han Xing had already released an arrow.
’Gale·Break!’
The speed of this arrow completely surpassed lightning.
Even those Dominator Level creatures’ vision couldn’t catch the arrow’s trajectory.
Moreover, Han Xing launched the attack in the instant the mist dissipated.
Those Dominators couldn’t react at all.
The next moment.
The arrow, carrying the force of destruction, instantly struck the head of one Dominator.
Then, it pierced through and out the back of its head!
Pft!
This Dominator, with a hint of confusion in its eyes, suddenly felt a searing pain in its head.
Yet, this was just the beginning.
After penetrating its head, the arrow, undeterred, hit the eyeball of a second Dominator.
Then continued through its brain.
Pft! Pft pft pft!
A series of a dozen piercing sounds ensued.
In one shot, all the Dominator level monsters on the field were completely pierced through.
More than a dozen Dominators suspended in the air fell like kites with broken strings.
And at this moment.
The gale raised by the arrow’s release suddenly erupted!
Whir——
After a deafening blast.
From the point where Han Xing released the arrow.
To the location of the Dominator level creatures.
A gigantic chasm appeared, dozens of kilometers long, ten meters wide, and about a hundred meters deep!
All the monsters along the way, whether leaders or elites, had completely vanished.
They were all torn into pieces by that terrifying gale!
As those dozen Dominators fell from the sky.
The battlefield, previously in chaos, suddenly quieted down.
Whether it was the Witch Race soldiers or the Shadow Monsters.
They all looked at the gigantic chasm on the battlefield with disbelief in their eyes.
At this moment, a Witch Race officer swallowed and said with difficulty, "One strike, severely wounding over a dozen Dominators, with the aftermath even altering the terrain!"
"Such power, I’ve only seen it when Lady Saintess acts."
"Who is the one who launched this attack?"
"Could it be another legendary warrior of our race?"
Upon hearing the word legend.
The reactions of both sides were entirely different.
The eyes of the Witch Race soldiers lit up intensely.
Because they knew, as long as a legendary warrior stepped in.
They would be saved.
Those Shadow Monsters, whether Lords or so-called Dominators, were insignificant before a true Legend!
Just now, that one strike, with over a dozen Dominators falling, their fate unknown, was the best evidence.
At this moment.
Millions of Witch Race soldiers raised their heads, gazing with anticipation up into the sky.
Then, they saw a majestic and lavish throne floating in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 276: The Strongest Legend in History!
paragraphs: Above, stood a man holding a large bow, with a cold and stern expression.
A human!
Commander Kathy also saw the figure in the sky.
And when she saw Han Xing’s face, she let out a gasp of surprise.
"Is it him?"
Kathy had met Han Xing.
More than a month ago, Han Xing slew Malik in the Witch Race Main City, then defeated Zefer, forcing the legendary powerhouse Feienna to intervene.
Kathy was present at that time.
But back then.
Han Xing’s displayed combat strength was just around the peak of Tier Four, slightly stronger than typical Leader Level figures, but not by much.
And now, he suddenly possessed the aura and combat power of a legendary powerhouse.
"Legendary..." Kathy murmured, filled with disbelief.
"How can it be so fast? It’s only been more than a month since I last saw him, right?"
"Even in the tens of thousands of years of Holy Spirit Realm’s history, such a powerful being has never appeared!"
"How did he manage it?"
However, what Kathy didn’t know was that Han Xing had not yet crossed into the legendary level.
His level was only 45, and he still had a few pieces of golden armor.
At the stage of the fourth transformation, he could still advance further.
This also indirectly indicated that Han Xing’s potential was boundless.
Once he reaches level 50, formally stepping into the legendary realm.
Perhaps, as Wu Ling’Er said,
He will become the most powerful legendary powerhouse in Holy Spirit Realm’s history!
The next moment.
Han Xing’s figure suddenly disappeared from where he stood.
Then, he directly appeared above the group of dominator level creatures!
Now, Han Xing’s movement speed and agility reached an unparalleled level.
There’s no need to worry that he would be trapped by the monster swarm and be besieged.
Han Xing also knew the dominators weren’t dead yet.
With their mighty life force, having their heads pierced wasn’t considered a severe injury.
Sure enough, upon seeing Han Xing.
The dozen terrifying figures on the ground instantly erupted with monstrous killing intent.
They were only temporarily stunned by the blow.
Now, reacting, terrifying auras were released from their bodies!
"Pop——"
The dominator level creatures spit out a black smoke.
They used this move to trap a batch of Demon Elephant War Chariots, almost leading to the total annihilation of those Witch Race powerhouses.
Now, it seemed they wanted to use the same trick again.
However.
Han Xing was dismissive.
What greeted the dominators was an arrow crackling with flames!
From this arrow, the dominators felt a threat and destructive power even more terrifying than those defense towers!
They wanted to interrupt the skill, release the previous black crystals to block the arrow’s attack.
But Han Xing’s attack was much faster than the defense tower.
Moreover, at such close range.
The dominator level creatures had no chance to dodge.
The next moment.
The arrow descended, igniting a flame with a diameter of over a kilometer!
Boom!
The soaring fire illuminated everyone’s vision at this moment.
Heatwaves swept out instantly.
In the nearby area spanning several kilometers, all shadow monsters below the Lord Level were overturned by the terrifying impact.
Including soldiers within the main city, they felt unsteady.
And this is the power of the legendary level.
Han Xing merely touched upon this level.
At the fourth transformation stage, the almost invincible dominator monsters were single-handedly crushed by him.
At this moment.
The shock in Kathy’s eyes grew more intense, observing this battlefield.
If she weren’t sensing that Han Xing’s aura was just at the fourth transformation level,
She would truly believe Han Xing had broken through to the legendary level!
Looking at the soldiers in a daze.
Han Xing turned and said.
"Don’t just stand there stunned, I’ll handle these dominators. You start up defense towers and ancient weapons, deal with the leader monsters."
With Han Xing’s reminder, the Witch Race soldiers finally snapped out of their daze.
Including Kathy, hurriedly activating the defense towers, began attacking the overwhelming Shadow Legion.
Boom! Boom boom!
The attack range of the True Spirit Tower and Tower of Witch Soul was vast.
Previously restrained by dominator level creatures, they couldn’t fully utilize their effects.
But now, with the dominator level creatures being crushed by Han Xing,
Those powerful defense towers in the Witch Race main city were now free to unleash their full might!
Large swaths of shadow monsters were obliterated, and the previously precarious situation of the Witch Race main city suddenly improved.
On Han Xing’s side, the dominator level creatures seemed to want to struggle to stand up.
And at this moment, Shen Yun’s two blessings came over, enhancing his attributes significantly!
Han Xing was still discontent.
He directly activated the medal effect, ’Breath of the Wild.’
Activating the effect enhances evasion rate by 99%, movement speed by 99%, attack power by 99%, lasting for 10 seconds.
Already reaching a terrifying level, Han Xing’s aura now truly reached the legendary level.
Even in the hundred thousand meter high sky.
The four figures locked in a life-and-death battle sensed a rising aura from below.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er had just slapped away a lion-headed monster, suddenly furrowing her brows.
"Legendary... Another legendary powerhouse appeared?"
"This aura seems like never sensed before..."
Wu Ling’Er felt puzzled, growing increasingly anxious.
"Damn it, what unexpected situation occurred below!
Wu Ling’Er now wanted to quickly rid herself of the opponents, to see what happened in her main city.
However, despite her overwhelming combat power.
Her opponents were even stronger.
That one was a true Shadow Demon Venerable, a high-tier legend!
Additionally, there were two assistance shadow legends.
If replaced with other Witch Race legends coming over, they would’ve been slaughtered by now.
Thanks to Wu Ling’Er continuously erupting, was she barely maintaining the situation.
Yet even so, Wu Ling’Er was being fully constrained.
And as time passed.
Wu Ling’Er increasingly felt somewhat out of her depth.
Below...
After activating Breath of the Wild effect.
Han Xing’s aura surged again, nearly doubling in intensity!
The entire Witch Race Sky Island was enveloped in his terrifying force.
Han Xing’s eyes suddenly showed a strange expression.
"So this is... the power of the legendary level?"
"Interesting, at this level, the way of perceiving the world seems somewhat different."
Indeed, after activating the effect, Han Xing suddenly realized he gained a special ability.
That is, extending consciousness outward.
He closed his eyes, yet could clearly sense.
Within a radius of nearly ten thousand meters centered on himself, all enemies and other creatures.
Furthermore, their strengths are known perfectly.
Even what they were saying, Han Xing knew with complete clarity.
This ability must be a special ability exclusive to legendary powerhouses.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing raised his head, sensing the four battling auras in the sky.
Among them, one aura carried a gentle yet firm presence, fighting alone against three other powerful beings.
At this time, Han Xing thought quietly: "So, Wu Ling’Er’s battleground is in the sky."
"But it seems her situation over there isn’t quite favorable."
"Everyone assumed Wu Ling’Er was dealing with two shadow legends."
"When in fact, it’s three."
"And among them, one aura is formidable enough that even now, I feel completely outmatched."
As Han Xing pondered these thoughts.
The shadow dominators below struggled to rise again.
Han Xing glanced at them, finding these shadow dominators severely injured.
So, Han Xing drew the bowstring once more.
A terrifying sense of tear appeared.
Before the arrow was shot, the group of shadow dominators seemed struck by lightning, falling from the sky once again.
Several seconds later.
All fifteen dominator level creatures perished.
A system notification appeared.
[Slain ’Shadow Source’, Four-star Dominator Level creature, gained experience value 124 million...]
[Slain ’Shadow Source’...]

sentences.text: Above, stood a man holding a large bow, with a cold and stern expression.
A human!
Commander Kathy also saw the figure in the sky.
And when she saw Han Xing’s face, she let out a gasp of surprise.
"Is it him?"
Kathy had met Han Xing.
More than a month ago, Han Xing slew Malik in the Witch Race Main City, then defeated Zefer, forcing the legendary powerhouse Feienna to intervene.
Kathy was present at that time.
But back then.
Han Xing’s displayed combat strength was just around the peak of Tier Four, slightly stronger than typical Leader Level figures, but not by much.
And now, he suddenly possessed the aura and combat power of a legendary powerhouse.
"Legendary..." Kathy murmured, filled with disbelief.
"How can it be so fast?
It’s only been more than a month since I last saw him, right?"
"Even in the tens of thousands of years of Holy Spirit Realm’s history, such a powerful being has never appeared!"
"How did he manage it?"
However, what Kathy didn’t know was that Han Xing had not yet crossed into the legendary level.
His level was only 45, and he still had a few pieces of golden armor.
At the stage of the fourth transformation, he could still advance further.
This also indirectly indicated that Han Xing’s potential was boundless.
Once he reaches level 50, formally stepping into the legendary realm.
Perhaps, as Wu Ling’Er said,
He will become the most powerful legendary powerhouse in Holy Spirit Realm’s history!
The next moment.
Han Xing’s figure suddenly disappeared from where he stood.
Then, he directly appeared above the group of dominator level creatures!
Now, Han Xing’s movement speed and agility reached an unparalleled level.
There’s no need to worry that he would be trapped by the monster swarm and be besieged.
Han Xing also knew the dominators weren’t dead yet.
With their mighty life force, having their heads pierced wasn’t considered a severe injury.
Sure enough, upon seeing Han Xing.
The dozen terrifying figures on the ground instantly erupted with monstrous killing intent.
They were only temporarily stunned by the blow.
Now, reacting, terrifying auras were released from their bodies!
"Pop——"
The dominator level creatures spit out a black smoke.
They used this move to trap a batch of Demon Elephant War Chariots, almost leading to the total annihilation of those Witch Race powerhouses.
Now, it seemed they wanted to use the same trick again.
However.
Han Xing was dismissive.
What greeted the dominators was an arrow crackling with flames!
From this arrow, the dominators felt a threat and destructive power even more terrifying than those defense towers!
They wanted to interrupt the skill, release the previous black crystals to block the arrow’s attack.
But Han Xing’s attack was much faster than the defense tower.
Moreover, at such close range.
The dominator level creatures had no chance to dodge.
The next moment.
The arrow descended, igniting a flame with a diameter of over a kilometer!
Boom!
The soaring fire illuminated everyone’s vision at this moment.
Heatwaves swept out instantly.
In the nearby area spanning several kilometers, all shadow monsters below the Lord Level were overturned by the terrifying impact.
Including soldiers within the main city, they felt unsteady.
And this is the power of the legendary level.
Han Xing merely touched upon this level.
At the fourth transformation stage, the almost invincible dominator monsters were single-handedly crushed by him.
At this moment.
The shock in Kathy’s eyes grew more intense, observing this battlefield.
If she weren’t sensing that Han Xing’s aura was just at the fourth transformation level,
She would truly believe Han Xing had broken through to the legendary level!
Looking at the soldiers in a daze.
Han Xing turned and said.
"Don’t just stand there stunned, I’ll handle these dominators.
You start up defense towers and ancient weapons, deal with the leader monsters."
With Han Xing’s reminder, the Witch Race soldiers finally snapped out of their daze.
Including Kathy, hurriedly activating the defense towers, began attacking the overwhelming Shadow Legion.
Boom!
Boom boom!
The attack range of the True Spirit Tower and Tower of Witch Soul was vast.
Previously restrained by dominator level creatures, they couldn’t fully utilize their effects.
But now, with the dominator level creatures being crushed by Han Xing,
Those powerful defense towers in the Witch Race main city were now free to unleash their full might!
Large swaths of shadow monsters were obliterated, and the previously precarious situation of the Witch Race main city suddenly improved.
On Han Xing’s side, the dominator level creatures seemed to want to struggle to stand up.
And at this moment, Shen Yun’s two blessings came over, enhancing his attributes significantly!
Han Xing was still discontent.
He directly activated the medal effect, ’Breath of the Wild.’
Activating the effect enhances evasion rate by 99%, movement speed by 99%, attack power by 99%, lasting for 10 seconds.
Already reaching a terrifying level, Han Xing’s aura now truly reached the legendary level.
Even in the hundred thousand meter high sky.
The four figures locked in a life-and-death battle sensed a rising aura from below.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er had just slapped away a lion-headed monster, suddenly furrowing her brows.
"Legendary...
Another legendary powerhouse appeared?"
"This aura seems like never sensed before..."
Wu Ling’Er felt puzzled, growing increasingly anxious.
"Damn it, what unexpected situation occurred below!
Wu Ling’Er now wanted to quickly rid herself of the opponents, to see what happened in her main city.
However, despite her overwhelming combat power.
Her opponents were even stronger.
That one was a true Shadow Demon Venerable, a high-tier legend!
Additionally, there were two assistance shadow legends.
If replaced with other Witch Race legends coming over, they would’ve been slaughtered by now.
Thanks to Wu Ling’Er continuously erupting, was she barely maintaining the situation.
Yet even so, Wu Ling’Er was being fully constrained.
And as time passed.
Wu Ling’Er increasingly felt somewhat out of her depth.
Below...

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 277: Turning the Tide
paragraphs: Ground.
The fifteen gigantic corpses gradually dissipated.
These shadow creatures, after dying, rapidly lose the energy of their bodies and then gradually turn into a mass of black powder, dispersing into the air.
Even dominator-level creatures are no exception.
This scene.
Was witnessed by Kathy in the command room, who was using special means to watch the battlefield here.
Her always stern face suddenly showed a look of shock mixed with a bit of fear.
This is the power of the legendary level, no matter if you are a fourth-turn lord, a dominator, or even break the limits.
But as long as you haven’t reached the legendary level, you are all ants!
At this moment, Kathy sighed in relief and patted her ample chest.
She couldn’t help but feel grateful.
Luckily, this human powerhouse came to help them.
If at this moment, he followed the Shadow Legion to attack the Witch Race, the consequences would have been unimaginable!
After dealing with these dozen dominator creatures.
Han Xing suddenly noticed.
The medal on his chest was faintly scorching.
It’s the ’King of the Wilderness Medal’.
Han Xing remembered that this medal could be upgraded.
During the Blood Tide, Han Xing took down countless powerful monsters, upgrading it to orange level.
Moreover, it could still be upgraded further.
However, it required Han Xing to kill more monsters.
After so long, he wondered how the upgrade progress was going.
So, Han Xing clicked on the item attributes to take a look.
[King of the Wilderness Medal Upgrade Progress]
Lord-level creatures: 9472/10000.
Dominator-level creatures: 100/100.
Legendary-level creatures: 0/1.
Seeing this upgrade progress, Han Xing froze for a moment.
He hadn’t expected that he had managed to eliminate so many lords and dominators from the Blood Tide period to now.
Now, he just needed to deal with over five hundred more lords, and additionally one legendary creature, then he could directly upgrade this medal to red level, which is the divine artifact quality.
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel excited.
The current orange medal’s attributes were already quite terrifying.
Just the perk of increasing all attributes by 15%, and dealing an extra 15% damage to lord-level creatures, exceeded the bonus of a piece of golden equipment.
Moreover, there was also a rather formidable special effect.
These two effects had already significantly amplified Han Xing’s combat abilities.
Just imagine how powerful it would be if it were upgraded again?
Just then.
Han Xing noticed that in the places where the dominators had died, many black stones were left behind.
The appearance of these stones was very familiar; they were shadow divine stones.
However, these dominator-level monsters dropped a lot of shadow divine stones.
Han Xing took a rough scan and found there were at least a couple of hundred.
Besides the shadow divine stones, Han Xing also noticed that above the corpses of these dominator-level monsters, there floated a mass of red flames.
Just as Han Xing was about to check out what these red flames were.
The ’Breath of the Wild’ effect, ten-second duration, ended.
Han Xing fell out of that magical state.
At the same time, he suddenly noticed the red flames that were there before had also disappeared.
As if it had been a mere illusion before.
Han Xing’s eyes showed a hint of thought.
At his level, unless affected by a certain spiritual illusion technique, it is impossible to experience hallucinations.
This indicates that those red flames were undoubtedly real.
To verify this guess, Han Xing’s figure flashed and returned directly to Ten Thousand Stars City.
He went to Cheng Jianyong and asked, "Did you see any red flames among those shadow divine stones?"
Cheng Jianyong listened, looked intently, then shook his head in bewilderment.
"No, Brother Xing, there’s just a pile of shadow divine stones on the ground."
"But there are so many, we struck it rich this time!"
Han Xing nodded, confirming his own speculation.
These red flames could only be seen by oneself after activating the ’Breath of the Wild’ effect.
Or rather, only those who had touched the legendary power level could see them.
Han Xing’s figure flashed again, returning to the pile of shadow divine stones.
He found that with the Oracle Throne, it really was convenient.
You could go anywhere you wanted, and the movement speed was fast.
Even though he couldn’t see them, Han Xing still relied on a vague impression from his memory to go to the places where the flames hovered, then reached out to touch.
A system prompt appeared.
"Obtained special item: Divine Power Source Fire*1."
[Divine Power Source Fire]: Flames containing divine power, which fourth-turned spirits can ignite upon reaching the current level limit to strike the fifth transformation legendary realm.

Note: After igniting the source fire, if divine power is successfully mastered, it will automatically ascend to legendary level powerhouse status (the more source fires ignited, the greater the chance of mastering divine power).
Note 2: If mastering divine power fails, one can choose to ascend as an ordinary fifth transformation powerhouse; or choose to downgrade by 5 levels to reattempt the legendary realm breakthrough.
Upon seeing this introduction of the Divine Power Source Fire, Han Xing’s pupils constricted.
Turns out, this item is the key tool for survivors to break through from the fourth transformation to the fifth!
Moreover, it’s the key to crossing into the legendary level!
Then, Han Xing suddenly recalled that Wu Ling’Er had once told him.
There’s a fundamental difference between legendary powerhouses and ordinary fifth transformations, which is mastering divine power.
This Divine Power Source Fire is the key item in helping them master divine power.
However, this also has some drawbacks; there’s a failure probability in mastering divine power.
If mastering fails, one can either ascend as an ordinary fifth transformation powerhouse or choose to downgrade by 5 levels to reattempt the legendary realm breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 277: Turning the Tide! (Part 2)
paragraphs: If you choose to attempt the Legendary Realm anew, you must endure the massive cost of dropping 5 levels.
From level 45 to 50, the experience required is enormous.
Even for Han Xing, constantly grinding Abyssal Rifts would take at least a few months.
For ordinary survivors, it would be half a year or even a year.
Equivalent to severely slowing down progress.
Moreover, there’s no guarantee that the next attempt at the Legendary Realm will succeed.
No wonder Wu Ling’Er had mentioned before.
In this world, there are many Fifth Transformation powerhouses.
However, those who can reach the Legendary Realm are very few.
Han Xing pondered, "To reach the Legendary Realm is indeed very difficult."
"However, compared to the native residents of this world, we survivors still have a significant advantage."
"At least we can directly see our stats and the cost we need to bear upon failure."
"Moreover, this cost is not unbearable; even dropping 5 levels only delays us by about a year."
"But if successful, the benefits are enormous."
"The difference between a Fifth Transformation Legend and an ordinary Fifth Transformation is vast!"
With this in mind, Han Xing excitedly stored these Divine Power Source Fires into his backpack.
"Obtained special item: Divine Power Source Fire*14, obtained Shadow Divine Stone*210..."
Han Xing nodded.
Based on these calculations.
A Fourth Transformation Dominator is guaranteed to drop one Divine Power Source Fire.
Han Xing remembered that the item information above noted.
When attempting the Legendary Realm, the more Divine Fires ignited, the higher the chance of success.
With his strength, these Fourth Transformation Dominators were no longer worth his attention.
In other words, as long as there are enough Fourth Transformation Dominator level beings, Han Xing can acquire a large amount of Divine Power Source Fire!
At the Fifth Transformation, Han Xing was determined to stack himself into a Legendary Level powerhouse using a pile of Divine Fires.
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s mood improved significantly.
Ever since joining the war between the Shadow Legion and the Witch Race.
Han Xing has harvested greatly along the way.
Those ordinary shadow monsters could drop Shadow Crystals, which can be used to exchange in the Battle Merit Store.
The lords could drop precious materials like Shadow Divine Stone.
Now, these Shadow Dominators have even dropped critical items like Divine Power Source Fire.
In Han Xing’s eyes, this wasn’t a Shadow invasion; it was basically bringing treasures to him.
After eliminating the threat of the Dominator, it solved the biggest crisis on the Witch Race Sky Island.
Kathy seized the opportunity to control the defense towers in the main city, starting continuous blast strikes.
Boom! Rumble!
The firepower of the Witch Race Main City is several times stronger than that of Ten Thousand Stars City.
With full firepower now.
Han Xing witnessed what a saturation bombing scene looks like.
Groups of shadow monsters were blown to pieces under Kathy’s relentless bombardment.
This included the entire huge Witch Race Sky Island, battlefields in other cities, and even those wasteland areas.
Kathy spared none.
Each attack from the Tower of Witch Soul took down a large number of shadow monsters and also caused significant destruction to the Sky Island’s terrain.
In an instant, countless craters appeared, with many cities destroyed as well.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing spread his hands.
Previously, he thought his bombardment might damage Wu Ling’Er’s Sky Island.
Now it seems, their own side struck even harder.
They’re almost flipping the entire Sky Island upside down.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er, fighting in the sky, grew increasingly anxious.
She didn’t know the situation below.
Wu Ling’Er naturally assumed that the situation below must be very unfavorable.
This time, the Shadow Legion had brought in high-tier legends.
Having dealt with them for so many years, Wu Ling’Er deeply understood the terrifying power of the Shadow Legion.
They came with such a grand show, they must have found a way to deal with the defense towers in the main city.
The Witch Race Sky Island below must be enduring extremely terrifying pressure at this moment.
Every second she delayed might result in more Witch Race soldiers perishing under the claws of the shadow monsters.
Wu Ling’Er felt increasingly restless.
The next moment, she let out a light cry.
The ocean of blue secret patterns covering the sky retracted into her body at that moment.
Wu Ling’Er took a deep breath.
Then, an overwhelming power erupted from her body.
Buzz!
It was as if an eighteen-level hurricane had swept through the place.
Three Shadow Legends were suddenly forced back.
Wu Ling’Er seized the opportunity and instantly departed from the battlefield.
Watching Wu Ling’Er leave.
The humanoid creature, nearly a hundred meters tall and holding a trident, shouted, "Stop her!"
The next moment, three legendary powerhouses pursued rapidly!
In the sky.
Four beams of light suddenly appeared.
A blue beam, like a dazzling lightning, descended swiftly with terrifying speed!
Behind it were three black beams, rapidly closing in!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er lightly bit her lip, clenched her fist, and said.
"This time, I misjudged and underestimated the Shadow Legion’s determination to destroy my clan."
"My kin in the main city, you must hold on!"
A million meters in the air, roughly more than a thousand kilometers away.
At the movement speed of legendary powerhouses, it would take only a dozen seconds.
However, in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes, these dozen seconds seemed so long.
Behind her.
Three Shadow Legends were in relentless pursuit!
The high-tier legend suddenly raised the trident in its hand, brewing massive dark divine power within it.
Sizzle... sizzle...
Like a burst of black lightning!
The next moment, its speed surged significantly!
It was about to catch up with Wu Ling’Er.
This guy, truly boasts the combat prowess of a high-tier legend.
Even in a one-on-one situation, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t claim to be its match.
After all, even among legends, there are differences in strength and weakness.
She was a level below the Shadow Demon Venerable.
However, Wu Ling’Er had no intention of entangling with it further at this moment.
She just wanted to return to the Witch Race Sky Island as soon as possible to rescue her people.
Seeing the Shadow Demon Venerable was now less than a hundred meters away from her.
And the other two Shadow Legends were also getting closer.
Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth, and her aura suddenly concentrated.
With a low voice, she gritted her teeth and shouted.
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Forbidden Abyss!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er, regardless of the cost, used the Witch Clan’s lethal forbidden technique again!
A dark vortex enveloped the three Shadow Legends completely.
Trapped in the Forbidden Abyss, even legendary powerhouses would be dragged in by that terrifying suction and then swept into the endless abyss.
However, there’s always an exception.
If the target devoured by the abyss is too powerful, they can use their own strength to forcibly break free from that attraction and struggle out.
Obviously, this Forbidden Abyss could not swallow up these three powerful legendary powerhouses all at once.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t know how long her forbidden technique could hold them.
But she knew she had to make the most of her time to head to the main city for the rescue.
Thus, Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth again and softly whispered, "Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Witch Soul Transfer!"
The next moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure vanished from the spot.
The Shadow Demon Venerable and the other two Shadow Legends were deep within the dark vortex.
Continuously releasing their divine power to counter that terrifying suction.
While resisting the vortex.
The Shadow Demon Venerable still watched the Witch Race Sky Island below, with flickering fierce green flames in its eyes.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure suddenly appeared within the Royal City.
Before she could check the current battle situation, she suddenly felt a surge of blood within her body.
A mouthful of fresh blood spurted from her throat.
Because of consecutively using forbidden techniques, Wu Ling’Er suffered severe backlash.
Even though she was the Witch Race Saintess, even though she had exceptional talent, she was at her limit now.
But now was not the time to worry about these things.
She needed to quickly figure out the current situation of the main city.
Although she had prepared for the worst.
After calming the churning blood inside her, she instantly released her divine sense.
The entire Witch Race Sky Island, all areas were now covered by her divine sense.
And at this moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s expression suddenly changed.
Because, in her perception, the current battle situation on the Witch Race Sky Island.
Seemed a bit different from what she imagined...

The lords could drop precious materials like Shadow Divine Stone.
Now, these Shadow Dominators have even dropped critical items like Divine Power Source Fire.
In Han Xing’s eyes, this wasn’t a Shadow invasion; it was basically bringing treasures to him.
After eliminating the threat of the Dominator, it solved the biggest crisis on the Witch Race Sky Island.
Kathy seized the opportunity to control the defense towers in the main city, starting continuous blast strikes.
Boom!
Rumble!
The firepower of the Witch Race Main City is several times stronger than that of Ten Thousand Stars City.
With full firepower now.
Han Xing witnessed what a saturation bombing scene looks like.
Groups of shadow monsters were blown to pieces under Kathy’s relentless bombardment.
This included the entire huge Witch Race Sky Island, battlefields in other cities, and even those wasteland areas.
Kathy spared none.
Each attack from the Tower of Witch Soul took down a large number of shadow monsters and also caused significant destruction to the Sky Island’s terrain.
In an instant, countless craters appeared, with many cities destroyed as well.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing spread his hands.
Previously, he thought his bombardment might damage Wu Ling’Er’s Sky Island.
Now it seems, their own side struck even harder.
They’re almost flipping the entire Sky Island upside down.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er, fighting in the sky, grew increasingly anxious.
She didn’t know the situation below.
Wu Ling’Er naturally assumed that the situation below must be very unfavorable.
This time, the Shadow Legion had brought in high-tier legends.
Having dealt with them for so many years, Wu Ling’Er deeply understood the terrifying power of the Shadow Legion.
They came with such a grand show, they must have found a way to deal with the defense towers in the main city.
The Witch Race Sky Island below must be enduring extremely terrifying pressure at this moment.
Every second she delayed might result in more Witch Race soldiers perishing under the claws of the shadow monsters.
Wu Ling’Er felt increasingly restless.
The next moment, she let out a light cry.
The ocean of blue secret patterns covering the sky retracted into her body at that moment.
Wu Ling’Er took a deep breath.
Then, an overwhelming power erupted from her body.
Buzz!
It was as if an eighteen-level hurricane had swept through the place.
Three Shadow Legends were suddenly forced back.
Wu Ling’Er seized the opportunity and instantly departed from the battlefield.
Watching Wu Ling’Er leave.
The humanoid creature, nearly a hundred meters tall and holding a trident, shouted, "Stop her!"
The next moment, three legendary powerhouses pursued rapidly!
In the sky.
Four beams of light suddenly appeared.
A blue beam, like a dazzling lightning, descended swiftly with terrifying speed!
Behind it were three black beams, rapidly closing in!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er lightly bit her lip, clenched her fist, and said.
"This time, I misjudged and underestimated the Shadow Legion’s determination to destroy my clan."
"My kin in the main city, you must hold on!"
A million meters in the air, roughly more than a thousand kilometers away.
At the movement speed of legendary powerhouses, it would take only a dozen seconds.
However, in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes, these dozen seconds seemed so long.
Behind her.
Three Shadow Legends were in relentless pursuit!
The high-tier legend suddenly raised the trident in its hand, brewing massive dark divine power within it.
Sizzle... sizzle...
Like a burst of black lightning!
The next moment, its speed surged significantly!
It was about to catch up with Wu Ling’Er.
This guy, truly boasts the combat prowess of a high-tier legend.
Even in a one-on-one situation, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t claim to be its match.
After all, even among legends, there are differences in strength and weakness.
She was a level below the Shadow Demon Venerable.
However, Wu Ling’Er had no intention of entangling with it further at this moment.
She just wanted to return to the Witch Race Sky Island as soon as possible to rescue her people.
Seeing the Shadow Demon Venerable was now less than a hundred meters away from her.
And the other two Shadow Legends were also getting closer.
Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth, and her aura suddenly concentrated.
With a low voice, she gritted her teeth and shouted.
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Forbidden Abyss!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er, regardless of the cost, used the Witch Clan’s lethal forbidden technique again!
A dark vortex enveloped the three Shadow Legends completely.
Trapped in the Forbidden Abyss, even legendary powerhouses would be dragged in by that terrifying suction and then swept into the endless abyss.
However, there’s always an exception.
If the target devoured by the abyss is too powerful, they can use their own strength to forcibly break free from that attraction and struggle out.
Obviously, this Forbidden Abyss could not swallow up these three powerful legendary powerhouses all at once.
Wu Ling’Er didn’t know how long her forbidden technique could hold them.
But she knew she had to make the most of her time to head to the main city for the rescue.
Thus, Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth again and softly whispered, "Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Witch Soul Transfer!"
The next moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure vanished from the spot.
The Shadow Demon Venerable and the other two Shadow Legends were deep within the dark vortex.
Continuously releasing their divine power to counter that terrifying suction.
While resisting the vortex.
The Shadow Demon Venerable still watched the Witch Race Sky Island below, with flickering fierce green flames in its eyes.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s figure suddenly appeared within the Royal City.
Before she could check the current battle situation, she suddenly felt a surge of blood within her body.
A mouthful of fresh blood spurted from her throat.
Because of consecutively using forbidden techniques, Wu Ling’Er suffered severe backlash.
Even though she was the Witch Race Saintess, even though she had exceptional talent, she was at her limit now.
But now was not the time to worry about these things.
She needed to quickly figure out the current situation of the main city.
Although she had prepared for the worst.
After calming the churning blood inside her, she instantly released her divine sense.
The entire Witch Race Sky Island, all areas were now covered by her divine sense.
And at this moment.
Wu Ling’Er’s expression suddenly changed.
Because, in her perception, the current battle situation on the Witch Race Sky Island.
Seemed a bit different from what she imagined...

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 278: High-tier Legend, Heaven and Earth Destruction!
paragraphs: Wu Ling’Er originally thought that the current Witch Race Main City should be in a precarious state.
Even-
It was very possible that it had already been conquered by the Shadow Legion.
But now.
Not only did she not see any dangerous situation.
Instead, those Shadow Monsters were being blown apart by the main city’s Defense Towers.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t help but wonder if she was hallucinating.
But when she sensed again, she found it was still so.
Even with Wu Ling’Er’s composure, she couldn’t help but feel her mind buzzing.
What on earth... happened?
Could it be that those two guys were deceiving her?
There were no Shadow Source and Lord Army descending at all.
However, Wu Ling’Er immediately shook her head.
Because she did sense the aura of many Dominators above, a lot of them.
Among them, there was also a terrifying power residue.
A shocking battle seemed to have occurred between the two sides.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er really wanted to find someone to ask what exactly happened.
Her figure flashed, and she appeared directly in the command center of the main city, right next to Kathy.
Kathy suddenly felt an additional presence beside her and was taken aback.
However, when she saw that the figure was Wu Ling’Er, the alert and seriousness on her face disappeared, replaced by a look of surprise.
"Lady Saintess!"
Kathy wanted to say something more.
However, Wu Ling’Er said with a serious expression: "Make it quick!"
"Tell me, what happened after I left with those two Shadow Legends?"
"Also, who killed those Dominators?"
Upon hearing this, Kathy immediately put away her smile and began to quickly explain to Wu Ling’Er what happened next.
The more Wu Ling’Er listened, the more the shock in her eyes grew.
And when she heard that it was the humans she brought from the Land of the Abandoned Gods, including Han Xing, who took action.
The astonishment in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes could no longer be suppressed.
"What did you say?
"Han Xing has already stepped into the Legendary Realm!?"
Wu Ling’Er’s voice was a little trembling.
She had lived for nearly a thousand years, but she had never lost her composure like this.
After all, she personally brought Han Xing out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
She was well aware of his strength.
At that time, they had obviously just barely gone through the Fourth Transformation.
Without even knowing how to step into the Legendary Realm.
Until now, not even two months had passed, right?
And now you’re telling me that Han Xing has already broken through to Legendary?
However, Kathy across from her shook her head and said, "Lady Saintess, I’m not too sure either."
"However, this human, who is Han Xing, indeed demonstrated Legendary Level combat power."
"He single-handedly easily wiped out those dozen or so Dominator monsters."
Looking into Kathy’s eyes, Wu Ling’Er knew that she couldn’t possibly be lying about this.
In her Divine Sense perception, she did indeed find Han Xing’s aura.
At first, she was a bit surprised at why they appeared here.
Now, she completely understood.
Han Xing rushed to help her as soon as he heard about the Shadow Legion’s invasion.
All of a sudden, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t help but feel a warm current surge in her heart.
This wonderful feeling was something Wu Ling’Er had never experienced before.
The next moment, she took a deep breath and said: "I understand."
"Keep what happened here a secret."
"Including the fact you saw Han Xing slaughter that group of Dominators, also keep it confidential."
Wu Ling’Er had her own concerns.
After all, in just two short months, breaking through from the Fourth Transformation to Legendary.
Whether for the Witch Race or the entire Holy Spirit Realm, it was truly astonishing.
If other major clan powerhouses were to find out, it might cause trouble for Han Xing.
Upon hearing this, Kathy solemnly nodded and said: "Yes!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er really wanted to find Han Xing and see what happened to him.
However, before she could take action.
In the sky.
Three terrifying auras had already descended.
The entire Sky Island, with billions of creatures, was enveloped by the terrifying aura, and their bodies froze.
Those Witch Race civilians, in particular, directly fainted.
Wu Ling’Er’s expression changed.
She knew that the Shadow Demon Venerable and the other two Shadow Legends had broken free.
No time to think more.
Wu Ling’Er instantly shot up into the sky.
Since there was no longer any danger here.
Then she would take these three Legendary creatures away from the Witch Race Sky Island.
After all.
The coverage area during a Legendary Level battle is too large.
If not careful, it might even destroy the entire Sky Island.
Therefore, Wu Ling’Er absolutely would not let these Shadow Legends get close to her Sky Island!
However, knowing her intentions, those Shadow Legends naturally wouldn’t let Wu Ling’Er have her way.
Be aware that the original goal of the Shadow Legion was to cause widespread destruction to the Witch Race’s power and slaughter more Witch Race people.
Previously, they were just coerced by Wu Ling’Er and had to change the battlefield.
But now that Wu Ling’Er had run back to the Witch Race Sky Island, they would certainly not miss such a good opportunity.
Looking at the Sky Island below, the fire in the pupils of the Shadow Demon Venerable flickered incessantly.
Then, in a hoarse voice, it said: "Wu Ling’Er..."
In the next moment.
The Shadow Demon Venerable suddenly raised the Trident in its hand.
Black lightning gathered again at the tip of the Trident.
At the same time, black energy spheres appeared in front of the other two Shadow Legends.
The Shadow Demon Venerable swung the Trident and pointed abruptly.
A terrifying black lightning, along with two energy spheres containing destruction aura, all fell down!

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 278: High-tier Legend, Heaven and Earth Destruction!
paragraphs: Wu Ling’Er’s expression changed dramatically.
She could feel how terrifyingly destructive these three attacks were!
Even the slightest aftershock could cause extremely serious damage to this Sky Island, even destroy it.
Wu Ling’Er took a deep breath.
Her delicate face, a bit pale due to the backlash from the Forbidden Technique, regained a touch of rosiness at this moment.
The next moment.
The blue Sea of Secret Patterns suddenly appeared.
She was going to use her Secret Pattern Domain to intercept all three attacks.
In a flash.
At the moment the blue Sea of Secret Patterns appeared, the attacks from the three Shadow Legends had crossed over ten thousand meters and were about to hit the Sky Island.
Then, they came into contact with Wu Ling’Er’s Secret Pattern Domain.
Buzz!
At that moment, terrifying energy exploded violently.
In an instant, everyone felt a blinding whiteness before them, losing all vision.
A wave of the feeling of impending death surged in.
The hairs on their bodies stood on end, as if a current was continuously running through them.
And this was the effect caused by the battle of Legendary Powerhouses.
It could be said, if not for Wu Ling’Er blocking all the impact.
The mere aftershocks of these few attacks would be enough to cause massive casualties among the personnel on Witch Race Sky Island.
However, the current situation is not optimistic either.
Wu Ling’Er’s blue Secret Pattern Domain, under the energy erosion of those three attacks.
At a speed visible to the naked eye, was rapidly shrinking.
In less than a second, the blue Sea of Secret Patterns had become very illusory, already on the verge of collapse.
But fortunately, she managed to block these three destructive attacks.
The price was blood trickling from the corner of Wu Ling’Er’s mouth, and her face turned pale as paper.
In the sky, a cold snort suddenly came.
"The current Saintess... seems to have overestimated herself."
"Daring to take our attacks head-on, how overconfident!"
"Prepare to die!"
Buzz!
A black bolt of lightning suddenly descended, piercing through Wu Ling’Er’s body, then landed in the Witch Race Sky Island below.
This attack was too fast, too fierce.
Even Wu Ling’Er didn’t have time to block it!
The next moment.
The entire Witch Race Sky Island experienced a strong tremor.
Rumble!
Earth-shattering.
After the earthquake-like sensation disappeared.
A gigantic crater with a diameter of over hundreds of thousands of meters and a depth of more than a million meters suddenly appeared where the black lightning struck!
And from the sky above, one could directly see the scene below the Sky Island.
With a casual strike, the entire Sky Island was directly pierced through!
At this moment, not only were the Witch Race soldiers horrified,
Even Han Xing frowned slightly.
Facing such a level of powerhouse, even if Han Xing used all his means, he wasn’t confident of confronting them head-to-head.
No, not even survive one move.
Only by relying on the transmission effect of the ’Oracle Throne’ could he barely keep his life.
However, before they could react.
They suddenly saw a graceful figure falling straight from the sky.
Like a bird with broken wings.
Below, the terrified shouts of the Witch Race soldiers rose.
"Saintess!
"Lady Saintess!"
Wu Ling’Er at this moment had forcibly endured a strike from the Shadow Demon Venerable and was severely injured, falling from the sky.
Before she could gather herself.
The three Shadow Legends in the sky were already closing in.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly coughed up a mouthful of fresh blood, a trace of panic appearing in her eyes.
This time, she miscalculated.
It wasn’t because of the backlash she suffered after using consecutive Forbidden Techniques.
She knew, even without using those two Forbidden Techniques, she wasn’t a match for these three Shadow Legends.
The next moment, a hint of determination flashed in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes.
She shouted loudly: "Citizens of the Witch Race, the situation is now at its most critical point."
"I will do my utmost to hold back these three Shadow Legends, buying time for you to escape, make an effort to flee to the territories of other Witch Clan Priests."
"No matter what happens, do not look back!"
All the Witch Race soldiers, including those Witch Race civilians, heard Wu Ling’Er’s words.
For a moment, everyone’s hearts sank.
They asked in disbelief: "Lady Saintess, what are you saying? You want us to leave first?"
"Are you implying you want to stay behind yourself?"
"Lady Saintess! We won’t leave, everyone believes in you, you can surely defeat the enemy! Just like before!"
"That’s right! Lady Saintess, we support you!"
In no time, countless voices shouted out, wanting to stay and fight to the end with Wu Ling’Er.
Wu Ling’Er felt a touch of emotion in her eyes.
But she also knew, these Witch Race soldiers and civilians staying would be of no use and would only add to the casualties!
At this moment, that Shadow Demon Venerable was already charging with a trident in hand!
In an instant.
Wu Ling’Er’s divine sense swiftly scanned over the tens of billions of spirits on the entire Sky Island.
Then, locked onto Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly received a system notification.
"For unknown reasons, you have obtained the highest access of the Witch Race’s Third Sky Island."
"Now, you can control all the buildings, defense towers, and other resources on this Sky Island."
Hearing this system notification, Han Xing was stunned.
What’s going on?
How did I suddenly gain the highest access?
Just then, Wu Ling’Er’s voice echoed in Han Xing’s ears.
"Han Xing, it’s Wu Ling’Er."
"The current situation is very bleak, the enemy this time is very strong, I am not confident I can handle them."
"You are my most trusted friend, now I am granting you all access to this Sky Island."
"Please control this Sky Island to leave as soon as possible, I will do my utmost to hold back these three Shadow Legends to buy you time to escape!"
"Thank you, Han Xing, and I hope you can help me one last time..."
Wu Ling’Er’s words carried urgency and plea.
Han Xing knew Wu Ling’Er couldn’t handle these three enemies.
But, he didn’t expect Wu Ling’Er to directly hand over the control rights of the Sky Island to him.
This meant, Wu Ling’Er had already resolved to die.
A moment later, Han Xing shook his head and said: "This woman, really likes making decisions on her own!"
"Telling us to run, and you go off to die, am I, Han Xing, that kind of person..."
Han Xing paused for a moment, he indeed seemed to be such a person.
But that was in situations dealing with outsiders.
Wu Ling’Er handed over the entire Sky Island to him.
In her heart, Han Xing was her friend, her most trusted person.
This trust, Han Xing naturally didn’t want to betray.
However, if they didn’t leave, it meant they would have to clash with the Legendary Powerhouses.

At this time, Han Xing looked at Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun beside him and said: "Brothers, Wu Ling’Er just handed me the Sky Island, telling me to lead you to escape, while she prepares to sacrifice herself."
"What do you think?"
Upon hearing this, everyone was slightly stunned.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was the first to say: "Damn, is this chick that fierce?"
Shen Yun beside him said: "Has the situation become this dire?"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also showed worried expressions.
However, not a single one of them suggested running away.
Han Xing nodded and said: "Yes."
"So, what do you all mean?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was the first to say: "Damn! Of course we should fight them!"
"Run? Run for what!"
"If Wu Ling’Er dies, it’ll be our turn soon!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun also nodded and said: "Xiaoyongzi is right, with the speed of the Legendary Powerhouses, even with the Sky Island, they can quickly catch up with us."
"Unless we leave these Witch Race people behind and escape alone."
But clearly, no one would make such a choice.
Including the two girls beside him, who also shook their heads.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed.
"You are right, with the Sky Island, we can’t escape."
"Leaving these Witch Race people behind, we can’t do that either."
"So, I’ve decided, let’s go head to head with the real Legends."
Upon hearing this, everyone looked serious.
Han Xing continued: "This time, our goal is to hold them off, maybe even take down those two Legends, to give Wu Ling’Er a chance to catch her breath."
"This is very dangerous! If anyone hesitates, you can back out now!"
No one answered, but through their actions, they made their stand clear!
