But she also knew, these Witch Race soldiers and civilians staying would be of no use and would only add to the casualties!
At this moment, that Shadow Demon Venerable was already charging with a trident in hand!
In an instant.
Wu Ling’Er’s divine sense swiftly scanned over the tens of billions of spirits on the entire Sky Island.
Then, locked onto Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly received a system notification.
"For unknown reasons, you have obtained the highest access of the Witch Race’s Third Sky Island."
"Now, you can control all the buildings, defense towers, and other resources on this Sky Island."
Hearing this system notification, Han Xing was stunned.
What’s going on?
How did I suddenly gain the highest access?
Just then, Wu Ling’Er’s voice echoed in Han Xing’s ears.
"Han Xing, it’s Wu Ling’Er."
"The current situation is very bleak, the enemy this time is very strong, I am not confident I can handle them."
"You are my most trusted friend, now I am granting you all access to this Sky Island."
"Please control this Sky Island to leave as soon as possible, I will do my utmost to hold back these three Shadow Legends to buy you time to escape!"
"Thank you, Han Xing, and I hope you can help me one last time..."
Wu Ling’Er’s words carried urgency and plea.
Han Xing knew Wu Ling’Er couldn’t handle these three enemies.
But, he didn’t expect Wu Ling’Er to directly hand over the control rights of the Sky Island to him.
This meant, Wu Ling’Er had already resolved to die.
A moment later, Han Xing shook his head and said: "This woman, really likes making decisions on her own!"
"Telling us to run, and you go off to die, am I, Han Xing, that kind of person..."
Han Xing paused for a moment, he indeed seemed to be such a person.
But that was in situations dealing with outsiders.
Wu Ling’Er handed over the entire Sky Island to him.
In her heart, Han Xing was her friend, her most trusted person.
This trust, Han Xing naturally didn’t want to betray.
However, if they didn’t leave, it meant they would have to clash with the Legendary Powerhouses.

At this time, Han Xing looked at Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun beside him and said: "Brothers, Wu Ling’Er just handed me the Sky Island, telling me to lead you to escape, while she prepares to sacrifice herself."
"What do you think?"
Upon hearing this, everyone was slightly stunned.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was the first to say: "Damn, is this chick that fierce?"
Shen Yun beside him said: "Has the situation become this dire?"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also showed worried expressions.
However, not a single one of them suggested running away.
Han Xing nodded and said: "Yes."
"So, what do you all mean?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong was the first to say: "Damn!
Of course we should fight them!"
"Run?
Run for what!"
"If Wu Ling’Er dies, it’ll be our turn soon!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun also nodded and said: "Xiaoyongzi is right, with the speed of the Legendary Powerhouses, even with the Sky Island, they can quickly catch up with us."
"Unless we leave these Witch Race people behind and escape alone."
But clearly, no one would make such a choice.
Including the two girls beside him, who also shook their heads.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed.
"You are right, with the Sky Island, we can’t escape."
"Leaving these Witch Race people behind, we can’t do that either."
"So, I’ve decided, let’s go head to head with the real Legends."
Upon hearing this, everyone looked serious.
Han Xing continued: "This time, our goal is to hold them off, maybe even take down those two Legends, to give Wu Ling’Er a chance to catch her breath."
"This is very dangerous!
If anyone hesitates, you can back out now!"
No one answered, but through their actions, they made their stand clear!

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 279: Give This World a Little Shock!
paragraphs: Angel’s Blessing!
Blessing of Honor!
Shen Yun directly cast two blessings, putting everyone instantly into combat state.
Han Xing said that this time they were going to face two legends, which was completely beyond everyone’s expectations.
If any other legendary powerhouses saw their actions, they would surely think these humans were crazy.
After all, they’re legends!
Facing a Fourth Transformation, they can almost crush them effortlessly!
And they not only overestimate their own capabilities to challenge a legend, but they’re challenging two at once.
This isn’t just madness, it’s suicide!
However, in the eyes of Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others, there was no fear.
Seeing the look in their eyes, Han Xing understood.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Let’s go, let’s give the legendary powerhouses of this world a little shock!"
Everyone else also laughed.
Then.
Han Xing directly controlled the Ten Thousand Stars City, soaring into the high sky.
At this moment.
Wu Ling’Er, who was battling the three Shadow Legends, suddenly sensed the breath coming from below.
A trace of panic instantly appeared in her eyes.
Even when fighting against three Shadow Legends, Wu Ling’Er hadn’t shown such an expression.
She urgently transmitted her voice.
"Han Xing! What are you doing?"
"Hurry up and leave! Don’t come over!"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone was very anxious.
However, the Sky Island below ignored her and continued to approach straight on.
Wu Ling’Er became more anxious.
She hurriedly said, "Han Xing, I know you are very strong now, even possessing legendary level combat power!"
"But this time, the enemies are beyond your imagination, you are not a true legend yet!"
"I appreciate you wanting to help me, but I don’t want you to court death!"
"Hurry and leave!"
Yet, Han Xing just shook his head and said, "Wu Ling’Er, why are you fussing like this?
"This doesn’t seem like your style."
While battling the three Shadow Legends, Wu Ling’Er slightly frowned.
She wanted to say something more, but heard the man below speak.
"Since I dared to come, it means I’m confident."
"Watch closely, you’ll witness the most shocking moment of your life next."
"I will kill a legend with Fourth Transformation power!"
"Breaking the so-called myth of the legend’s invincibility!"
In the sky.
The Shadow Demon Venerable also heard Han Xing’s arrogant words.
It wielded its trident and asked, "Wu Ling’Er, is this the helper you brought?"
"Quite arrogant, but the power is a bit too weak."
Beside him, the two Shadow Legends surrounding her also showed disdain in their eyes.
Wu Ling’Er glared and directly rebuked the Shadow Demon Venerable, "Shut up!"
Han Xing ignored the mocking gazes of these guys.
The next moment.
A magnificent throne suddenly appeared beneath Han Xing.
As he sat on the throne, a regal aura burst from his body, doubling his entire strength!
At this moment, Han Xing unexpectedly reached legendary level momentum once again.
At this time, the four legendary powerhouses fighting above felt their expressions freeze.
Even their movements slowed down a bit.
Sensing Han Xing’s aura, the Shadow Demon Venerable showed a smile full of interest and said, "Interesting, you actually touched this level of power."
"But, still too weak!"
Boom!
Taking advantage of Wu Ling’Er’s momentary distraction, the Shadow Demon Venerable swatted her away!
Hearing the mockery from the opponent.
Han Xing smiled with the corner of his mouth curled up.
Then.
He drew the bowstring.
The familiar opening move remained the same.
A strong tearing sensation came.
The sinister green pupils of the Shadow Demon Venerable gleamed with more interest.
"This move is somewhat interesting."
Han Xing laughed and said, "Next, there’s something even more interesting."
The next moment!
The arrow in his hand was released!
This arrow was extremely fast, and moreover, the Shadow Demon Venerable also wanted to test this human’s current power.
Therefore.
It didn’t dodge, and when the arrow came whizzing by, it slashed it down fiercely.
However, even with its speed, it failed to intercept.
Pouch!
The arrow instantly hit its heart position, producing a crisp "ding" sound.
This attack surprisingly caused a slight damage to it.
Even the Shadow Demon Venerable was a little surprised by this.
After all, even though the Shadow Legend’s combat power was weaker than other legendary powerhouses,
they had an advantage of being purely constructed from dark crystal stone.
Thus, their defense was a notch stronger than other legendary powerhouses.
Even for Wu Ling’Er, it wouldn’t be an easy task to harm it either.
Seeing the surprised expression of his opponent, Han Xing said, "What do you think? Want your two subordinates to play with us?"
"Otherwise, I’ll keep shooting arrows to disrupt you from the side."
Listening to this, killing intent erupted in the Shadow Demon Venerable’s eyes.
It indeed sensed a slight threat from Han Xing.
The Shadow Demon Venerable thought of teleporting over to directly kill these ants.
However, Wu Ling’Er’s tousled hair flew around her head.
She had already locked onto it with an intense aura.
The Shadow Demon Venerable knew that Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t allow it to advance further.
Fire flickered in the eyes of the Shadow Demon Venerable, then it nodded and said, "Fine, let them play with you."
Then, it pointed at the lion-headed monster and the Shadow Legend wielding the Crystal Greatsword and said, "Go, show these overconfident humans how powerful a true legendary powerhouse is!"
The two Shadow Legends listened and seemed to receive its command.
Then, they charged directly towards Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 279: Give This World a Little Shock!
paragraphs: Han Xing controlled Xingyu City, pulling away from Wu Ling’Er.
As they were about to part, Han Xing picked up the communication jade and said a few words to Wu Ling’Er.
The battlefield was divided on both sides.
The next moment.
A blue Sea of Secret Patterns blossomed again on Wu Ling’Er’s body.
She remembered Han Xing’s last words, which were to leave enough space and time for Han Xing to appear, as he intended to slay these two Legends!
Even though she did not know where Han Xing got this confidence.
A Fourth Transformation slaying a Legend was something that had never happened in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Yet, Wu Ling’Er couldn’t help but believe him.
Thus, Wu Ling’Er directly took the Shadow Demon Venerable and rapidly ascended to the sky.
The Shadow Demon Venerable was also glad.
It was worried that Wu Ling’Er might intervene to rescue those humans when they couldn’t hold up and were about to be slain.
At this moment.
In the air, only Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City was facing those two overwhelmingly imposing beings.
Feeling the intense killing intent from the other side.
Han Xing licked his lips.
This was their first time dealing with Legendary Powerhouses.
Moreover, they were up against two at once, truly a challenging ordeal.
However, the good news was that these two Shadow Legends had already been battered by Wu Ling’Er, reducing much of the burden on Han Xing and his team.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at Wu Ling’Er gradually fading into the sky.
Suddenly, he let out a hearty laugh.
"Haha! Hahahaha!"
The two Shadow Legends looked bewildered, seemingly unable to comprehend why this human was suddenly laughing.
They even thought he might have been scared silly.
However, Han Xing suddenly said, "I’m laughing at how foolish you are, actually agreeing to part the battlefield with me!"
"Now, let me see how that guy will save you!"
Yet, the two Legends took it as if they heard a joke.
This human wanted to separate the battlefield because he was worried about the Demon Venerable’s aid?
Utterly laughable!
However, Han Xing was speaking the truth.
From the beginning, he hadn’t taken these two Shadow Legends seriously!
With the current firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, it was sufficient to restrain a Legendary Powerhouse.
And the combined strength of their five members was enough to crush a Legend!
At this moment, Han Xing was ready to pay any price.
To deliver the most furious attack in the shortest time!
To slay these two Legends.
Han Xing shouted loudly, "Shen Yun, throw the Sun!"
"Everyone, unleash your full power!"
"Let’s finish them in a second!"
The moment Han Xing’s command was received.
Shen Yun immediately threw a Sun radiating Holy Radiance into the sky.
At the same time, the equipment effects on the five members were activated one after another.
Their aura surged rapidly in an instant.
The two Shadow Legends were horrified to find.
The five people in front of them had instantly ascended from Fourth Transformation to the aura of Legendary Level!
Shen Yun’s amplification effect was terrifyingly immense!
Two Blessings along with a Church Secret Technique—Holy Light Shines, directly more than doubled everyone’s attributes!
Additionally, they were all equipped with at least Golden Armor, with some wearing Orange Equipment, and even Orange Sets!
The effects above further amplified their strength in all aspects.
In this moment!
The strength of the five reached a monumental transformation!
Even the Shadow Demon Venerable battling Wu Ling’Er in high altitude sensed those five suddenly erupting Legendary auras.
It realized something unfathomable might be happening below.
Something peculiar...
As it attempted to rush over, Wu Ling’Er immediately intercepted it.
The Shadow Demon Venerable had a foreboding sensation.
The two Shadow Legends accompanying it also felt an imminent danger!
They foresaw that if the five continued to have their aura soaring,
They might genuinely face the threat of demise!
Thus.
The figures of two Legendary Powerhouses flashed.
They were about to rush toward the group!
And at this moment.
Su Xiaoyang suddenly raised the Valkyrie Longbow and shot an arrow with a green aura.
"Elf Secret Technique—Withered Life Vine!"

[Withered Life Vine]: Applies Withered Life Vine effect to all enemy creatures within a 1000*1000 meters area in front, reducing movement speed by 95%, loses life value equivalent to Survivor’s agility * 1.25 every second, lasting for 5 seconds.
The Withered Life Vine was a skill Su Xiaoyang learned after completing the Fourth Transformation, combining group burst + recovery + control.
Its effect was comprehensive, but previously Han Xing and others hadn’t encountered situations to deploy it as they were overwhelming the adversaries.
This Elf Secret Technique, when used against Legendary Powerhouses, had much-reduced life depletion effects.
But what Han Xing wanted was merely the 95% reduction in movement speed.
In essence, for five seconds, the two Shadow Legends were nearly incapacitated!
In the sky.
Two figures entirely wrapped in green vines suddenly appeared.
They struggled vigorously.
One green vine after another shattered but were immediately replaced by more vines sprouting from the void.
It seemed that this control effect wouldn’t last the full five seconds.
But even if it was only two seconds, it was more than enough.
Han Xing’s lips curved into a joyful smile as he shouted loudly.
"Brothers, finish them!"
With that.
Arrows capable of instantly killing Dominator Level creatures, coupled with terrifyingly lethal sword qi.
And meteorites with Heaven and Earth Destruction, all crashed down upon the two Shadow Legends.
Rumble! Rumble, rumble!
The terrifying energy fluctuations.
Were no less than Wu Ling’Er’s full-force attack!
However.
This was not the end!
The next moment.
All the Defense Towers, Hellfire Missile Silos, along with Demon Elephant War Chariots on Ten Thousand Stars City launched their attacks.
And the targets were still those two Legends.
Han Xing perfectly demonstrated the meaning of remaining still until movement signified Heaven and Earth Destruction-like attacks!
At the same time, the team’s assaults followed the Defense Towers’ attacks in unison.
In this moment.
An even more terrifying energy wave erupted suddenly!
The entire Witch Race Sky Island shook violently!
Its power was not inferior to when the Shadow Demon Venerable’s attack was unleashed!
Truly reaching the level of High-tier Legend!
Even the Shadow Demon Venerable, far away a million meters, felt a change in its expression!
"Damn! Those humans dared to trick me!"
"Pretending to be weak in front of me just to create the present situation!"
It realized and its killing intent fully boiled over!
To think the noble Shadow Demon Venerable was fooled by a mere human today!
However, Wu Ling’Er’s blue hair intervened once again!
The Shadow Demon Venerable swung its trident furiously, "Wu Ling’Er, get lost!"
"Otherwise, today I will definitely kill you!"
Wu Ling’Er replied with a cold laugh, "With just you?"
"If you have the ability, come and try!"
Wu Ling’Er stood unafraid.
She also sensed the commotion below.
Wu Ling’Er felt both shock and relief at the sudden burst from Han Xing and his team.
Previously, the Shadow Demon Venerable had tried its best to hinder Wu Ling’Er, fearing she would go to aid them.
But now, the situation seemed to have reversed.
"Damn it!" The Shadow Demon Venerable was almost exploding with rage!
In the lower battlefield.
The Witch Race officers looked dumbfounded at the scene in the sky.
Even from hundreds of thousands of meters away, they could see that thousands-meters-high flame!
The terrifying shockwave even swept into the Witch Race Main City.
The entire enormous sky island trembled a few times.
Until the commotion ceased.
The firelight disappeared.
Yet, no Shadow Legend’s figures remained at the original spot.
But Han Xing, however, was utterly certain that the two Shadow Legends were dead.
Because his ears had already heard the system notifications.
"Successfully killed Legendary Creatures: Shadow Sword Master, gaining 2.437 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power, All Attributes +100."
"Successfully killed Legendary Creatures: Shadow Lion King, gaining 2.164 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power, All Attributes +80."
After these two system notifications sounded, a white light suddenly rose from Han Xing’s body.
The massive Experience Value finally pushed his Level directly to 46.
At this moment, Han Xing’s attributes surged significantly!

Previously, the Shadow Demon Venerable had tried its best to hinder Wu Ling’Er, fearing she would go to aid them.
But now, the situation seemed to have reversed.
"Damn it!" The Shadow Demon Venerable was almost exploding with rage!
In the lower battlefield.
The Witch Race officers looked dumbfounded at the scene in the sky.
Even from hundreds of thousands of meters away, they could see that thousands-meters-high flame!
The terrifying shockwave even swept into the Witch Race Main City.
The entire enormous sky island trembled a few times.
Until the commotion ceased.
The firelight disappeared.
Yet, no Shadow Legend’s figures remained at the original spot.
But Han Xing, however, was utterly certain that the two Shadow Legends were dead.
Because his ears had already heard the system notifications.
"Successfully killed Legendary Creatures: Shadow Sword Master, gaining 2.437 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power, All Attributes +100."
"Successfully killed Legendary Creatures: Shadow Lion King, gaining 2.164 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power, All Attributes +80."
After these two system notifications sounded, a white light suddenly rose from Han Xing’s body.
The massive Experience Value finally pushed his Level directly to 46.
At this moment, Han Xing’s attributes surged significantly!

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - 280: First Kill Reward, Human Race Milestone Unlocked!
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Xing’s attributes skyrocketed significantly!
Not only from the upgrade boost.
But also the boost in all attributes after slaying these two Legends!
The divine power from the two Shadow Legends made his all attributes soar by 180!
A look of shock appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
He didn’t expect that slaying a Legend had such additional effects!
Killing a Legend provided more attribute boosts than leveling up twice!
Moreover, the key point is, this boost is extra!
In other words, even if you reach Level 50, the current level cap.
As long as you slay enough Legends, your basic attributes can continue to increase.
You might even rival Fifth Transformation powerhouses!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim in his heart, "Damn!"
"Does that mean if I kill a few more Legends during my Fourth Transformation, when I reach the Fifth Transformation, I’ll be invincible?"
This assumption is likely true.
Because, there is a terrifying transformation from Fourth to Fifth Transformation.
This transformation boosts according to your basic attributes.
In other words, the stronger you are during Fourth Transformation, the greater the boost when completing the Fifth Transformation!
Han Xing might indeed become an unprecedented, unmatched power.
Throughout the entire history of the Holy Spirit Realm, becoming the most powerful Legendary Powerhouse!
Just thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel excited!
Of course, achieving this goal is not that easy.
Even though Han Xing now has the power to slay Legends.
There aren’t that many Legends for him to slay in this world.
But, there’s more than one surprise.
At this time, the second system notification arrived.
"As the first Survivor in the server to slay a Legendary Creature, you receive a first kill reward: Dragon Ancestor Rune Blueprint (Orange) *1, additional attribute reward: Luck Value +10.
"Damn!"
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t hold back anymore and exclaimed aloud.
He almost forgot, previously when he first killed Leaders, Lords, Dominators, there were rewards.
Now, for the first kill of a Legend, naturally, there would be corresponding rewards.
Moreover, this time the reward seems quite impressive.
It’s actually an Orange Rune Blueprint and an additional ten Luck Points!
Even when he bound the Mask of the Golden Goddess, Han Xing only increased Luck by ten points.
The first kill reward can be said to be very generous.
The Orange Rune Blueprint doesn’t need much explanation.
The attributes enhanced by Golden Runes were already terrifying, and now there’s actually an Orange Rune.
One can imagine, this blueprint is absolutely extraordinary.
Before Han Xing could check the blueprint’s attributes.
The third system notification came.
And this notification echoed in the ears of billions of Survivors worldwide.
System Announcement: "Attention all Survivors, the first Survivor to slay a Legendary Creature has appeared in the server."
"The system has detected that the contemporary Human Race now has the power to survive in this world."
"All monster levels in the Land of the Abandoned Gods have been increased."
"Attention: New map in the Holy Spirit Realm, Witch Race Territory has been unlocked."
"Coordinates for the Path of the Giant Dragon have been unlocked, all Survivors can follow these coordinates to reach the Path of the Giant Dragon, leading to the Witch Race Territory."
"Achievement Unlocked: Human Race Milestone."
"After unlocking this milestone, all Survivors gain a 20% increase in Experience Value, 10% increase in Attack Power, effects are long-lasting..."
This system notification left everyone stunned.
The Human Race battling in the Land of the Abandoned Gods stood there dumbfounded.
Their brains seemed unable to process so much information, some couldn’t react.
The chat channel was buzzing at that moment.
"What did I just hear?"
"Slaying a Legend? Human Race Milestone?"
"And the Path of the Giant Dragon, can someone explain what all these are?"
"I don’t know sumida, I’m also completely confused."
At this moment, a few Survivors still in clear mind said: "Upstairs, didn’t you hear the system notification?"
"The first powerhouse to slay a Legendary Creature has appeared, we should now leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods and head to the outside world."
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t believe it.
"Damn, I just completed the Third Transformation! I can’t even beat the monsters in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, and you want me to go outside?"
"Yeah, this update even raised the monster levels there, making survival even tougher for me."
Other Survivors also expressed that it seemed a bit unrealistic.
Now, most Survivors are just at the Third Transformation, with only a small elite completing the Fourth Transformation.
And inside the Land of the Abandoned Gods, there are many Fourth Transformation monsters, including some Fifth Transformation ordinary creatures.
Although not at the Legendary Level, they are much stronger than Fourth Transformation monsters.
With the current overall strength of the Human Race, they are far from being able to adapt to the outside world.
However, because Han Xing outpaced them so much.
Most Survivors were just getting through the initial stages, while he was already clashing head-on with this world’s Legendary Powerhouses,
The impact of slaying a Legend is just too significant.
Even Han Xing didn’t know it would affect all of humanity.
At this moment, another Survivor said in the chat channel: "Well, the system only said a new map is open, it didn’t say we must go."
"If you want to continue developing in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, no one will stop you."
"The person above is right, we don’t even know what the Path of the Giant Dragon is or what’s inside, let alone the high-level map Witch Race Territory."

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 280: First Kill Reward, Human Race Milestone Unlocked!
paragraphs: "Yes, yes."
The other survivors echoed in agreement.
The turbulence in the chat channel gradually calmed down.
After all, going to the Witch Race Territory now is an extremely difficult task for most survivors.
First off, just the Path of the Giant Dragon alone would stop ninety-nine percent of people.
The key item, the Ancient Fire, is not so easy to obtain.
Moreover, even if you meet the above conditions, you still have to abandon your territory to safely pass the Path of the Giant Dragon.
This equates to redeveloping in the Witch Race Territory.
Not everyone can be like Han Xing, possessing the strength to make a comeback in a short time.
Thus, Han Xing’s progress has increasingly outpaced these survivors.
At this moment.
Boundless, who just cleared the 40th floor of the Abyssal Rift, was in a dazed state after hearing the system prompt.
Before he could react, Zhou Huang had already sent a message over.
Zhou Huang: "Boundless, did you see the system prompt?"
Boundless slowly replied: "I saw it. Someone has already slain a Legendary Level creature, meaning they must possess Fifth Transformation combat power at the very least."
Zhou Huang: "That’s right, and the opening of this new map reveals another piece of information.
"Which is—this person had already left the Land of the Abandoned Gods, long before us!"
"After all, we all know that in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, Legendary Creatures do not appear."
Upon hearing this, Boundless was aghast, as he hadn’t considered that possibility.
However, linking it to the system’s prompt, Zhou Huang’s deduction is likely correct.
Boundless tried to calm the shock in his heart, then sighed and said, "I didn’t expect this guy, who hadn’t shown up for months—I thought he was hiding in some corner quietly developing."
"Turns out, he was out there roaming free."
A sigh also came from Zhou Huang on the other side.
The two of them didn’t name the person, but they both knew who it was.
Because there’s no need to guess.
Now, among global survivors, only one person can achieve this.
Star River.
A moment later, Zhou Huang said, "The reason I reached out to you this time, you should understand."
"We need to carefully discuss the matters of alliance and then move forward on the new map together."
Hearing this, Boundless looked a bit hesitant.
Recently, Xingyu City’s development in the Land of the Abandoned Gods has been thriving.
Every day, Xingyu City’s size is visibly expanding, and more and more survivors are signing contracts with Xingyu City.
Moreover, as the newly built shops and other businesses gradually open.
Now, the flow of people in Xingyu City has reached a staggering number.
Every day, it brings huge profits to Han Xing.
This profit is making Zhou Huang and Boundless and other major faction leaders extremely envious.
But they can’t do anything about it.
After all, in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, no force can compete with Xingyu City, which is a recognized fact.
Previously, Zhou Huang and other major teams tried to open their territories, hoping to attract some survivors over.
Because it was several major teams working together, the announcements were quite extensive.
For a few days, they did manage to divert a lot of traffic.
However, with Han Xing putting the ’Destruction Rune’ on sale at Xingyu City’s shops.
This powerful rune made many survivors instantly envious.
In a moment, it attracted nearly half of the global survivors to hue and cry in Xingyu City.
So Zhou Huang and his companions completely lost their competitive edge.
Thus, Zhou Huang had long thought about future developments.
Zhou Huang seized the opportunity and said, "Boundless, you can see it, too."
"Within the Land of the Abandoned Gods, we can’t compete with Xingyu City.
"He had a much earlier start than us, and the resources he possesses are beyond our imagination."
"Now, the only thing we can do is to be the first to open a city in the new map to realize a reverse surpassing."
Upon hearing this, Boundless slowly replied, "I understand, give me some time to think about it, and I’ll get back to you as soon as possible."
The call was ended by both sides.
The scene shifts back to the Witch Race Territory.
After Han Xing killed two Shadow Legends, suddenly a furious roar was heard from the sky.
"Damn! Human, how dare you play me!"
Buzz!
The sky instantly filled with dark clouds.
Within those clouds, black lightning flashed, as if the entire sky was raging!
Crack... Crackle...
Under this mighty force, billions of Witch Race civilians felt waves of panic.
Including Han Xing’s five-member team, who also felt a sense of being locked onto overhead.
And at this moment.
A sequence of blue Secret Patterns inscribed with Witch Race characters suddenly appeared in the cloudy sky.
Wu Ling’Er’s Sea of Secret Patterns dispersed all the black clouds in the sky directly.
At this moment, a furious voice was heard again.
"Wu Ling’Er! You’re courting death!"
"No matter, today I’ll take you out first, then eliminate those humans, and slaughter your entire race!"
The voice carried immense murderous intent,
And those it targeted seemed to sense an impending calamity.
This is a special ability of high-tier Legends.
Every word and every thought can severely affect ordinary beings.
It’s not a case of words being law.
But rather another kind of profound influence.
In other words, it’s fate.
A single thought from a high-tier Legend can, in the unseen, influence the destiny of these ordinary beings.
Now, the Shadow Demon Venerable wants to kill everyone here.
So they are now all trapped in the fear of impending death.
The Shadow Demon Venerable was furious beyond measure, every strike was with full force!
Buzz!
The Trident collided with the Sea of Secret Patterns.
Wu Ling’Er was immediately sent flying backwards!
At this moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable’s killing intent towards Han Xing was even more intense than towards Wu Ling’Er.
It actually abandoned Wu Ling’Er and charged swiftly towards Han Xing.
At this moment, all the beings on Ten Thousand Stars City, including Han Xing, felt a sense of impending death crisis.
In their eyes, there seemed to appear an illusion.
The Shadow Demon Venerable wielding a black Trident shattered Ten Thousand Stars City in one blow.
All the structures crumbled in an instant, a million Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs were shattered into bits!
Including Han Xing’s five-member team, all were killed in an instant by the Shadow Demon Venerable’s strike!
Especially Han Xing, his corpse was lifted high in the sky by the Shadow Demon Venerable.
His eyes still conveyed an unwillingness to die peacefully.
The next moment.
With a cold snort, Han Xing abruptly snapped out of the illusion.
"Stop pretending with your tricks!"
"Wake up, all of you!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s voice, millions of beings in Ten Thousand Stars City snapped awake abruptly.
Then, they looked with lingering fear at the swiftly approaching Shadow Demon Venerable.
At this moment.
The Shadow Demon Venerable showed a slightly entertained expression at the corner of its mouth.
"Interesting... that you managed to so quickly free yourself from my influence."
"However, this isn’t an illusion; it’s something that’s bound to happen next!"
Han Xing drew a longbow, unfazed by the Shadow Demon Venerable’s words.
Even if this guy is a high-tier Legend.
Han Xing was already prepared to fight with everything he had.
Just then.
Wu Ling’Er’s blue Sea of Secret Patterns once again pushed back the dark clouds in the sky.
To prevent the Shadow Demon Venerable from attacking Han Xing, Wu Ling’Er even risked using a Forbidden Technique once more.
At the moment of the clash.
Wu Ling’Er was violently blown back several kilometers.
The Shadow Demon Venerable only slightly faltered.
The Shadow Demon Venerable, now seething with anger, exclaimed, "Wu Ling’Er! You’re courting death with your stubbornness!"
"Fine, today I will destroy you first, then finish off those humans, and annihilate your entire race!"
Its tone was filled with overwhelming killing intent,
Inevitable doom seemed to loom over the targets of its enmity.
This is a special ability of a high-tier legend.
Everything they say, every thought they have, can profoundly affect ordinary creatures.
It’s not as simple as words becoming law.
Rather, it’s a deep and subtle influence.
In other words, it determines fate.
Just one thought from a high-tier legend towards these ordinary beings can, in an unseen way, influence their destinies.
Now, the Shadow Demon Venerable intends to kill everyone here.
The panic was palpable as they faced imminent death.
Yet at this crucial moment.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly summoned a series of blue Secret Patterns inscribed in Witch Race script into the sky filled with dark clouds, dispersing them entirely.
At this, the furious voice boomed once more.
"Wu Ling’Er! You’re seeking death!"
"Very well then, today you will be the first to go, and then I’ll eliminate those humans and annihilate your entire race!"
Its tone was filled with overwhelming murderous intent,
those on the receiving end of its hostility seemed to feel an impending doom.
This is the special ability of a high-tier Legend.
Their every word, every thought, can have a profound and severe impact on ordinary beings.
It’s not as simple as speaking and having the words become law.
It’s a deeper kind of influence.
In other words, it dictates destiny.
When a high-tier Legend like the Shadow Demon Venerable directs their killing intent at someone, it’s as though a great calamity is about to befall them.
The Shadow Demon Venerable was now raging immensely, each attack brimming with murderous intent.
It directly abandoned Wu Ling’Er and charged at Han Xing with great speed.
At this moment, all the beings above Ten Thousand Stars City, including Han Xing, felt enveloped by a sense of impending doom.
In this moment, it seemed as if the entire Ten Thousand Stars City was at the brink of total collapse from one blow by the Shadow Demon Venerable’s Trident.
All structures were instantly reduced to rubble, a million Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs were crushed to pulp!
Particularly Han Xing’s lifeless body, raised high by the Shadow Demon Venerable,
Han Xing’s voice echoed, snapping everyone back to reality.
"Enough with your tricks!"
At Han Xing’s call, a wave of relief washed over the millions in Ten Thousand Stars City.

Now, the Shadow Demon Venerable intends to kill everyone here.
The panic was palpable as they faced imminent death.
Yet at this crucial moment.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly summoned a series of blue Secret Patterns inscribed in Witch Race script into the sky filled with dark clouds, dispersing them entirely.
At this, the furious voice boomed once more.
"Wu Ling’Er!
You’re seeking death!"
"Very well then, today you will be the first to go, and then I’ll eliminate those humans and annihilate your entire race!"
Its tone was filled with overwhelming murderous intent,
those on the receiving end of its hostility seemed to feel an impending doom.
This is the special ability of a high-tier Legend.
Their every word, every thought, can have a profound and severe impact on ordinary beings.
It’s not as simple as speaking and having the words become law.
It’s a deeper kind of influence.
In other words, it dictates destiny.
When a high-tier Legend like the Shadow Demon Venerable directs their killing intent at someone, it’s as though a great calamity is about to befall them.
The Shadow Demon Venerable was now raging immensely, each attack brimming with murderous intent.
It directly abandoned Wu Ling’Er and charged at Han Xing with great speed.
At this moment, all the beings above Ten Thousand Stars City, including Han Xing, felt enveloped by a sense of impending doom.
In this moment, it seemed as if the entire Ten Thousand Stars City was at the brink of total collapse from one blow by the Shadow Demon Venerable’s Trident.
All structures were instantly reduced to rubble, a million Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs were crushed to pulp!
Particularly Han Xing’s lifeless body, raised high by the Shadow Demon Venerable,
Han Xing’s voice echoed, snapping everyone back to reality.
"Enough with your tricks!"
At Han Xing’s call, a wave of relief washed over the millions in Ten Thousand Stars City.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - 281: At All Costs, Slay the Demon Venerable!
paragraphs: "Wu Ling’Er, you have no chance of winning!" Shadow Demon Venerable threatened.
Wu Ling’Er paid no attention.
Both sides clashed once more.
Hiss... Hiss hiss...
Black lightning erupted across the entire sky.
The blue Sea of Secret Patterns of Wu Ling’Er had already been compressed to a size of three meters around her body.
The impact of a high-tier legend battle was truly immense.
Wu Ling’Er fought against the Demon Venerable while also preventing Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City from being affected.
She was restrained in every way.
The Demon Venerable’s trident swung several times, hitting Wu Ling’Er’s body and drawing droplets of blood.
Gradually, Wu Ling’Er’s injuries became more severe.
At that moment.
Wu Ling’Er took a brief moment, frantically signaling with her eyes for Han Xing to leave.
However, Han Xing acted as if he hadn’t noticed, continuously watching their battle.
Especially, Han Xing kept his gaze fixed on the Shadow Demon Venerable.
He seemed to be analyzing its strength and methods.
Seeing Wu Ling’Er once again sent flying and preparing to charge in recklessly,.
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a sudden understanding.
He called out to Wu Ling’Er.
"Wu Ling’Er, come back, I have a way to take it down!"
"What?" Wu Ling’Er paused her charge, her eyes filled with confusion.
Han Xing repeated, "I said, I have a way to take this guy down, but we need to join forces."
The Shadow Demon Venerable in the sky seemed to hear the biggest joke.
"Human, you really are unbearably arrogant. You think that by slaying those two heavily injured and useless legends, you’re qualified to challenge me?"
"Even if you team up with Wu Ling’Er, not even the High Priest of the Witch Race would dare claim to kill me!"
"If you don’t believe me, ask Wu Ling’Er."
Wu Ling’Er did not respond, nor did she even glance at the Shadow Demon Venerable.
She only gazed deeply at Han Xing, at that man.
The Shadow Demon Venerable felt slighted as it was ignored.
"Today, let me show you how overconfident you really are!"
Han Xing did not speak, but instead responded with action.
He slowly pulled back the bowstring.
A bright moon suddenly appeared behind the Shadow Demon Venerable.
The moment that bright moon appeared, the expression of the Shadow Demon Venerable changed slightly.
It said in uncertain surprise, "Imprisonment... Power of Rules?"
"Why does this move feel so familiar?"
The Shadow Demon Venerable instinctively sensed something amiss.
It admitted to underestimating this human, who could manipulate the Power of Rules to attack it.
Even as a high-tier legend, the Shadow Demon Venerable dared not claim to be able to resist the Power of Rules.
The next moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable’s figure vanished from its original spot.
Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
This was the first target in Sky Island Paradise that remained mobile after he selected it for his legendary skill—Broken Moon.
However.
It must be said, Broken Moon lived up to its reputation as the signature skill of the Fifth Generation Wild Ranger.
Even if the Shadow Demon Venerable relocated,
the bright moon behind it kept on condensing.
The Shadow Demon Venerable also noticed the situation behind it, and its heart skipped a beat.
It irritably said, "Troublesome!"
"The Power of Rules is really tricky to deal with. If this continues, this force might completely take shape."
The Shadow Demon Venerable began to release energy to resist.
However, what it feared still happened.
Because.
The bright moon behind had already completely formed!
At the moment it was about to be immobilized, rapid thoughts flashed through the Shadow Demon Venerable’s mind.
"Is it a rule power that immobilizes?"
"In that case, it means that within a few seconds, I might not be able to move."
"Very well, let you witness the formidable defensive power of the Shadow Race!"
The surface of the Shadow Demon Venerable’s body was suddenly covered by a thick layer of shadow crystal.
Its eyes kept burning with a ghastly green flame.
It didn’t seem panicked by its immobilization.
Because it believed the layer of shadow crystal on its body could withstand the attack.
And at that moment.
Han Xing said, "Attack!"
In that instant.
Without Han Xing needing to say more.
The blue secret pattern in Wu Ling’Er’s hand instantly solidified, turning into a sphere containing destructive aura, which was hurled fiercely at the Shadow Demon Venerable.
At the same time.
The burst skills of Han Xing and five others were unleashed without reserve!
And that wasn’t all.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s fifty Demon Elephant War Chariots, plus five hundred Hellfire Launchers, and over ten thousand Defense Towers, all aimed in the same direction.
Compared to when they previously annihilated the two Shadow Legends in an instant,
this time the focused firepower was even more lethal, even more terrifying!
The space where the Shadow Demon Venerable was located showed streaks of fractures.
The terrifying energy rampaged continuously, as if even space was about to shatter!
Once the smoke cleared.
The control duration of Shattered Moon had passed two seconds.
Han Xing focused his gaze.
Immediately, he saw the surface of the pristine white moon covered in cracks.
And at the center of the full moon,
the thick layer of black crystal on the Shadow Demon Venerable’s body had already shattered.
It itself seemed to have suffered extremely serious injuries!
But ultimately, the Shadow Demon Venerable held on.
The Shadow Demon Venerable’s face showed a victorious smile.
It could feel that it was about to break free.
At that moment, Han Xing’s Shattered Moon skill entered cooldown, leaving no more ways to restrain it!
Wu Ling’Er seemed to have noticed this as well.
In the next moment, she knew that this was the opportunity Han Xing had painstakingly created.
Before the full moon shattered, the Shadow Demon Venerable had to be slain.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly let out a soft exclamation.
"Witch Clan Forbidden Technique—Thunder Purgatory!"

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - 281: At All Costs, Slay the Demon Venerable! (2)
paragraphs: As Wu Ling’Er finished speaking, all the blue secret patterns on her body gathered into her petite palm.
There, compressed, were countless forces of secret patterns capable of instantly killing a Four-star Lord.
At this moment, they all smashed onto the body of the Shadow Demon Venerable.
Buzz!
The area was once again covered by violent energy.
With a few crisp cracking sounds.
The space was completely shattered!
In the sky, suddenly large gaps appeared.
Like a mirror breaking with cracks.
Yet, those gaps were a complete pitch black.
Out of which continuously released chaotic, destructive power.
The place where the Shadow Demon Venerable was standing was already mixed with so many types of energy that it couldn’t be observed with the naked eye.
Only legendary powerhouses could see inside the situation.
Han Xing closed his eyes.
With his divine sense, he saw that the Shadow Demon Venerable had already been seriously injured by Wu Ling’Er’s grand move!
All over its body, constructed seemingly of black crystals, it already had dense cracks, seemingly about to shatter.
However, this guy was truly a high-tier legend.
After being targeted by numerous attacks that could instantly kill even initial or middle-tier legends.
It somehow managed to endure.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er’s face was extremely pale.
Today, she had already released countless forbidden techniques.
The powerful backlash had already rendered Wu Ling’Er completely powerless to fight.
For other Witch Race powerhouses, forbidden techniques were named so precisely because of their taboos and obvious side effects.
Ordinary legendary powerhouses would fall into a long period of weakness after releasing just one forbidden technique.
Yet Wu Ling’Er had released at least seven or eight forbidden techniques today.
To be able to persist up to this point was already extraordinary.
Han Xing also knew that in this state, Wu Ling’Er could not be relied upon.
Now, he could only rely on himself.
Han Xing pulled out a golden mask from his backpack and put it on directly.
His voice came through the mask.
"Damn it, high-tier legends are really hard to kill!"
"But at this point, no matter what, I’m going to take you down today!"
Beside him, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s expressions turned serious.
They knew that Han Xing was going all out!
With those words.
Han Xing directly activated the third effect on the Goddess Mask.
[Eye of the Divine]: After activating the Eye of the Divine effect, the survivor’s critical strike rate increases by 100%, and critical strike damage increases by 150%.
Each attack reduces the target’s armor by 10%, up to a maximum of 50%.
In the backpack, a hundred Philosopher’s Stones disappeared.
In exchange, Han Xing received a ten-second window of terrifying damage increase!
Now, there was just one second left until the Shattered Moon’s duration ended.
In one second, for powerhouses of their level, a lot could be accomplished.
And Han Xing was no different.
When he drew the bowstring once more.
An unusual power gathered on it.
Although it also contained intense power of rules.
But compared to the gentleness and confinement of the Shattered Moon.
This power seemed explosive and deadly!
At the same time.
The Shadow Demon Venerable, about to break free, suddenly felt a blazing large sun appear behind him.
From this large sun, it felt a threat no less than Wu Ling’Er’s forbidden technique!
Even more terrifying than Wu Ling’Er’s forbidden technique!
At this moment, it was already heavily injured.
If it were to endure another attack of the same magnitude, it would undoubtedly die.
Its eyes finally revealed a hint of disbelief.
The Shadow Demon Venerable never thought it would encounter a life-threatening situation in the Witch Race Territory!
Even when fighting a true high-tier legend, it would take tremendous effort to defeat the opponent.
Yet now, it felt a life-threatening danger from an ant not even at the fifth transformation!
At this point, aside from disbelief, the Shadow Demon Venerable’s heart was finally panicked!
However, like others trapped by the Shattered Moon Skill.
Once controlled by the Shattered Moon, all action abilities were lost.
The Shadow Demon Venerable couldn’t even speak.
And Han Xing, had already shot the arrow in his hand.
[Ultimate Skill - Sunfall Arrow]: A demigod-level skill, gathering the solar power floating in the world, shooting out an arrow of destruction, causing horrific explosive damage to the enemy.

Against enemies below demigod level, ignores all defenses to deal full damage, and permanently reduces hit enemy’s life value by 20%, with a damage coefficient of 5000%, damage range: agility * 100 meters.

Note: This skill is a demigod-level skill, with extremely severe side effects when used by those below demigod level. Each use permanently reduces all attributes by 100 and induces a day-long weakened state.
Yes, this skill was one of the relics left to Han Xing by the Hunter.
A terrifyingly powerful ultimate skill!
Previously, Han Xing had not used it because the skill had severe side effects.
Not only would the attributes be permanently reduced, but it would also induce a day-long weakened state.
At that time, he would be nearly combat ineffective.
But now, to take down this high-tier legend.
Han Xing had to use his greatest trump card!
Crack!
With a clear cracking sound.
Everyone saw that the burning, terrifying flaming large sun.
At this moment, began to crack.
From those cracks erupted countless forces of pure yang and destruction, pouring out simultaneously.
The already riddled space, at this moment, completely shattered!
In that area, a bottomless black hole emerged.
The violent energy battered the Shadow Demon Venerable’s body.
Its already cracked body was overwhelmed!
Moreover, Han Xing discovered.
The collapse of the large sun triggered a chain reaction with the Shattered Moon Skill.
The control time of Shattered Moon had not yet completely ended.
Yet, at this moment, it exploded together with the large sun!
Boom!
A 5000% damage coefficient, a 1500% damage coefficient!
Coupled with numerous special effects activated on Han Xing, including two divine-level effects.
And the support of his companions.
Han Xing believed.
This would be the strongest attack he had ever unleashed!
An area ten million miles in all directions lost its color in an instant under this blow.
The flying shadow monsters, as if swept by an invisible force, fell down from the sky.
Billion lives felt a doomsday-like sensation!
At the same time.
At the moment when the sun and moon simultaneously shattered.
A desperate roar from the Shadow Demon Venerable echoed from within.
However, its fate was sealed the moment it was trapped by the Shattered Moon Skill.
At that moment, the Shadow Demon Venerable could have easily used its means to teleport away.
However, it was too arrogant.
It also feared that after it fled, it wouldn’t find Wu Ling’Er and others upon its return.
So, it chose to withstand Han Xing’s skill.
Yet, the Shadow Demon Venerable completely underestimated Han Xing’s explosive power.
And this led to the death of a high-tier legend.
As the Shadow Demon Venerable’s life faded.
Phenomena seemed to occur in the sky.
Dark clouds gathered, with lightning and thunder.
A system prompt rang in Han Xing’s ears.
"Successfully slain Shadow Demon Venerable: High-tier Legend, gained 2.467 billion experience points, automatically absorbing divine power from the opponent, all attributes +500."
"Due to your outstanding performance, you have received an additional reward: a contaminated Divine Fragment of the Shadow God."
At this moment, Han Xing felt two different sensations on his body.
One was the surge in physical prowess after slaying the Shadow Demon Venerable and gaining +500 in all attributes.
One was the waves of weakness brought on by the dreadful side effects after using the ultimate skill.
Han Xing checked his physical state.
[State]: Divine Power Backlash (All attributes reduced by 90%), remaining time 24 hours...
In other words, for the entire next day, Han Xing would be nearly combat ineffective.
And the moment the Shadow Demon Venerable died.
Below, on the Witch Race Sky Island, billions of Witch Race Soldiers stared dumbfounded into the sky.
Though they didn’t know what had happened above.
Since the Shadow Demon Venerable issued a death cry, a shadow had enveloped the soldiers’ hearts.
And now, that shadow was directly dispelled.
There was no need to guess; the Shadow Demon Venerable was dead.
In an instant, billions of Witch Race civilians and soldiers erupted into deafening shouts!

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 282: Victory and Its Price
paragraphs: "We won! We won!"
"Lady Saintess has won!"
"Saintess, invincible!"
Countless Witch Race soldiers shouted loudly, and the morale on the entire battlefield skyrocketed.
They didn’t know that the one who finally slew the Shadow Demon Venerable was Han Xing.
But these things no longer mattered.
They only knew that in this war, they had emerged victorious.
The Witch Race warriors’ attacks became more fierce.
In contrast, the Shadow Legion, already heavily hit by Han Xing, was no longer a threat.
Now, they were being defeated, retreating at every turn.
These Witch Race soldiers thought Wu Ling’er had dealt with the Shadow Demon Venerable.
But as one who witnessed it all, Wu Ling’er.
Since the appearance of that great sun, her eyes had never left Han Xing.
In his weakened state, Han Xing suddenly received a system notification.
"Due to your actions, you have moved the Witch Race Saintess, Wu Ling’er’s Affinity has increased, current affinity 91 (Admiration)"
Hearing this system notification, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
He didn’t expect that resolving the situation with Wu Ling’er this time would suddenly add so much affinity.
Directly reaching a new level...
Only, that note made Han Xing feel rather odd.
Why did it feel like he was playing some kind of dating simulation game...
Now at 91 points, it had reached the level of admiration.
If it reached 100, what would that become?
Could it be possible to push her down directly?
Thinking of this, Han Xing couldn’t help but glance at Wu Ling’er.
That petite figure, exquisite body, combined with an exceptionally beautiful face, carried a touch of coolness.
Although, Wu Ling’er was already several hundred years old, she still looked like a teenager.
Like a divine spirit girl walking out of a manga.
Thinking of this, Han Xing quickly interrupted his own train of thought.
In the air, Wu Ling’er seemed to have also sensed Han Xing’s gaze.
Then, she directly flashed to Ten Thousand Stars City.
Wu Ling’er looked at Han Xing, took a deep breath and said, "Han Xing... I don’t know what to say..."
"But this time, you have far exceeded my expectations."
"Do you know, you have already broken the conventions of this world, even in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s never been someone like you!"
"However, regardless, this time it was you who saved me and saved tens of billions of lives of the Witch Race."
"I sincerely thank you for your rescue."
Wu Ling’er bowed deeply.
Han Xing coughed twice and quickly interrupted.
"Alright, alright, didn’t I say we’re friends? No need to be so polite."
Hearing Han Xing’s words, Wu Ling’er showed a happy smile and nodded solemnly.
"Mm-hmm, we are friends!"
Han Xing nodded: "So, no need for formalities, let’s first handle the shadow monsters below."
Wu Ling’er sweetly smiled, "Okay, I’ll follow your lead."
Hearing this, not only Han Xing but also the other four were instantly stunned.
In their impression, Wu Ling’er was a very strong, very kingly woman.
But now, she showed such a little womanly side in front of Han Xing.
Not only did she take Han Xing’s advice, but the admiration in her eyes was almost undeniable.
Behind, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang looked at Wu Ling’er and then at Han Xing.
Their expressions were a bit peculiar, but they didn’t say much.
Then.
Han Xing began to command Ten Thousand Stars City, launching a wanton bombardment.
Although he couldn’t exert his power now, the Defense Towers on Ten Thousand Stars City were still operable.
A dozen minutes later.
The Shadow Mist shrouding the Witch Race Sky Island completely dissipated.
And this also meant that the crisis on Wu Ling’er’s side was completely resolved.
Half an hour later.
The vast battlefield on the immense Sky Island was in chaos everywhere.
Just a few minutes after the war ended, all the Witch Race officers received the same order.
At this moment.
Inside the Royal Palace of the main city.
A woman with a cold face, exuding an aura that seemed to demand attention, sat on the main seat.
Below, there were hundreds of Witch Race officers.
The strength of these officers was at least Four-star Leader Level, with most possessing Lord-level strength.
Including that Commander Kathy.
They were reporting the casualties of this war one after another.
However, the more Wu Ling’er listened, the more her brows furrowed.
As of now.
Under Wu Ling’er’s command, nearly ten million ordinary soldiers had been lost.
Among them, more than a hundred thousand elite warriors like squad leaders and captains had died.
Even Leader-level figures with lord-level strength, almost twenty had died.
However, this wasn’t the biggest loss.
This time, most of the deaths were among the civilians who were caught in it.
According to the current statistics, the number of civilian deaths had exceeded two hundred million...
This was a heavy number.
In such a large-scale war, those civilians had no means of resistance.
However, Wu Ling’er also knew that the battle losses on her Sky Island were considered fortunate.
If Han Xing hadn’t arrived in time, the casualty rate would have been even higher, with the possibility of total annihilation.
Thinking of this, Wu Ling’er’s gaze passed through the congregation of officers in the council hall and looked towards Han Xing, sitting at the side.
At the same time, the gazes of those Witch Race officers followed Wu Ling’er’s, looking towards Han Xing and the others.
Wu Ling’er stood up directly and said: "In this war, as you know, my few friends from the Human Race have been indispensable."
"If it weren’t for them, among the people present, there would probably be few who could still be standing here alive."

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 282: Victory and Its Price
paragraphs: A group of Witch Race officers, upon hearing this, understood Wu Ling’Er’s intention.
They all stood up and bowed towards Han Xing and the others, saying,
"Thank you, brave warriors of the Human Race, the Witch Race extends to you our highest respect."
They bowed deeply to express their gratitude.
Han Xing and the others were not surprised by this.
The Witch Race was known for their straightforwardness; they directly express gratitude without hesitation to those who have helped them.
After all, this time, the contributions of Han Xing and his team were truly significant.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"Due to your outstanding performance in this war, achieving remarkable victories, the entire affinity with the Witch Race has increased by +3248..."
"Current affinity: 9072 (Respect)"
Hearing the system notification, a look of surprise instantly appeared on Han Xing’s face.
What the hell?
An increase of so much affinity at once?
It’s already over nine thousand!
Only a little over nine hundred left to reach ten thousand.
Han Xing was shocked internally.
However, upon reflection, it made sense.
After all, this time, they almost saved the entire Witch Race Main City, nearly a hundred billion Witch Race people.
It was not surprising that they gained so much affinity.
Moreover, as the affinity increased, Han Xing felt that the Witch Race officers’ gazes towards him became noticeably softer.
Among them, Han Xing also noticed a Witch Race woman sitting next to Wu Ling’Er among the officers.
She was staring at him with a very fervent gaze.
The curiosity and admiration in her eyes were almost unhidden.
At this moment, another system notification sounded in Han Xing’s ear.
"Due to your performance, you have impressed the Legion Commander of the Witch Race’s Third Corps: Kathy, unlocking character affinity."
"Current affinity: 71 (Close Friend)"
Han Xing: "???
Han Xing was full of questions.
He hadn’t even interacted with this woman, how did the character affinity suddenly unlock?
Moreover, it skyrocketed to over 70!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel suspicious.
If it weren’t for Wu Ling’Er being here, this Witch Race woman, wearing an officer’s uniform with a curvy figure, might have pounced directly on him.
However, what he didn’t know was.
This Witch Race woman was indeed Kathy, who previously served as the war commander.
Because of her decision, a group of Witch Race officers was trapped in the encirclement by the Lord and Dominator.
At that time, her heart was filled with guilt and fear.
And just then, Han Xing appeared.
She witnessed firsthand that man single-handedly slaying a group of Dominators.
Reversing the situation that was about to collapse instantaneously!
If it weren’t for him, Kathy would have been the culprit of this war.
So, although Han Xing did not know Kathy, Kathy had long regarded Han Xing as her lifesaver.
Beside them, Wu Ling’Er also noticed Kathy’s fervent gaze.
However, she merely glanced at Kathy indifferently.
Kathy immediately seemed to be hit by a thunderbolt and quickly lowered her head.
Observing the exchange of glances between the two women, including Han Xing, the Witch Race officers around had expressions of slight peculiarity.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er spoke again, "Although the crisis in our Third Main City has been resolved, the entire Witch Race Territory is still engulfed in flames of war."
"Next, pass on my orders!"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone suddenly turned serious.
In the hall, all the Witch Race officers assumed a serious demeanor, staring intently at Wu Ling’Er,
"Our Third Main City will immediately dispatch all Ancient Weapons and Witch Pattern Battleships to support other main cities."
"And send over seventy percent of the forces to assist the nearby small Sky Islands."
Upon hearing Wu Ling’Er’s decision, the officers were somewhat surprised.
After all, they had just fought a tough war and did not know if the Shadow Legion would return to attack their Sky Island again.
Sending out so much forces and Ancient Weapons now.
The defense of the main city would be quite weak.
Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice their concern and said directly, "I will be here to oversee things, so rest assured and proceed."
Hearing this, the officers immediately straightened up.
With Wu Ling’Er here, she alone was worth a thousand troops!
"As you command!"
All the officers saluted in response simultaneously.
Then.
Over a hundred Witch Race officers, including Commander Kathy, filed out of the conference hall.
They were about to execute Wu Ling’Er’s orders.
Soon.
Only Wu Ling’Er, Han Xing, and four others remained in the entire council hall.
Wu Ling’Er’s earlier serious expression was gone, replaced by a gentle smile.
"Next, I will stay here."
"Han Xing, you seem to be in a weakened state, would you mind staying by my side until you recover?"
Hearing Wu Ling’Er’s inquisitive tone, Han Xing also had a slightly peculiar expression.
However, he did need some time to recover, and having a Legendary Powerhouse next to him meant safety was ensured.
So, Han Xing nodded and said, "That’s fine, thank you."
Wu Ling’Er smiled genuinely and said, "No trouble."
"What else you need, just let me know, and I’ll have someone bring it over.
Han Xing was about to say he didn’t need anything, but Wu Ling’Er already stood up from the throne.
"Oh, I have some Snow-top Red Shadow from the Elf Realm, a highly precious tea leaf."
"I read in the history books that your Human Race likes drinking tea, so let me brew some for you."
Without waiting for Han Xing to refuse, Wu Ling’Er moved with quick steps to brew tea for everyone.
Soon.
Wu Ling’Er returned with a tray, placing five steaming cups of tea.
Han Xing also understood that this was Wu Ling’Er’s way of thanking everyone.
So, he did not refuse further and casually picked up a tea cup.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun did the same.
Upon holding it, Han Xing immediately felt a refreshing aroma, tempting him with its fragrance.
Everyone drank it all, then praised, "Good tea!"
Seeing their enjoyment.
Wu Ling’Er’s face lit up with a happy smile.
Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Right, you mentioned that this tea was transported from the Elf Realm, do you also trade with the Elf Realm?"
Wu Ling’Er smiled and said, "Of course."
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, any significant force will choose to open up trade with the outside world."
"Especially those major clans, each has its own unique resources."

"For example, the Secret Elixir of our Witch Race, the magical plants of the Elf Race, the forging technology and Ancient Weapons of the Dwarf Race, the abundant mineral resources of the Giant Race, and so on..."
"During times of peace, these major clans will trade with one another."
"However... with growing chaos, such transactions have become rare now."
After listening, everyone seemed to be deep in thought.
Wu Ling’Er continued to ask, "Is there anything else you would like to know?"
Everyone exchanged glances.
Han Xing seemed to remember something.
"Not exactly something to know, but I do have a request."
Wu Ling’Er turned her beautiful eyes towards Han Xing, staring directly at him.
Her gaze was so passionate that it made Han Xing feel a little uneasy.
However, Han Xing still took out a small, fingertip-sized black crystal from his backpack, and asked.
"You’ve seen this thing, right?"
Gazing at the item in Han Xing’s hand, Wu Ling’Er nodded lightly, "Yes, of course, I’ve seen it."
"This item is dropped from those Shadow Monsters, we call it Shadow Crystal."
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a look of realization.
It seems everyone calls this thing the same, which makes things much easier.
Han Xing said directly, "What I want to ask is if you can tell your people to give me the Shadow Crystals dropped by monsters in this war."
This time, Han Xing used the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, almost wiping out nearly ten billion monsters, and collected over a hundred million Shadow Crystals.
But he hadn’t forgotten that the number of monsters on this Sky Island was far greater than just that.
If he could collect all those crystals, Han Xing’s gain would be enormous!

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 283: The Deal with Wu Ling’Er and Returning to the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Xing immediately added, "Of course, I won’t let you suffer a loss. I will give you some compensation."
Seeing the appearance of the item in Han Xing’s hand.
Wu Ling’Er asked, "Do you need this type of crystal?"
"Yes, I need a lot of it."
Han Xing confessed, as there was no need to be secretive about this matter.
Ling’Er slightly nodded her head, "We usually only add a little of this Shadow Crystal when refining some special secret elixirs."
"It’s not very useful, so people generally are too lazy to collect it."
"I can inform the people below to send over all such crystals when they clean up the battlefield."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s face instantly lit up with joy, "Thank you so much!"
Ling’Er gave a faint smile, "No need to thank me, it’s a small effort."
She spoke very casually.
Although she said this, Han Xing still took out a purple backpack and threw it directly to Ling’Er.
Seeing the appearance of this backpack, Ling’Er immediately felt a sense of familiarity.
Last time when they parted, Han Xing gave her two similar items, which were blue space backpacks.
They had a larger capacity than her space ring.
Now, Ling’Er had already removed the ring from her hand and started using the space backpack to store things.
This time, the beast hide backpack Han Xing took out appeared even more exquisite in appearance.
When Ling’Er tentatively received it, the confusion in her eyes immediately turned to shock.
"Is this... a new space backpack?"
"I feel that inside, it holds an extremely dense power of space!"
Ling’Er spoke in a tone of shock, "Even more so, the power of space is several times more condensed than the backpack you gave me last time!"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, this is a more advanced space backpack."
"And I have many more on hand."
Upon hearing this sentence.
It was as if she had heard something terrifying, and her aura surged!
From within her body, several blue secret patterns rapidly unfolded, enveloping the entire Royal City!
After confirming no one nearby had overheard.
Ling’Er once again acted, casting several secret patterns to completely seal the council chamber.
Only after doing all this did Ling’Er breathe a sigh of relief.
Then, she approached Han Xing with an apologetic look, saying, "Sorry, this matter is too significant."
"If others heard about it, it would have a huge impact."
Han Xing nodded to show his understanding.
At this point, Ling’Er cautiously reconfirmed, "Are you saying, you still have many of these backpacks filled with dense power of space?"
Han Xing nodded in response, "Yes, I had someone bring out a batch from the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
He casually gave an excuse.
Although she already knew the answer, Ling’Er’s heart couldn’t help but feel surprised.
"Han Xing, what do you mean by now?" Ling’Er tentatively asked.
Han Xing replied, "It’s similar to what you guessed."
"The reason I brought up this matter with you is to discuss trading a large quantity of these backpacks with your race."
"You should know, I need a lot of high-level ores, and if possible, it would be best to establish a long-term trading channel."
Han Xing spoke very clearly, and Ling’Er understood his meaning.
After pondering for a moment, Ling’Er reconfirmed, "Han Xing, you must understand the preciousness of these backpacks."
"This matter is of great significance. Although I can promise you on behalf of the Witch Race."
"But, are you sure you’ve thought through the potential consequences?"
Han Xing knew what consequences Ling’Er was referring to.
That is, it might attract the covetous gaze or even pursuit of other legendary powerhouses.
However.
The reason Han Xing had hidden for two months before approaching Ling’Er about this matter was because he was worried about this.
Now, he had already proven that he possessed the ability to contend with and even go head-to-head with legendary powerhouses.
Han Xing nodded in acknowledgment.
Seeing this, Ling’Er no longer said anything and replied, "Alright, I agree to this matter."
"Shall we start trading now?"
Han Xing shook his head, "No, there’s no rush yet."
"At least let this Shadow Legion invasion storm pass, and then I’ll come find you to discuss the relevant matters in detail."
Ling’Er nodded in agreement, "Alright, whenever you have time, you can come find me."
After the exchange in the council chamber concluded, Ling’Er immediately issued an order to gather all the shadow crystals across the entire Sky Island and send them to the Royal Palace.
Even those Witch Race officers who had gone out to provide aid in various places received this directive.
After dealing with the Shadow Fangs, they were to collect all the shadow crystals and then send them back.
This surprised them a bit.
After all, before this, almost no one wanted these crystals. After every war ended, they would only collect a part of it haphazardly and discard the rest.
However, since it was the Saintess’s command, they chose to comply.
Standing behind Ling’Er, Han Xing could hardly contain his joy.
This was equivalent to having millions of Witch Race warriors helping him collect Shadow Crystals, significantly increasing efficiency compared to before.
Originally, the one hundred billion shadow crystals needed to exchange for that high-tier ancient weapon no longer seemed so out of reach.
The rest of the day, Han Xing and the others stayed with Ling’Er.
Meanwhile, Ling’Er continued to receive battle reports from various places.
Seeing her furrowed brow, everyone knew that the situation in the Witch Race Territory was certainly not optimistic.
After all, even Ling’Er almost lost her life this time. If not for Han Xing, the fall of this Sky Island would have been a certainty.

Wu Ling’Er asked, "Do you need this type of crystal?"
"Yes, I need a lot of it."
Han Xing confessed, as there was no need to be secretive about this matter.
Ling’Er slightly nodded her head, "We usually only add a little of this Shadow Crystal when refining some special secret elixirs."
"It’s not very useful, so people generally are too lazy to collect it."
"I can inform the people below to send over all such crystals when they clean up the battlefield."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s face instantly lit up with joy, "Thank you so much!"

She spoke very casually.
Although she said this, Han Xing still took out a purple backpack and threw it directly to Ling’Er.
Seeing the appearance of this backpack, Ling’Er immediately felt a sense of familiarity.
Last time when they parted, Han Xing gave her two similar items, which were blue space backpacks.
They had a larger capacity than her space ring.
Now, Ling’Er had already removed the ring from her hand and started using the space backpack to store things.
