chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 283: The Deal with Wu Ling’Er and Reentering the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: Therefore, the situation in other Sky Islands must be quite dire.
Indeed, that is the case.
So far, the entire Witch Race, a total of seven border defense lines and seventeen Witch Race Sky Islands, have all been engulfed in the flames of war.
Except for Wu Ling’Er, who ended the battle early.
The other Sky Islands are still struggling to hold on.
However.
With the aid from Wu Ling’Er’s side, the situation is bound to improve.
After all, as long as one Witch Race Sky Island can lend a hand elsewhere, it will spark a chain reaction.
Rescuing more Witch Race powerhouses and then rushing to other areas for assistance.
The war raged on for nearly a day and a night...
The next day.
The large-scale invasion of the Shadow Army finally came to an end.
But, the Witch Race paid a heavy price.
The heaviest losses were at the fourteenth and eleventh main islands of the Witch Race.
These two main islands have been completely conquered and directly destroyed.
All the Witch Race soldiers above, including those Witch Race civilians, were all tragically slaughtered under the claws of the Shadow Army.
And with other large and small Sky Islands being overrun.
Yesterday alone, the Witch Race lost at least ten billion civilians, plus billions of elite Witch Race soldiers.
Among them, even three Legendary Powerhouses fell.
For the entire Witch Race, this will be a day of tremendous significance in history.
Even after thousands or even tens of thousands of years, they will never forget this day.
From Wu Ling’Er’s reaction, it was clear, this was a sea of blood and deep hatred!
She stood barefoot, her entire body trembling uncontrollably.
Everyone could sense the anger that Wu Ling’Er was suppressing with great effort.
However, there was no other choice.
After all, with the war going on so long, the Shadow Army and the Witch Race are now at an irreconcilable state.
Moreover, there’s even worse news now.
That is, one of the seven border defense lines of the Witch Race, led by Commander Korden, has been completely breached.
In other words.
The shadow monsters can invade the Witch Race Territory from that area at any time.
The war could reignite at any moment.
The Witch Race is now hastily mobilizing forces to eliminate the border defense for support.
Though this has nothing to do with Han Xing.
But, when Han Xing heard that the Shadow Army might once again charge into the Witch Race Territory at any time.
He felt a renewed sense of urgency in his heart.
At this moment.
Han Xing was in the room arranged by Wu Ling’Er, frowning.
He thought that with his Legendary Level power, he could easily roam the Witch Race Territory.
But now, he realized that there’s a disparity in strength even among Legends.
Moreover, the gap between High-tier Legends and low-tier Legends is astonishingly large.
This time, if Wu Ling’Er wasn’t by his side.
Even if Han Xing gave his all, he might not have been able to take down the Shadow Demon Venerable.
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh: "My strength is still lacking. At this stage, just one High-tier Legend can destroy Ten Thousand Stars City."
"However, fortunately, I still have plenty of room for improvement!"
"I am currently at level 46, if I can reach level 50 and overhaul my equipment, my strength can at least double!"
And to level up quickly, Han Xing now had a plan.
That is, to head to the Abyssal Rift!
Previously, they stopped at the 49th layer because they weren’t confident about challenging the 50th layer, so they put it on hold.
But now, everyone’s abilities have undergone a qualitative leap!
Han Xing even had a faint premonition.
This time, he might reach the 60th layer directly!
Thinking of this, Han Xing gathered his team.
After explaining the upcoming plan, everyone unanimously agreed.
Then, inside the Royal Palace.
They crushed the Stronger’s Mark together.
The system prompt appeared: "Abyssal Rift transportation is open, please select the layer to enter this time, you can choose any layer from 1 to 49."
They had already farmed the set equipment for the earlier layers, and re-challenging them wouldn’t yield much benefit.
Thus, Han Xing directly chose the 49th layer to challenge.
"Selection successful, commencing transportation..."
As usual, Han Xing first placed the Coal Ball into the Pet Space, and a black mist enveloped everyone.
Then, the five of them vanished from the spot.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er, who was overseeing in the Royal Palace, suddenly sensed their disappearance and slightly furrowed her brows.
What was certain was that there were no other Legendary Powerhouses nearby.
Yet, Han Xing and his group disappeared under her perception, this method was beyond Wu Ling’Er’s understanding.
At this moment, she took out the Communication Jade and saw Han Xing’s message to her.
Wu Ling’Er’s lips gradually revealed a relaxed smile.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and the others’ view restored.
Then, they appeared in a familiar place.
The 49th layer of the Abyssal Rift.
The battle started quickly.
Just like before, the monsters here were between level 44 and 45, posing no threat to them now.
Two or three minutes later, the monsters were almost cleared by them, and a familiar figure appeared.
The Fear Wanderer.
A level 45 Lord.
A month ago, the team had to be well-prepared and even put in some effort to deal with this Lord.
But in just a month, they had defeated almost a hundred four-star Lords.
They didn’t pose any threat to them at all.
After a round of focused attacks, the Fear Wanderer was smashed to pieces without even casting a skill.
The system notification appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 49th layer of the Abyssal Rift, this battle took 17 minutes and 32 seconds...]
[The passage to the 50th layer of the Abyssal Rift has opened, the Brave Squad must decide whether to continue the challenge or exit...]
The mist passage of the fiftieth layer appeared.
This time, they chose to step into the passage without hesitation.
"The challenge of the 50th layer of the Abyssal Rift is about to begin..."
As they entered the misty area of the 50th layer, an extremely large combat space appeared before them.
It was about the size of ten school playgrounds.
However, unlike the flat grounds of the previous 49 layers,
the battle area in the middle of the 50th layer had several uneven hills about ten meters high.
Besides those hills, the low whispering from the mist also made the entire space feel very oppressive.
The pace of battle in the Abyssal Rift is very fast.
Before they could observe the area properly, the battle had already started.
With the sound of breaking soil, more and more monsters crawled out of the ground.
More monsters also emerged from the mist.
Most of them were still Abyssal Demon Eyes, Skeleton Generals, and Resentful Spirits.
The difference was that every Abyssal monster here was above level 46.
Compared to level 45 monsters, level 46 was another watershed.
The ordinary monsters here were much stronger than those on the lower levels.
However, for Han Xing and the others now, whether they were level 45 or 46, it didn’t matter.
Even for ordinary fifth transformation monsters, Han Xing and the others could easily crush them.
With the buff from Shen Yun.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball began clearing the field.
Three minutes later.
The monsters on this layer were all killed by them.
It seemed because they killed too quickly.
No new monsters appeared, causing the 50th layer to suddenly fall into silence.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "What’s the situation? No more monsters already?"
"I haven’t even satisfied my urge to fight yet!"
He held up the Golden Battle Spear, eager for action.
Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "Why the rush, the final boss of the 50th layer hasn’t appeared yet, you’ll have your fight."
As soon as he finished speaking.
They suddenly felt a strong tremor from beneath their feet!
This tremor quickly swept through the 50th layer’s battle space.
Not only that, it spread out of the space, into the mist.
Rumble!
As time passed, the tremor became even more intense, as if the entire mist was shaking!
Everyone gripped their weapons tightly, fully prepared!
At that moment, they suddenly saw the small hills in front of them rise another ten meters!
Another blink, and those hills had already reached hundreds of meters high.
Then they saw that beneath those hills, was a vast area of bone.
As the bones fully emerged.
A gigantic head of a monster, without a trace of flesh, appeared before them.
The next moment, on both sides of that monster head, deep in the eye sockets, two red flames ignited.
At the same time, a strong sense of suffocation came over them.
Their eyes finally saw clearly the appearance of this creature.
It was a dragon.
An Undead Bone Dragon!

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 284: Why Aren’t You Playing by the Rules?
paragraphs: That was a colossal bone dragon, with not a trace of flesh or hair on its body!
Whoosh—Whoosh—
In a place unseen by everyone.
The wings on either side of this monster flapped, generating fierce gusts of wind that swept continuously.
Just one of its heads was nearly a thousand meters in size.
One could imagine just how enormous the monster’s full body was.
A panel of this monster appeared before them.
[Demon Dragon Grindel: Four-star Dominator Level Creatures]
[Level]: lv46
[Attributes]: Power 5024, Agility 5235, Spirit 5944, Spirit 5442.
[Skills]: Abyssal Breath, Bone Blade Hurricane, Immortal Bone, Soul-locking Purgatory (Legendary Skills)

"Note: Grindel was a legendary abyssal demon dragon before death, and still possesses a portion of Legendary Power after death, making it more dangerous and powerful than the average Dominator. Survivors, please proceed with caution."
A trace of astonishment appeared in everyone’s eyes.
This was their first time encountering a monster with a system special note indicating danger, that also possesses a portion of Legendary Power.
No wonder Han Xing previously felt that the monsters on the 50th floor were extraordinary.
Now, it indeed seems quite remarkable.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"The final challenge of the 50th layer of the Abyssal Rift has begun, with four stages in the final challenge."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s head: 0/1."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s left wing: 0/1."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s right wing: 0/1."
"Progress in slaying Demon Dragon Grindel: 0/1."
Everyone was surprised again.
This was their first time encountering a boss divided into four stages.
However, considering the opponent’s massive size, it made sense.
Yet, despite the grand appearance of this monster, its strength was somewhat lacking for the current group.
The battle commenced instantly.
Han Xing’s team shot an arrow first, taking the initiative.
With a crisp sound, the arrow pierced through the gigantic head of the bone dragon.
"Roar!"
The bone dragon, in pain, let out a long howl into the sky, a terrifying dragon roar echoing throughout the Mist Space.
Han Xing quipped, "What are you screaming about?"
This was just a casual arrow he shot, without even using skills, nor summoning the Oracle Throne.
Yet the bone dragon screamed as if it were being slaughtered.
At this time, the bone dragon seemed to realize that its reaction was too big.
It quickly shut its mouth.
But really, it was because Han Xing’s Attack Power was too formidable.
With just one arrow, it almost knocked off its skull cap; who the hell could withstand that?
Bone Dragon Grindel’s eyes showed a sense of embarrassment and anger, glaring furiously at Han Xing.
However, its angry gaze was still ignored by Han Xing.
When this demon dragon opened its gigantic mouth to launch an attack, Han Xing made a hand signal.
Everyone understood, and a barrage of attacks flew towards the bone dragon’s head.
Large Fireballs exploded on its gigantic head, shattering bones into pieces.
Cheng Jianyong’s Golden Spear Qi targeted the deep eye socket of the demon dragon.
With a plop sound, it pierced through its head again, dimming the red light in its eyes.
"Roar! Roar!"
The attack the bone dragon was brewing was interrupted, causing it to howl in pain under the terrifying attacks of the crowd.
After just one round, the bone dragon’s head endured severe damage.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s head has been completed; the next stage will now begin..."
The bone dragon, ready to take off from the ground, saw Han Xing react quickly, shooting a ’Gale·Break.’
"Don’t let this guy fly!" Han Xing shouted.
Upon hearing this, everyone threw various Burst Skills en masse.
The bone dragon suddenly fell from the sky like a kite with a broken string.
When the bone dragon landed, it was stunned.
Darn it!
This wasn’t how it was supposed to go!
Weren’t you supposed to first repel my head, then I’d fight you with other parts?
Finally, entering into the final battle?
However, what it didn’t know was, Han Xing and his team were so strong they completely bypassed this phase.
With just one burst, the bone dragon was nearly down to critical health; what was the point of going through the one-two-three phases?
After all, the final goal was to take down this bone dragon.
As long as the goal was achieved, there was no need to follow the system’s procedure.
The bone dragon was bewildered but quickly reacted.
Because by this time, the attacks from those humans threatened to come once again, the sense of crisis enveloped its entire body.
Being well aware of how terrifying these humans were, the bone dragon immediately prepared a killer move.
In its mouth, dragon language appeared.
Translated by the system, it was:
"The great Grindel will imprison you eternally in purgatory!"
As the words fell.
Dark mist brought the sound of chains dragging.
Clang clang...
The next moment!
The group felt as if thousands and thousands of gusts were coming from above.
Before they could react, they suddenly saw one massive chain above, as thick as an elephant’s leg, rust-covered.
These chains, carrying a rush of ten thousand jins, covered the entire 50th layer!
This was the legendary skill of the bone dragon, the Soul-locking Purgatory!
Bang! Bang bang bang bang!
A full-screen area attack, if it were a month ago for Han Xing and the others, would have left them overwhelmed.
With one slip-up, there could even be casualties.
At this time, Han Xing felt somewhat grateful.
Thankfully, he had held on and waited for a while.
Otherwise, a month ago, while they also had a chance to clear the level, the risk was too high.
Compared to turning the tide against all odds, Han Xing preferred to crush the opponent completely.

"The final challenge of the 50th layer of the Abyssal Rift has begun, with four stages in the final challenge."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s head: 0/1."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s left wing: 0/1."
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s right wing: 0/1."
"Progress in slaying Demon Dragon Grindel: 0/1."
Everyone was surprised again.
This was their first time encountering a boss divided into four stages.
However, considering the opponent’s massive size, it made sense.
Yet, despite the grand appearance of this monster, its strength was somewhat lacking for the current group.
The battle commenced instantly.
Han Xing’s team shot an arrow first, taking the initiative.
With a crisp sound, the arrow pierced through the gigantic head of the bone dragon.
"Roar!"
The bone dragon, in pain, let out a long howl into the sky, a terrifying dragon roar echoing throughout the Mist Space.
Han Xing quipped, "What are you screaming about?"
This was just a casual arrow he shot, without even using skills, nor summoning the Oracle Throne.
Yet the bone dragon screamed as if it were being slaughtered.
At this time, the bone dragon seemed to realize that its reaction was too big.
It quickly shut its mouth.
But really, it was because Han Xing’s Attack Power was too formidable.
With just one arrow, it almost knocked off its skull cap; who the hell could withstand that?
Bone Dragon Grindel’s eyes showed a sense of embarrassment and anger, glaring furiously at Han Xing.
However, its angry gaze was still ignored by Han Xing.
When this demon dragon opened its gigantic mouth to launch an attack, Han Xing made a hand signal.
Everyone understood, and a barrage of attacks flew towards the bone dragon’s head.
Large Fireballs exploded on its gigantic head, shattering bones into pieces.
Cheng Jianyong’s Golden Spear Qi targeted the deep eye socket of the demon dragon.
With a plop sound, it pierced through its head again, dimming the red light in its eyes.
"Roar!
Roar!"
The attack the bone dragon was brewing was interrupted, causing it to howl in pain under the terrifying attacks of the crowd.
After just one round, the bone dragon’s head endured severe damage.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Progress in repelling the demon dragon’s head has been completed; the next stage will now begin..."
The bone dragon, ready to take off from the ground, saw Han Xing react quickly, shooting a ’Gale·Break.’
"Don’t let this guy fly!" Han Xing shouted.
Upon hearing this, everyone threw various Burst Skills en masse.
The bone dragon suddenly fell from the sky like a kite with a broken string.
When the bone dragon landed, it was stunned.
Darn it!
This wasn’t how it was supposed to go!
Weren’t you supposed to first repel my head, then I’d fight you with other parts?
Finally, entering into the final battle?
However, what it didn’t know was, Han Xing and his team were so strong they completely bypassed this phase.
With just one burst, the bone dragon was nearly down to critical health; what was the point of going through the one-two-three phases?
After all, the final goal was to take down this bone dragon.
As long as the goal was achieved, there was no need to follow the system’s procedure.
The bone dragon was bewildered but quickly reacted.
Because by this time, the attacks from those humans threatened to come once again, the sense of crisis enveloped its entire body.
Being well aware of how terrifying these humans were, the bone dragon immediately prepared a killer move.
In its mouth, dragon language appeared.
Translated by the system, it was:
"The great Grindel will imprison you eternally in purgatory!"
As the words fell.
Dark mist brought the sound of chains dragging.
Clang clang...
The next moment!
The group felt as if thousands and thousands of gusts were coming from above.
Before they could react, they suddenly saw one massive chain above, as thick as an elephant’s leg, rust-covered.
These chains, carrying a rush of ten thousand jins, covered the entire 50th layer!
This was the legendary skill of the bone dragon, the Soul-locking Purgatory!
Bang!
Bang bang bang bang!
A full-screen area attack, if it were a month ago for Han Xing and the others, would have left them overwhelmed.
With one slip-up, there could even be casualties.
At this time, Han Xing felt somewhat grateful.
Thankfully, he had held on and waited for a while.
Otherwise, a month ago, while they also had a chance to clear the level, the risk was too high.
Compared to turning the tide against all odds, Han Xing preferred to crush the opponent completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 284: Why Aren’t You Playing by the Rules?
paragraphs: For example, right now.
As the bone dragon’s full-screen attack descended, Shen Yun had already raised his shield high.
Then, with a burst of soil-yellow light illuminating, everyone was shielded by Shen Yun.
Bang! Bang bang bang!
A series of loud booms, like waves crashing against rocks, echoed.
Shen Yun stood like a steadfast reef, effortlessly resisting the storm-like attack.
When the commotion disappeared.
In front of everyone, appeared at least hundreds of thousands of rusty iron chains.
Dense, filling the entire space of the 50th floor.
At this moment.
The bone dragon also saw the five unharmed individuals.
Its prideful legendary level burst yielded no effect,
At this moment, Grindel nearly had his heart shattered.
It uttered a hoarse voice, questioning: "Human race, why?"
"You clearly only have the aura of the fourth transformation, yet the strength you exhibit is more terrifying than an ordinary legend?"
Everyone exchanged smiles but didn’t respond.
As Zhang Lianmeng’s meteor technique smashed down.
The colossal body of the bone dragon collapsed thunderously.
Boom!
System prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 50th floor of the Abyssal Rift, the battle duration was 4 minutes and 51 seconds...]
[Since you are the first team to clear the Abyssal Rift, receive first-clear rewards Abyssal Magic Stones * 100000, Heroic Spirit * 100, "Cemetery" Blueprint * 1.]
Upon hearing the prompt, joy appeared on Han Xing’s face.
Indeed, the first-clear rewards after passing the 50th floor are very good.
Those hundred thousand Abyssal Magic Stones may not mean much to him.
But those 100 Heroic Spirits are equivalent to ten Demon Elephant War Chariots.
However, these are secondary; the main reward is naturally the system’s blueprint.
Han Xing eagerly checked the attributes.

[Abyss Technology: Cemetery Blueprint]: Can construct a cemetery in the territory, where abyss-exclusive monsters can hatch, upgrade technology to expand cemetery area and increase the probability of hatching high-tier abyssal monsters.
Note: In the cemetery, there is an extremely low probability to summon some special abyssal monsters.
After reading the blueprint’s attributes, Han Xing showed a contemplative expression.
"Yet another blueprint similar to summons?"
"However, this time the summons are abyssal monsters."
"And this summoning method is quite strange, even coming out from a graveyard."
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Of course, this also fits the style of Abyss Technology.
"Also, what does that note about the extremely low probability of summoning some special abyssal monsters mean?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing couldn’t figure out the specific meaning, so he decided to put it aside.
"Forget it, once we leave, building a cemetery will reveal everything."
Han Xing put away the blueprint.
Then, Han Xing walked to the place where the bone dragon had died.
A cluster of red ghost fire floated above.
And below the ghost fire, there was also a tool resembling skeletal construction.
It looked like a breastplate?
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He first extended his hand to collect the cluster of red flames.
System prompt appeared.
"Obtained dim dragon spirit * 1,"
Dragon Spirit?
Han Xing was startled again.
This is, an item belonging to the same series as the Dragon Spirit?
Damn!
He hadn’t forgotten that a key material needed for forging the human race exclusive holy artifact, the Sun Crown Stele, was the Dragon Spirit.
However, what was needed was a legendary level Dragon Spirit.
The one in front of him was obviously several levels lower.
However, this was not the most important.
The most important part is that since there’s a dim dragon spirit appearing here.
It indicates that there must be a legendary level Dragon Spirit somewhere in the Abyssal Rift!
For now, it’s just because Han Xing hasn’t reached the challenge level needed!
Previously, Han Xing had no clue regarding the last material for the Sun Crown Stele.
He even thought that the Dragon Spirit might need to be found along the Path of the Giant Dragon.
But obviously, this is unrealistic.
Along the Path of the Giant Dragon, the lowest aura is the legendary level of dragons.
For Han Xing to ask for the Dragon Spirit there would be tantamount to declaring war with this group of dragons.
So, until now, Han Xing hadn’t found any other means to obtain the Dragon Spirit.
And now, finally a clue!
For a moment, Han Xing felt hope for the upcoming Abyssal Rift journey!
Because, out of the five materials required to forge the Sun Crown Stele, there were already clues and ideas for the first four.
The next step is just to find a legendary level Dragon Spirit, then he can start preparing to build this overwhelmingly powerful holy artifact.
Once constructed, the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City will instantly undergo a qualitative transformation.
Then, replace the High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint.
By then, the Shadow Legend, Shadow Demon Venerable, shall all be obliterated by him!
Tsk tsk!
Just thinking about it makes Han Xing feel hopeful for the future.
At this point, Han Xing, with expectations in mind, picked up the breastplate from the ground.
"Obtained Thousand-Spine Breastplate (Orange) * 1."
Before Han Xing appeared the attributes of the breastplate.
[Thousand-Spine Breastplate (Orange) lv46, Quality - Legend, Armor: 412~434, Power +350, Constitution +300, Evasion Rate +15%.]
[Attached Effect]: Demon Dragon’s Protection (Physical damage reduction 15%), Skeleton Spike (Reflects 20% damage received from ranged attacks, CD 5 seconds), Thousand Blades (Legendary Effect).
[Note: Thousand Ridge Set 1/6, can combine with Thousand Ridge Bone Boots, Thousand Ridge Bracelet, Thousand Ridge Pants, Thousand Ridge Necklace, Thousand Ridge Helmet for set effect.]
[Three-piece set attribute: All attributes increase 25%, Six-piece set attribute: Attack Power increases 20%, physical damage increases by an additional 20%.]
[Once the six-piece set is complete, activates ’Bone Dragon Grindel’ set function, Soul-locking Purgatory!]

[Soul-locking Purgatory]: Upon activating this set effect, each attack has a 30% probability of summoning a soul-locking chain, causing impact damage to the enemy, and putting the enemy into a brief state of paralysis.
Having seen its attributes, Han Xing’s eyes showed a hint of surprise.
He shouted towards the distance at Cheng Jianyong: "Cheng Jianyong, come over here, got your equipment!"
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was cleaning the battlefield and upon hearing these words, his eyes lit up.
He directly activated his acceleration state, his figure flashed, and appeared beside Han Xing.
He then eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, what equipment is it? Let me see quickly!"
Han Xing chuckled softly and then tossed the Thousand-Spine Breastplate he was holding to him.
Cheng Jianyong looked at it with anticipation, and then exclaimed.
"Wow! Orange set! And it’s level 46 light armor!"
"Such strong attributes, such terrifying boosts! Haha!"
Upon hearing Cheng Jianyong’s exaggerated laughter.
Everyone else also gathered around.
Before Shen Yun could speak, Cheng Jianyong wrapped his arm around Shen Yun’s shoulder and said, "See this, Xiaoyunzi, even old Cheng has an orange set, aren’t you envious?"
He appeared quite thrilled and then pasted the equipment attributes.
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him and said, "Why would I be envious? This is just the fiftieth floor."
"Next, we’ll definitely encounter sets with stronger attributes and higher levels."
"Moreover, based on the pattern, the set on the 49th floor is Mage Equipment, the set on the 50th floor is Warrior Equipment."
"In the floors ahead, the equipment appearing will either be heavy armor or Brother Xing’s leather armor."
"Then, you’ll be the one envying us."
Listening to Shen Yun’s analysis, everyone also felt it made sense.
But this time, Cheng Jianyong wasn’t discouraged by him.
Because, compared to the 40-Level Gold Armor he was wearing, this new 46-Level Orange Set brought an undeniable massive improvement.
If he could collect a full set, it would at least boost Cheng Jianyong’s overall strength by over 80%!
By that time, with Shen Yun’s amplification, Cheng Jianyong might even slightly touch the legendary level.
At this time, a new Mist Passage appeared in front of them.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, continue?"
Han Xing nodded, "Of course, continue."
Everyone also laughed together.
Then, they all stepped into the Mist Passage together.
System prompt: [Abyssal Rift, 51st floor scene has been loaded, the challenge will commence shortly, please Brave Squad prepare.]

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 285: Abyss Knight Set!
paragraphs: The group stood ready.
After a dozen seconds, a surge of monsters appeared.
The difficulty here was similar to the 50th floor; most monsters were at Level 45 or 46.
There were many Elite Monsters and a few Leader Monsters among them.
The boss at the end of this level was merely a Level 46 Lord, weaker compared to the 50th floor.
However, that was relative to Han Xing and the others.
At this current stage.
If a Level 46 Lord wandered into the Land of the Abandoned Gods, it would unleash a terrifying disaster.
A few minutes later, the battle ended.
The group worked together to defeat this Lord.
A Level 46 Orange Helmet and several Heroic Spirits burst out on the ground.
However, this Orange Helmet didn’t have set Attributes and could only be considered a decent standalone item.
After collecting the materials from the ground, they headed straight to the next level.
On the 52nd floor, the monster strength remained similar. Aside from a slight increase in monster levels, the frequency of Elite and Leader Monsters appearing also increased.
Still, the boss at the end dropped an Orange Armor.
Until reaching the 54th floor, after the group defeated a Lord Level Soul-devouring Monster.

Cheng Jianyong crouched down, picked up the Holy Hammer dropped by the boss, and remarked in surprise, "The drop rate is really high here in the Abyssal Rift after 50 levels; we’ve already gotten four pieces of Orange Equipment!"
"This Holy Hammer has fantastic Attributes, perfect for Xiaoyunzi to use."
After saying this, he tossed the hammer to Shen Yun.
Shen Yun, after receiving it, smiled and said, "The initial clearance state boost is why. The next time, it’ll be the usual probability."
The group nodded.
As previously verified, repeated clearance of Abyssal Rift makes the equipment drop rate very low.
Getting equipment once every ten times is considered good.
Then, the group arrived at the 55th floor.
According to their experience in clearing the Abyssal Rift.
Every 5 levels is a minor checkpoint, with a certain increase in difficulty.
Every 10 levels is a major checkpoint, where the difficulty dramatically surges.
Therefore, the monster difficulty on the 55th floor was equally formidable.
A group of Abyss Knights, clad in pitch-black armor, wielding Great Swords appeared.
Underneath them rode warhorses covered in black armor, with eerie red eyes!
Then, maintaining a neat formation, they raised their weapons and charged at the group!
Rumble!
As the horses galloped, the ground trembled continuously.
The group truly felt what it was like to face an army of thousands.
At this moment.
Han Xing suddenly shot an arrow towards the sky.
Skill: Fallen Star Arrow Rain!
Then, a sky-filled shower of destructive meteors began to rain down.
Han Xing’s base agility had reached 5243 points, and with Shen Yun’s state boost, it had already reached 7400 points.
In other words, he could summon over seven thousand meteors in one go.
Each meteor’s damage was enough to instantly kill a Leader Monster of the same level!
Even though the Abyss Knights were formidable.
In the face of truly overwhelming Power, they stood no chance of resistance.
No matter how many Abyss Knights emerged from the mist.
They would be blown apart by the Fallen Star Arrow Rain’s attack in an instant.
A dozen seconds later.
The meteor shower feast concluded.
At this time, deep in the dark mist, heavy footsteps sounded again.
Meanwhile, a hoarse warning voice echoed.
"I am Eudilys, Abyssal Guardian. All who dare infringe upon the Abyss Realm will face my judgment!"
With those words, a tall figure suddenly appeared within the black fog.
The figure did not possess a mount.
Its height barely reached two meters, in contrast to the increasingly larger monsters in the Abyssal Rift.
Clad in pitch-black armor, with spikes protruding from its joint connections, its design was quite striking.
It’s unknown what material crafted this armor, but just by looking at it, you could sense its incredible Defense.
The group saw the monster’s Attributes before them.
[Abyssal Guardian: Eudilys (Dominator Level Creature)]
[Level]: Lv 48
[Attributes]: Power 6243, Agility 6643, Spirit 5823, Constitution 6774.
[Skills]: Dark Shattering, Pain Curse, Dark Assault, Abyssal Domain, Judgment of Destiny (Legendary Skills)
For a Dominator Level Creature, it surprisingly had five Skills.
Among them was a Domain Skill, and a Legendary Skill.
In terms of sheer strength, this Abyss Knight didn’t lose to the Dominator Level Bone Dragon below, and even surpassed it in certain areas.
The group stayed vigilant.
There was a strong hostility from the opponent, and battle quickly commenced.
In the next moment.
The Abyss Knight raised its Black Great Sword, and the dark energy in a ten-thousand meter radius converged into the sword.
"Impudent ones, succumb to the punishment of Abyssal Power!"
"Darkness—Shattering!"
This creature began with a move full of spectacle.
Yet, just as it finished its dialogue.
It suddenly sensed a wind approaching its face, which was Han Xing’s arrow attack.
"Hmm?"
The Abyss Knight was slightly surprised, feeling a strong sense of crisis from the attack.
The Abyss Knight instantly locked onto the human archer at the back of the group.
To be cautious, it decided to temporarily avoid the attack.
The tall armored creature flashed and disappeared.
Compared to the oversized, somewhat cumbersome body of the Bone Dragon, this Abyss Knight seemed extremely agile.
Even able to dodge Han Xing’s arrows.
You could tell from its over six thousand points of Agility.
This creature, aside from being slightly weaker in Spirit, had other Attributes fierce enough to be terrifying.

It’s unknown what material crafted this armor, but just by looking at it, you could sense its incredible Defense.
The group saw the monster’s Attributes before them.
[Abyssal Guardian: Eudilys (Dominator Level Creature)]
[Level]: Lv 48
[Attributes]: Power 6243, Agility 6643, Spirit 5823, Constitution 6774.
[Skills]: Dark Shattering, Pain Curse, Dark Assault, Abyssal Domain, Judgment of Destiny (Legendary Skills)
For a Dominator Level Creature, it surprisingly had five Skills.
Among them was a Domain Skill, and a Legendary Skill.
In terms of sheer strength, this Abyss Knight didn’t lose to the Dominator Level Bone Dragon below, and even surpassed it in certain areas.
The group stayed vigilant.
There was a strong hostility from the opponent, and battle quickly commenced.
In the next moment.
The Abyss Knight raised its Black Great Sword, and the dark energy in a ten-thousand meter radius converged into the sword.
"Impudent ones, succumb to the punishment of Abyssal Power!"
"Darkness—Shattering!"
This creature began with a move full of spectacle.
Yet, just as it finished its dialogue.
It suddenly sensed a wind approaching its face, which was Han Xing’s arrow attack.
"Hmm?"
The Abyss Knight was slightly surprised, feeling a strong sense of crisis from the attack.
The Abyss Knight instantly locked onto the human archer at the back of the group.
To be cautious, it decided to temporarily avoid the attack.
The tall armored creature flashed and disappeared.
Compared to the oversized, somewhat cumbersome body of the Bone Dragon, this Abyss Knight seemed extremely agile.
Even able to dodge Han Xing’s arrows.
You could tell from its over six thousand points of Agility.
This creature, aside from being slightly weaker in Spirit, had other Attributes fierce enough to be terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 285: Abyss Knight Set!
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, everyone felt a bit surprised.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "This guy is something else, even dodging Brother Xing’s attack."
From the back, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also agreed.
After all, they had previously witnessed just how fast Han Xing’s arrows were — hitting with perfect precision!
The Abyss Knight’s decisiveness and speed exceeded everyone’s expectations.
And just at this moment.
The darkness above was suddenly stirred.
A black shadow lifted a great sword high and chopped down fiercely!
"So fast..."
Everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.
However, having been through so many battles, their combat experience was not to be underestimated.
In an instant, Shen Yun cast two blessings upon everyone.
Cheng Jianyong unleashed a Spear Qi Burst, creating a piercing whoosh in the air,
then, Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang’s arrows shot out simultaneously.
This time, it wasn’t just a normal attack, but one with explosive skill damage.
Gale·Break!
Elf’s Eye!
The Abyss Knight instinctively realized that this attack from the humans was even more terrifying than before, capable of inflicting extremely severe damage on it!
In an instant.
The Abyss Knight made the most correct response.
It placed its great sword horizontally before it.
With two clinks!
The attacks hit the Abyss Knight’s great sword, not causing significant damage.
However, it was forced back again by the burst of attacks.
The Abyss Knight’s shadow vanished once more.
This time, it reappeared to the left of everyone.
This strange combat method was something everyone was seeing for the first time.
Almost like teleportation.
When the great sword came slashing down.
A playful smile appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
"Interesting, these Abyssal Monsters really have some tricks."
This speed already surpassed the limit of the Fourth Transformation.
That’s why no one could capture its figure.
But, this would be the end of it.
When Han Xing took out the Oracle Throne from his backpack.
A terrifying aura burst from him once again, instantly surpassing the Abyss Knight.
This was a power from a completely different level.
Even Dominator-level creatures paled in comparison to this power.
The Abyss Knight’s shadow started to flicker again, stirring the entire combat area’s space.
At this moment, Han Xing wanted a swift conclusion.
So, he activated the effect on his medallion: Breath of the Wild, and his attributes soared instantly.
His presence rose directly to the true Legendary Realm.
As Han Xing closed his eyes, that peculiar state occurred once more.
In his perception, nothing could hide.
Including the rapidly flickering Abyss Knight.
At this moment, its movements seemed so slow.
Han Xing casually shot an arrow into the air.
That place was apparently empty.
But the next moment.
The Abyss Knight’s towering body abruptly slammed to the ground.
At this moment.
The red ghost fire in the eyes of the Abyss Knight flickered continuously, "Legendary..."
"How can you possess Legendary power?"
Its hoarse voice was filled with disbelief.
Han Xing did not respond.
When the Abyss Knight fell to the ground.
Everyone didn’t need Han Xing’s command to unleash their most powerful attacks.
Boom! Rumble!
The Abyssal Monster’s pitch-black armor blocked most of the damage.
Even Zhang Lianmeng’s fireball didn’t inflict significant damage, illustrating how terrifying the armor’s defense was.
But as Han Xing’s arrows flew.
The sound of arrows piercing the body resounded continuously.
Puff! Puff puff!
Even though its defense was astounding.
Against absolute attack power, it seemed as fragile as paper, punctured easily!
In a short time, the Abyss Knight was severely damaged.
The opponent swung its great sword, seeming to struggle to rise from the ground.
However, what greeted it was an arrow straight to the head.
The Abyss Knight rolled again and fell to the ground.
It was already thoroughly suppressed by Han Xing.
Ten seconds later.
As the Breath of the Wild effect ended, the Abyss Knight let out a hoarse scream and then died on the spot.
A system prompt appeared.
"Successfully cleared Abyssal Rift Level 55, time taken for this battle: 5 minutes 44 seconds..."
"Abyssal Rift Level 56 passage has been opened..."
Everyone let out a light sigh of relief.
Beyond Level 50, the difficulty of monsters indeed increased sharply.
If it weren’t for Han Xing’s burst, they could have defeated the enemy, but certainly not as easily as now.
However, the stronger the monsters, the more precious the equipment they drop.
Indeed—
In the place where the Abyss Knight died, a few bright ghost fires and a pitch-black helmet appeared.
It seemed to be the very set worn by the Abyss Knight.
Everyone’s eyes brightened.
Then they all walked over.
Han Xing directly collected the loot on the ground, and a system prompt appeared.
"Obtained Heroic Spirit*11, obtained Abyss Knight’s Helmet (Orange)*1...
Receiving eleven Heroic Spirits delighted Han Xing slightly.
Because with this, considering the Heroic Spirit count from the previous five levels’ monster drops, there were about 30 in total.
Just this harvest was quite rewarding.
Then, with excitement, everyone examined the helmet’s attributes.
[Abyss Knight’s Helmet (Orange) lv48, Quality: Legendary, Armor: 342~373, Critical Strike Rate +10%]
[Attached Effect]: Abyssal Gaze (Hit Rate +25%), Black Fog Shelter (Magic Damage received reduced by 15%), Knight’s Intent (Legendary Effect)
[Note: Abyss Knight Set 1/5, can be combined with Abyss Knight Breastplate, Abyss Knight’s Pants, Abyss Knight’s Wrist Guard, Abyss Knight’s Battle Boots for set effect.]
[Three-piece Set Attribute: All Attributes increase by 30%, Six-piece Set Attribute: Constitution increase by 20%, Magic Damage received reduced by 20%.]
[Upon collecting five pieces of the set, the Abyss Knight Set effect, Abyssal Guardian, can be activated!]
[Abyssal Guardian]: All damage received is reduced by 20%, and the next attack after receiving five attacks is negated.
Seeing the attributes of this equipment, everyone knew this was exclusive for knights.
The attributes of the single piece and the set effect combined could reduce Magic Damage by at least 55%.
No wonder Zhang Lianmeng’s attack did little damage.
They weren’t sure if other single pieces had the damage reduction feature.
If they did, it would be even more astonishing!
Han Xing directly tossed the helmet to Shen Yun.
Upon receiving it, Shen Yun saw the helmet’s attributes and gradually showed a look of delight.
Then he turned over and arrogantly said, "Did you see that, Xiaoyongzi?"
"I said before, don’t get too happy too early, the later set attributes are even better!"
Cheng Jianyong looked at him speechlessly, "What’s the use if the attributes are better, you can’t wear it now."
"48-level set, when will you be able to wear it, in the year of the monkey?"
Shen Yun sneered, "What do you know, now that the Human Race milestone has been unlocked, our experience gain speed has increased by 20%."
"Which means, the next time we sweep the Abyssal Rift quickly, we’ll gain more experience."
"By the time we sweep out this entire Abyss Knight set, my level would just about reach 48."
"So, the situation you mentioned won’t occur at all, hahaha!"
Cheng Jianyong gave him a look of exasperation.
Then, everyone proceeded into the Mist Passage of Level 56.
Next, they kept up the pace, starting their assault on the Abyssal Rift.
layers...
Until they reached Level 59, they paused for a moment.
The monsters of Level 59 were already at Level 49, nearing the limit of the Fourth Transformation.
However, since Han Xing had already brought out the Oracle Throne.
These monsters still posed no threat to them.
After a round of slaughter, the final BOSS was defeated by everyone together.
Then, in the open misty region, a slender and deep Mist Passage appeared once more.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Brave Squad, please note, Abyssal Rift Level 60 difficulty is extremely high, and may harbor creatures far exceeding the current Survivor level, please choose carefully whether to enter?"

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 286: Purgatory, Slaying the Wandering Demons
paragraphs: Just like when Han Xing and his group cleared the 49th layer previously, the system appeared once more with a very solemn reminder.
All four of them looked towards Han Xing, waiting for his decision.
This time, Han Xing directly said, "Enter."
Without another word, everyone followed Han Xing and stepped together into the Mist Passage of the 60th layer.
Within the Mist Passage, everyone once again felt the atmosphere around them change significantly.
The Mist Passage occasionally shrunk and expanded, as if it were somewhat unstable.
In the mist, there were no longer any murmurs of resentful spirits.
The surroundings were completely silent.
The two girls in the team continued walking in the middle.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, the two frontline fighters, walked at the front.
Han Xing followed at the back.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong involuntarily shivered and said, "Why does the atmosphere here feel so eerie?"
Shen Yun said, "What are you worried about? The system’s reminder only said that the monsters’ levels are higher than ours, it didn’t say their strength surpasses ours."
"Besides, don’t we still have Brother Xing with us?"
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong found reason in it, and then nodded his head, continuing to advance.
The deeper they went, the more the surrounding scenery began to change.
From the previously dark and cold environment, it gradually began to show some brightness and warmth.
At the end of the passage, there was a red glow, as if a flame was burning.
This sight was beyond everyone’s expectations.
"Fire glow? Could it be that we are already nearing the end of the Abyssal Rift, really stepping into the Abyss Realm?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Because everyone occasionally heard the natives mention it.
It is said that the Abyss Realm is actually a special world.
Unlike the outside, which is a world composed of sky islands.
It is a complete continent.
However, that place is often shrouded in a terrifying high temperature, utterly devoid of life.
Living creatures, at the moment of stepping in, will be burned to ashes.
This is what we commonly refer to as purgatory.
Coupled with various sudden natural disasters.
The Abyss Realm is a world completely unsuitable for living creatures to survive.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng softly said, "Probably... not yet."
"I remember the Abyssal Rift has a hundred layers... we are only at the 60th layer now."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Although the scene ahead was somewhat strange.
Everyone still bravely stepped into the battle space of the 60th layer.
The scene here once again left everyone in shock.
Compared to the previous 59 layers of vast gray space.
Before them was an area filled with rolling thick smoke and blazing fire everywhere.
On the charred ground, rivers of lava flowed, and from a distance, an occasional explosion could be heard.
Boom! Rumble!
One after another, lava rivers erupted in explosive blasts, those flows shooting up hundreds of meters high.
Terrifying heat waves swept over them in waves.
Coupled with the suffocating thick smoke, everyone felt extremely uncomfortable.
At this moment, Han Xing pondered, "I remember the system previously reminded us that the Abyssal Rift is the main channel connecting the Holy Spirit Realm and the Abyss Realm."
"It seems that as we delve deeper, we are gradually getting closer to the Abyss Realm."
Just as he finished speaking, the system reminder appeared.
"The Abyssal Rift 60th layer challenge is about to begin, please survivors prepare for battle..."
The battle rhythm of the 60th layer was extremely fast.
As soon as the words ended, a sound of air shredding was heard above everyone’s heads.
A group of red-skinned creatures with green faces, fangs, and broken flesh wings on their backs pounced towards them.
"Demons!"
Seeing the appearance of this group of creatures, Shen Yun blurted out!
Yes, they finally saw one of the most powerful creatures in the abyss.
Demons!
[Low-level Demon Warrior (Abyss Ordinary Creature)]
[Level]: lv50
[Attributes]: Power 4308, Agility 4561, Spirit 4457, Constitution 4782.
[Skills]: Demon Slash, Evil Magic Ball, Lava Eruption!
Although these low-level demons were only ordinary monsters.
They also possessed three skills.
Moreover, their attributes were quite formidable, roughly equivalent to elite creatures of level 49.
In addition to their massive numbers, they were indeed a bit difficult to handle.
But, as mentioned before.
As long as they’re not at the legendary level, they’re not a threat to Han Xing right now.
We see him seated on the throne, suddenly activating the effect of a piece of equipment.
The next moment—
An overwhelming aura burst forth from within him!
This aura was even more sinister and terrifying than that of this group of demons.
In the sky, tens of thousands of flying demons fell like kites with broken strings.
It was precisely the effect of Han Xing’s currently equipped Divine Artifact Armor, the Overwhelming Calamity.

[Overwhelming Calamity]: Epic Effect, spreading the divine power of the God of Spreading Calamity, reducing the constitution of all creatures within a radius of five thousand meters by 50%, reducing healing effects by 100%, the effect lasts for 60 seconds, with a cooldown time of 60 minutes.
Centered around Han Xing, the coverage area of five thousand meters nearly engulfed this entire group of monsters.
Their constitution suddenly halved.
It felt as if they had been continually drained by the enchanting demons of the abyss for nearly a month, a pervasive sense of emptiness emerged from within.
That’s why this group of demons suddenly fell.
Observing the effect before him, Han Xing was very pleased.
Although the Overwhelming Calamity effect does not work on legendary creatures.
But to deal with these ordinary creatures, the effect was truly excellent.
With that group of demons falling, they hadn’t even managed to showcase their prestige as native residents of the abyss before being swept away en masse by Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
Coal Ball’s silhouette was also constantly flickering.
That flock of low-level demons emitted piercing howls.
Trying to disrupt everyone’s minds by this means.

However, what surprised Han Xing was that the experience provided by these low-level demons was indeed substantial.
Each one gave a staggering ten million experience points.
After wiping them all out, they harvested almost close to ten billion experience points.
The experience bar, which had been rising slowly before, now showed a significant increase.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng excitedly appeared beside Han Xing, grabbing his arm and said: "Brother Xing, so much experience!"
"A few more times, and I can reach Level 46!"
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, the monsters on the 60th floor give a lot of experience."
"With this, our leveling speed can also accelerate."
Besides the experience points reward.
The places where these demons died also produced many high-level materials, such as Permanent Gold Ingots, Purple Gold Stone, and so on...
Han Xing quickly collected them all to prevent them from falling into the lava on the ground and being burned away.
The system notification appeared.
"Obtained mithril*7891, Permanent Gold Ingot*127, Purple Gold Stone*64, Low-Level Demon Blood*87937..."
This time, a new item appeared from these demons.
[Low-Level Demon Blood]: Blood containing the Power of the Demon, consuming it can increase 600 points of power within 60 seconds, after the effect ends, reduce power by 3000, lasting for one hour.
Uh...
This thing...
Han Xing glanced at it, then directly put it into his backpack.
points of power is indeed a big increase, but damn, the side effect is too terrifying.
An hour’s time reducing 3000 points of power, no matter how you calculate it, it’s a losing deal.
Unless forced into a desperate situation, otherwise no one would consume this thing.
Just as Han Xing had collected all the materials from the ground.
A sudden, violent tremor came from the sky.
Everyone instinctively raised their heads.
In the thick fog, a faint firelight began to appear.
The firelight grew clearer, like a meteor descending from the sky.
But it was even more impressive than Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique!
The next moment, it crashed onto the black and red ground with a loud bang!
Boom!
Under the terrifying impact, everyone felt a strong shock.
The lava rivers on the ground suddenly erupted, and the surrounding temperature rose significantly again.
According to everyone’s feeling estimation, the temperature has now reached over 90 degrees.
This terrifyingly high-temperature environment is almost unsuitable for any creature to survive.
However, with their current physical condition, they can still endure.
At the same time, a figure emerged, bathing in lava.
Its height reached seven to eight meters, holding a flaming greatsword in its hand.
Muscles exposed all over, only wearing simple beast hide trousers on the lower half, giving a strong sense of oppression.
When it appeared, everyone felt an overwhelming evil aura.
[Wandering Demon: Cancirias (Dominator-level Creature)]
[Level]: LV50
[Attributes]: Power 8243, Agility 8736, Spirit 8261, Constitution 8523.
[Skills]: Blood Devouring, Evil Burst, Spiritual Flame, Void Slash, Endless Withering (Legendary Skills)
Seeing this guy’s attributes, Han Xing couldn’t help but furrow his brows.
The Demon Race, worthy of being a race born for combat.
Its physical condition is almost omnipotent, with none below eight thousand.
This is nearly the attributes of a typical Fifth Transformation Lord-level creature.
Not to mention its five skills.
Its strength completely exceeds the Fifth Transformation Lord, even enough to rival the two Shadow Legends Han Xing once slain!
At this moment.
Cancirias shook the flaming greatsword in his hand, grinning exaggeratedly.
"Hehe, how many years has it been, no living being has entered the Abyssal Rift..."
"This time, the ones sending themselves to death are humans!"
"I don’t know, how strong are the souls of the human race?"
"They better not be like those self-righteous beastmen before, breaking their souls before playing with me for a few days."
Listening to this guy’s lines, everyone knew the opponent was not a good character.
Seems like, it’s one who likes to torture.
At the next moment.
The evil aura from Cancirias burst forth, even causing the molten ground beneath their feet to erupt continuously!
Boom! Boom!
This skill is one of its five skills, Evil Burst!
Faced with such an enemy, Han Xing dared not be careless.
He didn’t even release Coal Ball.
Because, this guy’s attack power is truly formidable.
Coal Ball’s attributes are too extreme, with current agility attribute already reaching over six thousand, higher than Han Xing.
But other attributes are only four to five thousand.
Moreover, Coal Ball cannot wear equipment like Han Xing and the others.
If touched by this guy, it would probably be heavily injured or even die on the spot.
Han Xing didn’t want to take this risk.
Therefore, he decided to resolve the battle himself.
Against this guy, no need to hold back.
Because Han Xing’s target this time is the 60th floor.
Except for skills with cooldowns exceeding a day, all other skills can be used against the opponent.
As the special effects of Han Xing’s equipment activated one by one.
Within a short time, his aura reached the level comparable to this demon.
Meanwhile.
Cancirias wielded the greatsword, and the surging lava in the air attacked them.
Simultaneously, the demon’s figure also vanished from its original position.
Facing head-on, an evil aura swept in.
This guy’s fighting style seemed a bit similar to the Abyss Knight on the 55th floor.
Only, Wandering Demon’s speed is faster, attacks more deadly.
Shen Yun raised the shield, taking two steps forward, shielding the others behind him.
However, the Wandering Demon seemed to sense Shen Yun was not easy to deal with.
Thus.
Its figure flickered, disappearing right before Shen Yun.
At the moment of disappearance, Shen Yun realized it too, quickly shouting: "Brother Xing, watch out!"
"This guy is coming after you guys!"
However, Shen Yun’s reminder was ultimately a step late.
The figure wielding the greatsword of the Wandering Demon had already appeared before Zhang Lianmeng.
It seemed to know this Female Mage posed the greatest threat to itself, wanting to deal with her first.
Zhang Lianmeng stared at the flaming greatsword rapidly enlarging before her, pupils constricting.
And at this critical moment.
Several arrows suddenly shot towards the Wandering Demon at unimaginable speed.
Puff puff puff!
The arrows pierced through the Wandering Demon’s chest, bringing out strings of dark red blood.
The creature froze.
It was this brief pause that allowed Shen Yun to reappear before it and intercept.
Bang!
The flaming greatsword and shield collided with a dull crash.
The ground’s lava erupted up to a height of over ten meters.
The Wandering Demon clutched its chest wound in surprise.
"Legend..." it murmured.
Next, the Wandering Demon’s figure vanished again.
At the same time, Han Xing’s words came from behind.
"Shen Yun, throw the Sun, let’s settle this quickly."
Most of the equipment effects on everyone had activated, now was the peak state.
Upon hearing, Shen Yun readily activated the Church Secret Technique — Holy Light Shines.
All of a sudden, everyone’s attributes surged dramatically!
Simultaneously.
Su Xiaoyang also activated the Elf Secret Technique, Withered Life Vine.
The Wandering Demon suddenly felt its body entangled by green vines growing unexpectedly from the void.
Its mobility greatly reduced.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "Burst, finish him off!"
Cheng Jianyong immediately understood, directly unleashing his ultimate move, Storm Chaos Dance!
Simultaneously, Zhang Lianmeng’s Chain Fireball, Su Xiaoyang’s Multi-Shot.
And Han Xing’s various burst skills were fired one after another without restraint!
After five seconds.
The green vines in the void all shattered at this moment.
The Wandering Demon now stared blankly at its own battered body, then fell with a resounding crash.
System notification: "Successfully slew the Wandering Demon: Cancirias, gained 1.821 billion experience points..."

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 287: First Clear Rewards, Hunter Set!
paragraphs: Hearing the system prompts, everyone breathed a sigh of relief simultaneously.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong flicked off the demon’s blood from the tip of his gun and said, somewhat belatedly, "So, Brother Xing told us to save those secret skills because of this moment?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"With our current strength, if we sprinted with all our might, we could push a few more floors up, but it wouldn’t be very meaningful."
"Because those skills of ours have such long cooldown times, some can only be used once every couple of days."
"What I need are levels that we can repeatedly clear without using those trump cards."
"It looks like the 60th floor is just perfect."
Everyone wore expressions of sudden realization on their faces.
And just at this moment.
The system prompt appeared once again.
"Successfully cleared the Abyssal Rift 60th floor, this battle took 8 minutes and 32 seconds..."

"Since you are the first team to clear the Abyssal Rift, you receive the first-clear rewards: Abyssal Magic Stone*200000, Heroic Spirit*200, Demon Essence Blood*10, Abyssal Technology: Tower of Death Light."
Han Xing, having dealt with this demon, finally relaxed.
He also heard the system prompt, and a smile of surprise appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Compared to the previous first-clear rewards, this one also included a large amount of Abyssal Magic Stones and Heroic Spirits.
The difference was, this time, there was also Demon Essence Blood and a Tower of Death Light.
Han Xing eagerly checked the attributes of these two items.

[Demon Essence Blood]: Heart blood of a low-tier demon, consuming it grants a 30% chance of +10 to all attributes, a 70% chance of -20 to all attributes, and it seems it can also be used as an additive in certain secret elixirs.
Seeing the attributes of this demon blood, Han Xing was slightly taken aback.
Such a gamble, unless someone is extremely confident in their own luck, they probably wouldn’t try it, right?
Even though Han Xing’s Luck Value had increased by 20 points recently, he didn’t dare to take this chance.
After all, a reduction of 20 to all attributes is no joke.
Han Xing defeated those two Legends, absorbed the divine power from their bodies, and only managed to increase by less than 180.
If another Survivor were in his place, they’d lose at least four or five levels worth of attributes.
He directly stored this drop of essence blood into his backpack, not bothering to look at it further.
Then, filled with excitement, Han Xing began to check the other item.
[Abyssal Technology: Tower of Death Light]: Can fire a dark death light of formidable destructive power, causing devastating damage to all enemies along its path.
[Attack Power]: 30000~35000.
[Defense Value]: 20000
[Maximum Attack Range]: 5000 kilometers.
Seeing the attributes of this defense tower, Han Xing was also clear in his heart.
The introduction is very simple, emitting energy attacks to harm enemies.
However, the attack power is as high as 30,000, more than enough to harm Legendary Powerhouses.
Although its attack range is only 5000 kilometers.
But don’t forget, the Tower of Death Light, just like the Thunderbolt Tower, is a columnar attack.
All monsters along the path will suffer damage.
In terms of destructive power and destructiveness, it’s much more formidable than the defense towers of the Witch Race Main City!
Han Xing satisfiedly stored this blueprint into his backpack.
Apart from the first-clear reward, Han Xing also noticed a few things that the Wandering Demon dropped upon its death.
A soul emitting a red glow, a large pile of materials, and a pair of red pants.
As the reward for the first kill, there is almost always a guaranteed rare piece of equipment.
Then, with a fiery gaze, Han Xing collected them all.
"Obtained Demon Essence Blood*1, Wandering Demon Soul*1, Wandering Demon Skin Pants (Orange)*1...
This time, two new things appeared, the Wandering Demon Soul and the Wandering Demon Skin Pants.

[Wandering Demon Soul]: A soul formed after the death of a powerful demon, can be used to craft some special items or summon a Wandering Demon to assist in battle, with the summoning lasting for 60 seconds...
This Wandering Demon Soul has an effect quite similar to that of the Heroic Spirit earlier.
However, the only difference is the time limit for the Wandering Demon that is summoned.
It can only assist in battle for 60 seconds.
It’s not of much significance, so Han Xing directly stored it into his backpack.
Then, he checked the attributes of another item, the pants dropped by the Wandering Demon.
[Wandering Demon Skin Pants (Orange) lv50, Quality: Legend, Armor 453~478, Agility+550, Hit Rate+15%.]

[Attached Effect]: Demon’s Gaze (reduces the critical strike rate of the unit you make eye contact with by 30%), Abyssal Energy (restores a certain amount of life value when receiving damage), Evil Aura (Legendary Effect)
[Note: Wandering Demon Set 1/5, can be combined with Wandering Demon Cloak, Wandering Demon Hide Armor, Wandering Demon Long Boots, Wandering Demon Wrist Guard for set effects.]
[Three-piece set attribute: All Attributes increase by 25%, Five-piece set attribute: Attack Power increase by 25%, Agility increase by 30%.]
[Once the five-piece set is collected, the Wandering Demon Set function can be activated, Spiritual Flame!]

[Spiritual Flame]: Upon activating this set effect, each attack can apply a Spiritual Flame effect on the enemy, causing continuous burning damage, with the damage attribute being Agility*1.13, this effect cannot be dispelled, and can stack up to 5 times.
Seeing this set of equipment, Han Xing couldn’t help but let his mouth curve upwards wildly.
Damn it, finally got my own set!
Previously just seeing others get theirs, it would be a lie to say Han Xing didn’t feel envious.
Now, it’s finally his turn.
Next, as long as they keep rapidly clearing the Abyssal Rifts.
By the time Han Xing reaches Level 50, his power will see an explosive increase!
"Alright, alright, the Wandering Demon Set huh, just watch as I grind you hard!"
Upon this, the loot from the 60th floor had been all stored in Han Xing’s backpack.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 287: First Clear Reward, Hunter Set! (Part 2)
paragraphs: At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"The teleportation channel to the 61st layer of the Abyssal Rift has appeared. Do you want to continue?"
Han Xing directly chose to refuse.
Then, everyone left the Abyssal Rift together.
When their vision was restored, they stared at the uniquely styled room in front of them, suddenly caught off guard.
It was at this moment that they remembered.
They were in the room arranged for them by Wu Ling’Er, performing the teleportation.
Upon coming out again now, it was naturally at the original location.
This journey through the Abyssal Rift took about two hours.
The harvest...can be said to be quite astonishing.
Aside from three pieces of the Orange Set, many high-level single items were also dropped.
Apart from these item rewards, everyone’s experience bar increased by about 10%.
Don’t underestimate the growth.
But at their current level, it’s already quite impressive.
Just a few more times, and within one or two days, they could all reach Level 46.
At this point, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, are we continuing to challenge the Abyssal Rift now?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Let’s wait a bit, I’m going to digest the things we’ve gathered this time."
Everyone nodded; they also knew that having connected 11 layers, Han Xing recently obtained two powerful blueprints and hadn’t had a chance to craft them yet.
Then, everyone left Han Xing’s room.
However, Shen Yun and the others had just left, and within a few minutes.
The sound of knocking on the door suddenly rang out.
"Han Xing, may I come in?"
A woman’s voice came from outside the door.
Upon hearing this voice, Han Xing knew it was Wu Ling’Er.
He nodded and said, "You may."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er directly pushed the door in.
Then casually sat on the edge of Han Xing’s bed, crossing her legs, treating it entirely as if it were her own room.
Uh, not quite right.
To be honest, this indeed is Wu Ling’Er’s room, as the entire Royal Palace belonged to her.
They were merely temporarily lodging here.
Han Xing didn’t mind these details and asked, "Is there anything you need?"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s inquiry, Wu Ling’Er tilted her head and replied casually, "Is it not okay to find you without a specific matter?"
Listening to this woman’s unusual remarks, Han Xing couldn’t help but cast his gaze aside.
Only to find she was tilting her head, her dark hair lazily spread across the bed, gazing at Han Xing with a smile.
"Of course, you can find me even when there’s nothing happening, but your side’s war just ended; you should be quite busy, right?"
"You managed to handle all those matters so quickly?" Han Xing asked.
Hearing this, the smile on Wu Ling’Er’s face faded, turning into some dismay.
"How could it be handled, the Witch Race suffered too great a loss this time, besides two main cities being conquered, even the seventh defense line has fallen.
"Additionally, the High Priest is rallying Legendary Level powerhouses to retaliate against the Shadow Legion at the seventh defense line."
"Though I don’t have to partake in the battle, I do have to be responsible for eliminating the remaining Shadow Legion monsters within the Witch Race Territory."
Han Xing perceived the weariness in Wu Ling’Er’s tone.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er changed the subject, saying: "If only I could be like you all."
"Not needing to be concerned with the trivial matters of the Witch Race, not having to bear the safety of tens of billions of Witch Race people."
Han Xing laughed, "What’s so great about that? You have the entire clan’s support now, with endless resources, you don’t need to gather them just like us."
But Wu Ling’Er shook her head, saying, "Of course, it would be great!"
"Because then...I could be like them, always following Brother Han Xing."
Han Xing: "..."
"You...what did you just call me?" Han Xing’s tone held some uncertainty.
"Brother Han Xing, right? I noticed the two beauties by your side call you that?" Wu Ling’Er asked in confusion.
"Don’t you like me calling you that way?"
Wu Ling’Er’s tone suddenly became a little discouraged.
"You’re right, after all, we’ve only met twice and I keep bothering you all..."
"You don’t disdain me and are still willing to be friends with me..."
As Wu Ling’Er spoke further, her tone became increasingly somber, until a mist of tears could be seen in her eyes, as though she was about to cry.
Han Xing rubbed his forehead and said speechlessly, "It’s not that, you can call me whatever you want, I don’t mind."
"You’re just overthinking it."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, Wu Ling’Er instantly broke into a smile.
"That’s great, I’ll call you Brother Han Xing from now on!"
Speaking, she took out five bottles of elixir flowing with green liquid from her backpack.
"What is this?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
Wu Ling’Er smiled and replied, "Holy Tree Spirit Secret Elixir."
"It’s a unique recovery elixir from our Witch Race~ Even Legendary powerhouses can quickly recover if injured after taking it."
After speaking, Wu Ling’Er handed these bottles of potion to Han Xing.
The attributes of these potions appeared in front of Han Xing.

[Holy Tree Spirit Secret Elixir]: An elixir containing powerful life force, capable of quickly healing minor injuries of Demigod Level powerhouses and serious injuries of Legendary level powerhouses within a short time.
Note: Creatures below Legendary level who take this elixir can instantly recover all life force; if not currently injured, consuming this elixir can permanently increase Constitution by 100.
Seeing the attributes of the potions, Han Xing was extremely astonished.
This is an elixir aimed at Legendary and even Demigod level recovery potion!
No wonder Wu Ling’Er was severely injured yesterday but fully recovered today.
With this, it’s equivalent to having an extra life!
Looking at Han Xing’s shocked expression, Wu Ling’Er said with some pride, "Can you feel it? The life force contained within?"
Han Xing nodded and couldn’t help asking, "These potions must be very precious, right?"
Wu Ling’Er slightly tilted her head with a smile and said, "They are indeed precious, but not as exaggerated as you think~"
"The main ingredient of these elixirs is the leaf of the World Tree."
"Before, our Witch Race would trade a batch of leaves from the Elf Race each year."
"But as the World Tree encounters problems, the yield of these leaves has been decreasing annually."
"In addition to the outbreak of war, there is less trading among our large clans."
After Han Xing heard this, he nodded.
Then he put these bottles of elixir away and thanked her, "Thank you, Wu Ling’Er."
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "No need to be so polite, aren’t we best friends?"
After Wu Ling’Er left.
Han Xing suddenly remembered that he had previously obtained two blueprints for secret elixirs and hadn’t had the chance to craft them.
Han Xing examined the materials needed for production.
[Materials required to make Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir]: Yi State*10,000, Flame Breath Grass*1, Four-star Fire-type Creature Blood*1, Spirit Core*1,000
[Materials required to make Gale Wings Secret Elixir]: Yi State*20,000, Wind Spirit Grass*1, Four-star Wind-type Creature Blood*1, Spirit Core*1,000
Han Xing nodded.
The materials needed for these two elixirs are relatively common, allowing for batch production.
Next time they enter a dungeon, it can increase everyone’s combat strength significantly.
At this moment, Han Xing realized he still had some unfinished business.
Then, he suddenly summoned the Oracle Throne, and with a flash, appeared high in the sky.
Then with another flash, he returned to the Ten Thousand Stars City Sky Island.
While staying at the Witch Race Main City, Ten Thousand Stars City continued to develop in an orderly fashion.
The hundreds of thousands of goblins were close to exhausting that Pulsating Black Iron Mine.
During this period, Han Xing also found other mines for them to exploit.
Beyond this.
The territory’s five troop camps continued to summon creatures at all times.
The last war saw Han Xing lose quite a few Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs, and he’s been busy replenishing them recently.
Big-beaked Birds and Wargs don’t require much elaboration.
Han Xing was paying special attention to the camp he built last.
Chimera Camp.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 288: Human Emperor’s Destiny, Child of Destiny
paragraphs: Han Xing prepared to inspect his Chimera Camp.
Then, he arrived outside Ten Thousand Stars City, in a broad plain region.
At the center of the plain, there was a clear lake.
A group of bird-like creatures, each over ten meters in length, with purple-red feathers covering their bodies, gathered by the lakeside.
Though called bird-like, upon closer inspection, one would find these creatures quite different.
They had a lion’s head, a body resembling that of a goat, and a snake-formed tail.
Their appearance was quite bizarre!
The Chimera, being a dual-attribute magical creature, would first use the head on its tail to spray venom when attacking, followed by spewing flames from the lion’s mouth, causing tremendous damage.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of these creatures also appeared.
[Chimera: Four-Star Elite Creatures]
[Level]: lv46
[Attributes]: Power 5201, Agility 5431, Spirit 5607, Constitution 5191.
[Skills]: Venom Spray, Flame Burst, Three-Phase Divine Power (Can activate the three-phase divine power within, increasing all attributes by 50% for a short time.)
Previously, the camp introduction had mentioned this.
The summoned Chimera were at least elite level creatures, with a chance to summon leader level creatures.
This probability was similar to the Minotaur Camp.
Moreover, after Han Xing maxed out the camp’s technology, an option appeared to summon lord-level monsters.
However, the probability of summoning a lord was lower.
Han Xing nodded satisfactorily.
Although summoning a Chimera takes 30 seconds, its powerful attributes and skills made it entirely worthwhile.
At this moment, Han Xing took out two black-blue prints from his backpack again.
These were rewards for clearing levels 50 and 60 in the Abyssal Rift this time.
Han Xing clicked directly to learn.
"Successfully learned Abyss Technology: Cemetery blue prints..."
"Successfully learned Abyss Technology: Tower of Death Light blue prints..."
He first examined the materials needed for the Cemetery blue prints.
[Materials required to build Cemetery]: Rotting Black Soil*100,000, Strong Blood*200,000, Rare Earth*500,000, Beast Skeleton*300,000, Refined Iron*100,000, Mithril*50,000.
This thing, deservedly called Abyss Technology.
The required materials were all so unique.
The other materials were fine, but Han Xing hadn’t encountered the Rotting Black Soil before.
Nonetheless, this didn’t stop him from searching for this material in the trading channel.
A quick search, and he indeed found quite a few.
However, the prices set by these fellows varied drastically.
Han Xing directly leveraged his purchasing power and bought them all.
After sorting out the Rotting Black Soil, the other materials were no longer a concern.
In Han Xing’s warehouse, there were ample reserves.
Thus, Han Xing clicked directly to build.
The system prompt appeared.
"Building: Cemetery, remaining time 13 hours and 24 minutes..."
After dealing with this blue print, Han Xing began to inspect the other major theme, the Tower of Death Light.
[Materials required to build Tower of Death Light]: Philosopher’s Stone*100, Permanent Gold Ingot*50,000, Mithril*200,000, Refined Iron*3,000,000, Rare Earth*5,000,000, Abyssal Magic Stone*50,000...
"What the heck!"
Even with Han Xing’s current substantial reserves, he couldn’t help but exclaim.
Originally he thought the materials required to build a Hellfire Missile Silo were already terrifying enough.
Now, it turns out the Tower of Death Light is terrifying ten times over!
Han Xing looked at the material reserves of Ten Thousand Stars City.
With his foundation, he could at most create 100 Towers of Death Light...
This was far removed from Han Xing’s anticipated number.
However, the threat posed by 100 Towers of Death Light was even more terrifying than 200 Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Calculated this way, it wasn’t a loss.
Han Xing selected a location in Ten Thousand Stars City and began clicking to build consecutively.
The system prompt appeared.
"Building Abyss Technology: Tower of Death Light, remaining time 17 hours and 32 minutes..."
After a series of hundreds of prompts.
Rows of fog-covered areas occupying over a thousand squares.
And the cost was the materials reserves in Ten Thousand Stars City hitting rock bottom.
Han Xing’s face showed a pained expression.
Over tens of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones, more than four million Permanent Gold Ingots, it’s terrifying even to mention!
Plus various other materials.
Converted into Spirit Core, it was simply an astronomical figure.
This wave emptied the materials planted in his warehouse directly.
Luckily, now there was Xingyu City, continuously earning various resources for him.
It would take only a month to gather the materials to create a hundred Towers of Death Light again.
However, such a huge cost is worthwhile for the gains.
According to estimates, currently, the simultaneous firing of a hundred Towers of Death Light is already enough to instantly kill legends like the Shadow Sword Master and Shadow Lion King!
Han Xing excitedly clenched his fist.
"Just wait until tomorrow, Ten Thousand Stars City will truly possess the ability to establish its footing in this world..."
"Next, even when facing the siege of legendary powerhouses, I will have the ability to protect myself, and even counterattack!"
After dealing with these.
Han Xing also crafted a few bottles of Fire Element Affinity Secret Elixir and Gale Wings Secret Elixir.
Then, he set out with Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and the others to swiftly clear the Abyssal Rift...
In a blink, seven days passed...
Seven days later.
At the edge of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Two vast territories converged.
These two territories were the team territories of the Huayi Alliance and Kunlun.
At this moment.
Zhou Huang and Boundless exchanged glances, both showing helpless expressions.
"Brother Boundless, this time, we were both miscalculated."
"Unexpectedly, this Path of the Giant Dragon’s coordinates are actually so far from us." Zhou Huang said somewhat speechlessly.
Beside him, Boundless also nodded.
This time, they traveled together.
After advancing for almost nine days, they only just arrived near the coordinates.
