chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 288: Human Emperor’s Destiny, Child of Destiny
paragraphs: It’s been so long, which means the progress they painstakingly made to outpace those ordinary survivors is nearly lost.
However, before Han Xing’s high-level teleportation array is established.
For these survivors wishing to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the Path of the Giant Dragon is their only route.
So there’s no other choice.
The two Sky Islands continue toward the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Yet, it didn’t take long before they encountered the same predicament as Han Xing did.
The environment along the Path of the Giant Dragon is too harsh, and along the way, their territory has been struck by erratically floating meteorites over a dozen times.
Though there hasn’t been much loss of personnel,
many of the buildings in their territories have been crushed.
Moreover, there are also over a dozen ill-fated souls who, if not careful, would be swept away by the howling currents.
Then they vanish without a trace.
But having reached this point, they couldn’t possibly give up just because of these difficulties.
Thus, on the two territories, millions of survivors gritted their teeth, forging ahead.
However—
They underestimated the severity of the environment within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The deeper they go, the more intense the howling winds become.
Many low-level buildings in the territory are shakily moving, while many survivors desperately cling to surrounding structures, striving not to be swept away by the gales.
Even Boundless closed his eyes, saying with difficulty: "Zhou Huang, we can’t go any further!"
"If we proceed further, we might perish before we even exit the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
Zhou Huang, on his side, had a deeply unpleasant expression.
He wanted to say, endure for just a bit longer.
But the harsh environment in the Path of the Giant Dragon isn’t one to make jokes.
With a couple of cracking sounds—
Several small houses in their territories were directly blown apart.
A group of survivors, faces filled with terror, were swept away by the gales, vanishing into the depths of the mist.
Howl—
Howl—
The winds grew increasingly severe.
In a short period, the survivors swept away cumulatively from the two Sky Islands exceeded ten thousand in losses.
Zhou Huang realized they really couldn’t press forward any longer!
Yet he was unwilling.
Why? Why could that guy cross over?
Why can’t I do it?
In despair, Zhou Huang again touched the golden Dragon Pearl on his neck.
He murmured in his heart, "Give me another revelation..."
After speaking, a golden light appeared on that Dragon Pearl.
This burst of golden light even dispersed some of the mist over a thousand-meter radius.
Everyone watched the miraculous scene unfold on Zhou Huang’s body, their eyes filled with confusion.
Moments later, realization dawned in Zhou Huang’s eyes.
"So that’s it... To cross the Path of the Giant Dragon, one must ignite the Ancient Fire and then abandon their current territory?
"No wonder Xingyu City opened in the Land of the Abandoned Gods..."
"It seems that guy made the same choice."
Zhou Huang shared the information he received with Boundless.
Upon hearing the condition, Boundless hesitated for a moment.
After all, Kunlun Territory is Boundless’s main asset, abundant with resources and powerful defense towers.
Boundless said, "Zhou Huang, how certain are you that we’ll be able to quickly rebuild our territory after leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Zhou Huang replied, "Of course, because of Star River."
Boundless was taken aback.
Zhou Huang explained, "We all know Star River’s greatest strength lies in the terrifying number of defense towers on his territory."
"He himself isn’t particularly strong in combat."
"But from his recent performances, such as opening Xingyu City and successfully traversing the Abyssal Rift."
"Star River likely has already established his foothold outside."
"Think about it, even he managed to rise so quickly, would we two, joining forces, be inferior to him?"
After listening, a hint of surprise flashed in Boundless’s eyes.
Indeed, in terms of individual combat strength, he believed he was the strongest among the global survivors.
Even Star River couldn’t be a match for him.
However, what he didn’t know was that Han Xing had undergone a transformative change through his recent development.
Now, on Han Xing’s territory, apart from the defense towers, Han Xing himself was the strongest force.
Seeing Boundless’s wavering, Zhou Huang continued to persuade: "Brother Boundless!"
"Star River is already far ahead of us now. If we don’t seize this opportunity, we won’t have another chance to surpass him."
"Are you really willing to just watch Xingyu City continue expanding and monopolize the billions of global survivors?"
Boundless pondered for a moment and eventually sighed.
"Let’s go together then, leaving our territories in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Hearing that, Zhou Huang’s expression lit up with joy.
Before Zhou Huang’s excitement could erupt, Boundless interjected.
"Don’t get too excited yet."
"Passing through the Path of the Giant Dragon requires the key material Ancient Fire, let’s first take stock of how many we have."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Huang seemed to remember, hastily looking behind him.
Then he shook his head with a bitter smile: "We have less than five seeds of fire; how about you?"
Boundless shook his head, "About the same as you."
Zhou Huang’s face stiffened.
At this point, he seemed to realize late and said, "I mentioned it before, Xingyu City began purchasing Ancient Fire at high prices long ago!"
"This Star River, he had this figured out all along!"
"Even wants to monopolize such things, truly..."
"Truly disgraceful!"
Zhou Huang was both furious and depressed.
But there was nothing to be done; before this, nobody knew the Ancient Fire could be used in this way.
They didn’t even know what the Path of the Giant Dragon was.
Han Xing’s side offered high prices to acquire it.
Thus, many survivors with Ancient Fire couldn’t resist the temptation and opted to sell.
But this also served as a warning to Zhou Huang.
In the future, if they notice Xingyu City purchasing something, it’ll be beneficial to also acquire a batch.
Zhou Huang said, "So it seems, including you and me, only ten people can escape the Land of the Abandoned Gods this time."
Boundless nodded.
Then they returned to their respective territories.
Ten minutes later.
They each selected personnel and briefed their core members on various matters before leaving the massive territorial Sky Islands behind.
Then, a group of ten.
Each stepped onto a piece of initial territory, venturing into the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Zhou Huang and Boundless hadn’t been advancing for long.
When they witnessed the same scene that Han Xing had previously encountered.
In the mist, numerous phantom shadows of giant dragons appeared.
However, these dragons’ numbers were noticeably fewer than what Han Xing experienced the first time.
At first, seeing those images instantly felt like facing imminent danger, with tingling scalps!
But after observing for a while, they found those dragons weren’t attacking them.
They collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
They continued cautiously in the state, warily pressing further into the Path of the Giant Dragon.
And at that moment, the pendant on Zhou Huang’s chest suddenly emitted a dazzling golden light.
It illuminated the entire mist space.
Simultaneously, those dragons seemed to sense something.
They collectively turned their gaze, focusing on Zhou Huang’s chest.
Meanwhile, a Golden Dragon swiftly appeared in their sight.
Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser: "My Dragon Pearl... and Human Emperor’s Destiny..."
"Has this generation’s Child of Destiny of the Human Race finally surfaced?"
In the sky, the Red and Green Dragons also appeared together.
They all scrutinized Zhou Huang with a critical gaze.
Moments later, the Red Dragon slowly spoke: "Weak... So weak..."
"What’s wrong with this generation of the Human Race? Every single one is so weak!"
Listening to the Red Dragon’s blunt ridicule, Zhou Huang’s face contorted unpleasantly.
He wanted to argue that he was already strong enough among the Human Race.
In a true fight, even Boundless wasn’t necessarily his match.
However, Zhou Huang understood that the Red Dragon’s strength far exceeded his imagination.
Therefore, the opponent saying he was weak was within reason.
Zhou Huang could only shrink a little, allowing the ridicule.

sentences.text: It’s been so long, which means the progress they painstakingly made to outpace those ordinary survivors is nearly lost.
However, before Han Xing’s high-level teleportation array is established.
For these survivors wishing to leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the Path of the Giant Dragon is their only route.
So there’s no other choice.
The two Sky Islands continue toward the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Yet, it didn’t take long before they encountered the same predicament as Han Xing did.
The environment along the Path of the Giant Dragon is too harsh, and along the way, their territory has been struck by erratically floating meteorites over a dozen times.
Though there hasn’t been much loss of personnel,
many of the buildings in their territories have been crushed.
Moreover, there are also over a dozen ill-fated souls who, if not careful, would be swept away by the howling currents.
Then they vanish without a trace.
But having reached this point, they couldn’t possibly give up just because of these difficulties.
Thus, on the two territories, millions of survivors gritted their teeth, forging ahead.
However—
They underestimated the severity of the environment within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The deeper they go, the more intense the howling winds become.
Many low-level buildings in the territory are shakily moving, while many survivors desperately cling to surrounding structures, striving not to be swept away by the gales.
Even Boundless closed his eyes, saying with difficulty: "Zhou Huang, we can’t go any further!"
"If we proceed further, we might perish before we even exit the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
Zhou Huang, on his side, had a deeply unpleasant expression.
He wanted to say, endure for just a bit longer.
But the harsh environment in the Path of the Giant Dragon isn’t one to make jokes.
With a couple of cracking sounds—
Several small houses in their territories were directly blown apart.
A group of survivors, faces filled with terror, were swept away by the gales, vanishing into the depths of the mist.
Howl—
Howl—
The winds grew increasingly severe.
In a short period, the survivors swept away cumulatively from the two Sky Islands exceeded ten thousand in losses.
Zhou Huang realized they really couldn’t press forward any longer!
Yet he was unwilling.
Why?
Why could that guy cross over?
Why can’t I do it?
In despair, Zhou Huang again touched the golden Dragon Pearl on his neck.
He murmured in his heart, "Give me another revelation..."
After speaking, a golden light appeared on that Dragon Pearl.
This burst of golden light even dispersed some of the mist over a thousand-meter radius.
Everyone watched the miraculous scene unfold on Zhou Huang’s body, their eyes filled with confusion.
Moments later, realization dawned in Zhou Huang’s eyes.
"So that’s it...
To cross the Path of the Giant Dragon, one must ignite the Ancient Fire and then abandon their current territory?
"No wonder Xingyu City opened in the Land of the Abandoned Gods..."
"It seems that guy made the same choice."
Zhou Huang shared the information he received with Boundless.
Upon hearing the condition, Boundless hesitated for a moment.
After all, Kunlun Territory is Boundless’s main asset, abundant with resources and powerful defense towers.
Boundless said, "Zhou Huang, how certain are you that we’ll be able to quickly rebuild our territory after leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods?"
Zhou Huang replied, "Of course, because of Star River."
Boundless was taken aback.
Zhou Huang explained, "We all know Star River’s greatest strength lies in the terrifying number of defense towers on his territory."
"He himself isn’t particularly strong in combat."
"But from his recent performances, such as opening Xingyu City and successfully traversing the Abyssal Rift."
"Star River likely has already established his foothold outside."
"Think about it, even he managed to rise so quickly, would we two, joining forces, be inferior to him?"
After listening, a hint of surprise flashed in Boundless’s eyes.
Indeed, in terms of individual combat strength, he believed he was the strongest among the global survivors.
Even Star River couldn’t be a match for him.
However, what he didn’t know was that Han Xing had undergone a transformative change through his recent development.
Now, on Han Xing’s territory, apart from the defense towers, Han Xing himself was the strongest force.
Seeing Boundless’s wavering, Zhou Huang continued to persuade: "Brother Boundless!"
"Star River is already far ahead of us now.
If we don’t seize this opportunity, we won’t have another chance to surpass him."
"Are you really willing to just watch Xingyu City continue expanding and monopolize the billions of global survivors?"
Boundless pondered for a moment and eventually sighed.
"Let’s go together then, leaving our territories in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Hearing that, Zhou Huang’s expression lit up with joy.
Before Zhou Huang’s excitement could erupt, Boundless interjected.
"Don’t get too excited yet."
"Passing through the Path of the Giant Dragon requires the key material Ancient Fire, let’s first take stock of how many we have."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Huang seemed to remember, hastily looking behind him.
Then he shook his head with a bitter smile: "We have less than five seeds of fire; how about you?"
Boundless shook his head, "About the same as you."
Zhou Huang’s face stiffened.
At this point, he seemed to realize late and said, "I mentioned it before, Xingyu City began purchasing Ancient Fire at high prices long ago!"
"This Star River, he had this figured out all along!"
"Even wants to monopolize such things, truly..."
"Truly disgraceful!"
Zhou Huang was both furious and depressed.
But there was nothing to be done; before this, nobody knew the Ancient Fire could be used in this way.
They didn’t even know what the Path of the Giant Dragon was.
Han Xing’s side offered high prices to acquire it.
Thus, many survivors with Ancient Fire couldn’t resist the temptation and opted to sell.

In the future, if they notice Xingyu City purchasing something, it’ll be beneficial to also acquire a batch.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 289: Opportunity and the Holy Artifact Set
paragraphs: Off to the side, the Green Dragon intervened again, "Alright, be quiet now."
"Don’t forget, the Land of the Abandoned Gods does not permit the emergence of Legendary Level power."
"For this generation’s Child of Destiny to achieve this level is already enough."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Huang’s somewhat wounded mind finally felt a bit of comfort.
However, at this moment, the Green Dragon added another remark.
"Although, it is indeed a bit weak..."
Zhou Huang was speechless, thinking it’s better if you hadn’t said anything!
At this moment, the Golden Dragon stepped forward from the crowd, "Alright, let’s stop arguing about this."
"Regardless of the strength of this generation’s Human Race Child of Destiny, we must fulfill the promises we made back then."
The Green Dragon and Red Dragon both shut their mouths.
The Golden Dragon then spoke slowly,
"To this generation’s Human Race Child of Destiny, I will bestow you with an opportunity, but simultaneously, you must agree to one condition of ours!"
Upon hearing these words, Zhou Huang’s face lit up with joy.
Each of these Giant Dragons was fearfully powerful, far beyond their imagination.
And as the leader of these dragons,
this Golden Dragon was clearly even more terrifying.
An opportunity granted by such a high-level being must be truly remarkable!
Zhou Huang quickly asked, "What is the opportunity?"
The Golden Dragon glanced at the surrounding humans and communicated privately to Zhou Huang.
"The Human Race Holy Artifact... the Human Emperor’s Sword."
Upon hearing these words, Zhou Huang’s pupils suddenly constricted!
"Holy... Holy Artifact?" he cautiously asked the voice in his mind.
The Golden Dragon replied again, "Yes, and it is not a simple Holy Artifact."
"The one who possesses the Human Emperor’s Sword can be guided by the information on it, and with the help of my Dragon Pearl, locate other Holy Artifact components..."
At this moment, Zhou Huang’s mouth fell open.
Prior to this, even though he had never encountered such a high-level item as a Holy Artifact, he knew how terrifying it could be.
Last time, the Holy Artifact at the Battle Merit Store was exchanged by Han Xing, but he has yet to reveal its nature.
So Zhou Huang has no knowledge of what kind of Holy Artifact Han Xing possesses or its attributes.
But now, Zhou Huang could be certain.
This Human Emperor’s Sword is definitely more frightening than Star River’s Holy Artifact!
And it’s part of a Holy Artifact Set no less!
Just thinking about it makes one feel incredibly excited!
Zhou Huang quickly said, "Can you really give me the Human Emperor’s Sword?"
The Golden Dragon replied, "That’s correct, but you need to agree to one condition of mine."
Upon hearing the condition, Zhou Huang hesitated a bit.
But he still tentatively asked, "What is the condition..."
A moment later.
Zhou Huang looked deeply at the Golden Dragon, "Your condition is a bit outrageous."
"As things stand, I have no hope of accomplishing it."
The Golden Dragon replied, "That’s alright, after all, we’ve already waited over ten thousand years, a little longer won’t matter."
Zhou Huang hesitated for a moment and nodded.
"If that’s the case, then I agree."
The Golden Dragon’s majestic and terrifying face suddenly showed a trace of a smile.
In the next moment—
A brilliant golden light emerged from the depths of the mist, entering Zhou Huang’s body in an instant.
At this moment, the Golden Dragon’s voice sounded again.
"Remember, the might of the Human Emperor’s Sword is too terrifying; without being Legendary, you won’t be able to wield it..."
However, Zhou Huang at this time had no mind to listen to the Golden Dragon’s reminder.
He looked at the backpack, at the Great Sword quietly lying there emitting a golden glow, and a strong golden light flashed in his eyes.
On the other hand, Boundless’s expression changed.
Although he couldn’t hear what the Golden Dragon and Zhou Huang were discussing,
he didn’t know what the opportunity the Golden Dragon spoke of was either.
But judging from Zhou Huang’s expression, this thing must be something incredible.
At this moment, Boundless was filled with frustration.
Who could have expected that a trip to the Path of the Giant Dragon could grant this guy such a powerful opportunity.
If this continues, the gap between him and Zhou Huang will keep widening!
Boundless clenched his fists, thinking to himself, "I must find the Blood God’s legacy soon to enhance my powers as well!"
With these thoughts, they continued heading deeper into the Path of the Giant Dragon.
When the bright sunshine above gradually appeared, they all received the same system notification.
"You have exited the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the Witch Race Territory Map is now open..."
Upon hearing the system prompt, the ten who emerged from the Path of the Giant Dragon all wore different expressions.
Zhou Huang’s face was filled with joy.
While Boundless looked at him with a complex expression.
Boundless tested the waters, "Brother Zhou Huang, wasn’t this opportunity of yours quite significant?"
"I just wonder if you could share with us what it is?"
Zhou Huang shook his head in response, "Not really, the item I have now is of no use yet."
"It’s uncertain how long it will take for it to become effective."
Zhou Huang avoided the question.
Seeing he was unwilling to answer, Boundless didn’t press on.
The group took a look at the surrounding environment of the Witch Race Territory.
At this time, Zhou Huang said with a smile, "Unexpectedly, the environment of this new map is quite similar to the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
The other Survivors also felt subtly reassured upon hearing this.
Zhou Huang looked at Boundless and spoke again.
"Brother Boundless, it seems our development here will go smoothly."
"As long as we maintain our previous development model, with the strength of the two of us, we can rebuild our territory in no time."
"We might even surpass the Star River in one fell swoop."
Boundless said nothing but glanced at him with an unseen sneer.
This guy is indeed a sanctimonious hypocrite.
He only talks about teaming up to surpass the Star River but hasn’t mentioned anything about profit sharing.
Nor the ownership of the rebuilt territory.
However, for now, Boundless still needed to rely on Zhou Huang, so he didn’t show his true feelings.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 289: Opportunity and the Holy Artifact Set
paragraphs: They quickly manipulated the small blocks under their feet and started wandering in the Witch Race Territory.
Meanwhile.
In the Witch Race Main City.
After a week of rapidly clearing the Abyssal Rift, Han Xing and the others had significantly improved their strength.
Now, his level had reached 47, at 85%.
The levels of others were also above 80% of Level 46.
They weren’t far from leveling up again.
Since unlocking the Human Race milestone, their leveling speed had indeed increased.
However—
Han Xing also found that as they progressed, the experience required became more terrifying.
Sometimes, in the next Abyssal Rift run.
Clearing from layer 50 to 60 didn’t even increase the experience by 1%.
At this rate, to reach Level 50.
Han Xing estimated that it would take at least two to three more months.
But, the good news was.
They had already obtained five or six pieces of the three Orange Sets, and, removing duplicates, there were two or three usable items.
In addition, most of the Heroic Spirits they acquired were used by Han Xing to create Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Now, the number of chariots on the territory had surpassed two hundred.
Similarly, the Philosopher’s Stones and Shadow Divine Stones he acquired from the goblin warehouse were completely exhausted.
The materials in Ten Thousand Stars City were completely depleted.
A week of intense combat had also left everyone a bit tired.
Han Xing decided to pause the exploration of the Abyssal Rift and do something else to change the mood.
And what Han Xing planned to do next was a significant task.
If successful, the strength of the five of them, including Ten Thousand Stars City, would experience a dramatic increase!
In the depths of the royal palace, in a luxuriously decorated bedroom.
Han Xing and Wu Ling’Er were alone in a room.
Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing nervously, "Is it about to start? Brother Xing..."
Her tone carried a hint of unease, and a bit of anticipation.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Let’s begin."
Wu Ling’Er took several deep breaths and then slowly walked in front of Han Xing.
Han Xing even noticed Wu Ling’Er’s shoulders slightly trembling with nervousness.
Her light brown skin revealed a youthful softness.
Her dreamy eyes gazed at Han Xing.
With each breath, one could even feel the warmth exhaled by this Legendary Level powerhouse.
A moment later, Wu Ling’Er reached into her sleeve.
She pulled out a yellowed sheet of paper.
The paper recorded some information.
It was precisely the first batch of resources the Witch Race had prepared for trading.
Yes, Han Xing and Wu Ling’Er were in this secret room for the purpose of this trade.
Han Xing had promised Wu Ling’Er that he would sell her a batch of space backpacks soon.
The first batch included: 100 purple backpacks, 1000 blue backpacks.
All of them were top-notch.
As for what Wu Ling’Er would offer in exchange, Han Xing let her decide.
Now it seemed, she had an answer.
Han Xing took the list and glanced at it carefully.
It read.

"For this transaction, the Witch Race is willing to offer 10,000 Philosopher’s Stones, 10,000 Shimmering Terra Stones, 80,000 Shadow Divine Stones, 1 Ice Element Affinity Secret Medicine Formula, 1 Four Symbols Power Secret Medicine Formula, 1 Spiritual Absorption Secret Medicine Formula, and 1.7 billion Shadow Crystals..."
Seeing the materials on the list, Han Xing’s lips curled into a pleased smile.
This time, the Witch Race was truly sincere.
The tens of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones alone were enough to illustrate their precious value.
Plus, there were also three types of advanced secret medicine formulas from the Witch Race.
Just these items alone far exceeded the value of these backpacks.
Moreover, Wu Ling’Er knew Han Xing needed Shadow Crystals, so she intentionally had many collected to gift him.
This transaction was a huge win for Han Xing.
However, considering the importance of these backpacks to powerful beings like them, it wasn’t entirely unexpected.
So, Han Xing directly said, "Alright, let’s proceed with the trade."
Wu Ling’Er nodded slightly, "Okay."
"I’ve put everything in those few boxes behind you, Brother Xing can take them directly."
At this moment, Han Xing also noticed, in the corner of the room, there were two rows of large boxes, twelve in total!
Then, Han Xing clicked to collect!
The system notification appeared,
"Obtained 10,000 Philosopher’s Stones, obtained 10,000 Shimmering Terra Stones, obtained..."
So many high-level materials nearly filled up two of Han Xing’s backpacks.
He couldn’t help but feel a surge of joy inside.
Great!
Because with this, he finally gathered the materials needed to craft the Sun Crown Stele!
Now, only one last material was missing, the Legendary Level Dragon Spirit.
Han Xing could almost start crafting this astonishingly powerful item!
At the same time, Han Xing handed those space backpacks over to Wu Ling’Er.
The two of them looked at each other very satisfied.
At this time, Han Xing asked, "By the way, Ling’Er."
Hearing Han Xing calling her, Wu Ling’Er blinked her pretty eyes and replied, "What’s up, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing said, "Does your clan still have a stock of Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones?
Wu Ling’Er looked at him curiously, "Brother Xing, do you need a lot more?"
This time, Wu Ling’Er had given him tens of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones.
This was almost the bulk of the reserves in her main city.
Even for Wu Ling’Er, a Legendary Level powerhouse, so many resources would last her one to two years without war.
However, what Wu Ling’Er didn’t know was that Han Xing was really short of these high-level materials.
The Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones given by Wu Ling’Er were indeed numerous, but just barely enough to craft the Sun Crown Stele.
Besides the Sun Crown Stele, Han Xing also wanted to build more Towers of Death Light, Ancient Weapons, etc.
He even wanted to give a ’Oracle Throne’ Divine Artifact to Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
And all of these things required a large number of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones.
"Yes, I need a lot of these high-level materials," Han Xing said straightforwardly.
Wu Ling’Er nodded her head slightly, "I understand, Brother Xing."
"Give me some time, I’ll talk to the other Witch Clan Priests to see if I can get some resources from their main cities."
Hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but grab Wu Ling’Er’s small hand, excitedly saying, "Thank you so much!"
Wu Ling’Er’s hands were held by Han Xing, but she didn’t break free, instead saying softly, "No... no problem..."
"When they hear they can trade for space items, they’ll definitely be happy to..."
The more Wu Ling’Er spoke, the softer her voice became.
Her face blushed even more.
Facing Han Xing, this immensely formidable Witch Race Saintess was now nearly burying her head to avoid eye contact.
Noticing Wu Ling’Er’s unusual reaction.
Han Xing then realized his actions and promptly released her hand.
Then he said, "Uh... sorry!"
Wu Ling’Er hurriedly replied, "No, no problem!"
"Brother Xing doesn’t need to apologize, just... could you call me just Ling’Er from now on..."
"Don’t call me by my full name, it feels a bit distant."
Han Xing: "..."
He understood why Wu Ling’Er wanted him to call her that.
That 91-point affinity already explained everything.
A moment later, he nodded and said, "Alright."
Wu Ling’Er’s face brightened with happiness at that, "Thank you, Brother Xing."
For a while, the atmosphere in the room became a bit awkward.
At this moment, Han Xing coughed twice, "Oh right, Ling... Ling’Er."
The first time calling her by this name, Han Xing was a bit unaccustomed.
But he quickly adjusted.
"You gave me so many Philosopher’s Stones at once, won’t it affect you?"
"You guys also need them to craft those war machines, right?"
In the last war, Wu Ling’Er’s main city suffered some damage, and many defense towers needed rebuilding.
Even the Demon Elephant War Chariots and Witch Pattern Battleships were heavily destroyed.

Since unlocking the Human Race milestone, their leveling speed had indeed increased.
However—
Han Xing also found that as they progressed, the experience required became more terrifying.
Sometimes, in the next Abyssal Rift run.
Clearing from layer 50 to 60 didn’t even increase the experience by 1%.
At this rate, to reach Level 50.
Han Xing estimated that it would take at least two to three more months.
But, the good news was.
They had already obtained five or six pieces of the three Orange Sets, and, removing duplicates, there were two or three usable items.
In addition, most of the Heroic Spirits they acquired were used by Han Xing to create Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Now, the number of chariots on the territory had surpassed two hundred.
Similarly, the Philosopher’s Stones and Shadow Divine Stones he acquired from the goblin warehouse were completely exhausted.
The materials in Ten Thousand Stars City were completely depleted.
A week of intense combat had also left everyone a bit tired.
Han Xing decided to pause the exploration of the Abyssal Rift and do something else to change the mood.
And what Han Xing planned to do next was a significant task.
If successful, the strength of the five of them, including Ten Thousand Stars City, would experience a dramatic increase!
In the depths of the royal palace, in a luxuriously decorated bedroom.
Han Xing and Wu Ling’Er were alone in a room.
Wu Ling’Er looked at Han Xing nervously, "Is it about to start?
Brother Xing..."
Her tone carried a hint of unease, and a bit of anticipation.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Let’s begin."
Wu Ling’Er took several deep breaths and then slowly walked in front of Han Xing.
Han Xing even noticed Wu Ling’Er’s shoulders slightly trembling with nervousness.
Her light brown skin revealed a youthful softness.
Her dreamy eyes gazed at Han Xing.
With each breath, one could even feel the warmth exhaled by this Legendary Level powerhouse.
A moment later, Wu Ling’Er reached into her sleeve.
She pulled out a yellowed sheet of paper.
The paper recorded some information.
It was precisely the first batch of resources the Witch Race had prepared for trading.
Yes, Han Xing and Wu Ling’Er were in this secret room for the purpose of this trade.
Han Xing had promised Wu Ling’Er that he would sell her a batch of space backpacks soon.
The first batch included: 100 purple backpacks, 1000 blue backpacks.
All of them were top-notch.
As for what Wu Ling’Er would offer in exchange, Han Xing let her decide.
Now it seemed, she had an answer.
Han Xing took the list and glanced at it carefully.
It read.

"For this transaction, the Witch Race is willing to offer 10,000 Philosopher’s Stones, 10,000 Shimmering Terra Stones, 80,000 Shadow Divine Stones, 1 Ice Element Affinity Secret Medicine Formula, 1 Four Symbols Power Secret Medicine Formula, 1 Spiritual Absorption Secret Medicine Formula, and 1.7 billion Shadow Crystals..."
Seeing the materials on the list, Han Xing’s lips curled into a pleased smile.
This time, the Witch Race was truly sincere.
The tens of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones alone were enough to illustrate their precious value.
Plus, there were also three types of advanced secret medicine formulas from the Witch Race.
Just these items alone far exceeded the value of these backpacks.
Moreover, Wu Ling’Er knew Han Xing needed Shadow Crystals, so she intentionally had many collected to gift him.
This transaction was a huge win for Han Xing.
However, considering the importance of these backpacks to powerful beings like them, it wasn’t entirely unexpected.
So, Han Xing directly said, "Alright, let’s proceed with the trade."
Wu Ling’Er nodded slightly, "Okay."
"I’ve put everything in those few boxes behind you, Brother Xing can take them directly."
At this moment, Han Xing also noticed, in the corner of the room, there were two rows of large boxes, twelve in total!
Then, Han Xing clicked to collect!
The system notification appeared,
"Obtained 10,000 Philosopher’s Stones, obtained 10,000 Shimmering Terra Stones, obtained..."
So many high-level materials nearly filled up two of Han Xing’s backpacks.
He couldn’t help but feel a surge of joy inside.
Great!
Because with this, he finally gathered the materials needed to craft the Sun Crown Stele!
Now, only one last material was missing, the Legendary Level Dragon Spirit.
Han Xing could almost start crafting this astonishingly powerful item!
At the same time, Han Xing handed those space backpacks over to Wu Ling’Er.
The two of them looked at each other very satisfied.
At this time, Han Xing asked, "By the way, Ling’Er."
Hearing Han Xing calling her, Wu Ling’Er blinked her pretty eyes and replied, "What’s up, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing said, "Does your clan still have a stock of Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones?
Wu Ling’Er looked at him curiously, "Brother Xing, do you need a lot more?"
This time, Wu Ling’Er had given him tens of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones.
This was almost the bulk of the reserves in her main city.
Even for Wu Ling’Er, a Legendary Level powerhouse, so many resources would last her one to two years without war.
However, what Wu Ling’Er didn’t know was that Han Xing was really short of these high-level materials.
The Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones given by Wu Ling’Er were indeed numerous, but just barely enough to craft the Sun Crown Stele.
Besides the Sun Crown Stele, Han Xing also wanted to build more Towers of Death Light, Ancient Weapons, etc.
He even wanted to give a ’Oracle Throne’ Divine Artifact to Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
And all of these things required a large number of Philosopher’s Stones and Terra Stones.
"Yes, I need a lot of these high-level materials," Han Xing said straightforwardly.
Wu Ling’Er nodded her head slightly, "I understand, Brother Xing."
"Give me some time, I’ll talk to the other Witch Clan Priests to see if I can get some resources from their main cities."
Hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but grab Wu Ling’Er’s small hand, excitedly saying, "Thank you so much!"
Wu Ling’Er’s hands were held by Han Xing, but she didn’t break free, instead saying softly, "No... no problem..."
"When they hear they can trade for space items, they’ll definitely be happy to..."
The more Wu Ling’Er spoke, the softer her voice became.
Her face blushed even more.
Facing Han Xing, this immensely formidable Witch Race Saintess was now nearly burying her head to avoid eye contact.
Noticing Wu Ling’Er’s unusual reaction.
Han Xing then realized his actions and promptly released her hand.
Then he said, "Uh... sorry!"
Wu Ling’Er hurriedly replied, "No, no problem!"
"Brother Xing doesn’t need to apologize, just... could you call me just Ling’Er from now on..."
"Don’t call me by my full name, it feels a bit distant."
Han Xing: "..."
He understood why Wu Ling’Er wanted him to call her that.
That 91-point affinity already explained everything.
A moment later, he nodded and said, "Alright."
Wu Ling’Er’s face brightened with happiness at that, "Thank you, Brother Xing."
For a while, the atmosphere in the room became a bit awkward.
At this moment, Han Xing coughed twice, "Oh right, Ling...
Ling’Er."
The first time calling her by this name, Han Xing was a bit unaccustomed.
But he quickly adjusted.
"You gave me so many Philosopher’s Stones at once, won’t it affect you?"
"You guys also need them to craft those war machines, right?"
In the last war, Wu Ling’Er’s main city suffered some damage, and many defense towers needed rebuilding.
Even the Demon Elephant War Chariots and Witch Pattern Battleships were heavily destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 290: The Powerful Secret Elixir and Unboxing!
paragraphs: Han Xing was worried that Wu Ling’Er had given him too many Divine Stones, and she might not have enough to consume on her side.
However, Wu Ling’Er shook her head and said: "Brother Xing, you don’t need to worry about that."
"Although trading with you consumed many of the resources stored in the main city,"
"We can quickly earn more back through trade."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "Are you saying, trade with other large races?"
"Yes, yes!" Wu Ling’Er nodded.
"I’ve told you before, these Space Items are very precious to us Legendary Powerhouses."
"Even the powerhouses of those large races would be willing to pay a high price to exchange for them."
"Moreover, compared to the scarcity of resources in our Witch Race Territory, the resources those large races have are countless times more than ours."
"Once the trade routes are restored, we can definitely propose high prices to exchange our bags for the resources they hold."
"Those large races will certainly accept!"
Wu Ling’Er candidly shared.
They could earn more resources through these bags.
Han Xing wasn’t surprised.
Indeed, Han Xing could also trade directly with those large races, and perhaps earn even greater profits.
But—
Greater profits also mean greater risks.
Dealing with these gigantic entities carelessly could lead to being swallowed completely.
Under the huge lure of profits, not all natives are as trustworthy as Wu Ling’Er.
Moreover, the relationship with Wu Ling’Er was built through various events by Han Xing.
Therefore, without understanding those large races’ strengths and attitudes.
Trading directly with Wu Ling’Er is the safest approach for Han Xing.
At this point, Han Xing asked again, "So when you trade, do representatives from those large races come over, or do you go there yourselves?"
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er shook her head with a bitter smile: "Of course, we go ourselves."
"Brother Xing should know, the Witch Race has declined, and compared to the scale of those large races, the Witch Race is no match."
Listening to Wu Ling’Er’s somewhat wistful tone.
Han Xing didn’t mind, but instead continued to ask, "When you trade again, can you take me along?"
He remembered he had two items related to the Dwarf Race.
One was to take Rhythm Black Iron to the Dwarf Race to exchange for the blueprints of Ancient Weapons.
Another was to find the blueprint for making the Spiritual Puppet Core.
Besides these, Han Xing also wanted to see the situation of the Elf Race’s World Tree.
After all, he still had several pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood, which seemed to be able to repair this legendary Divine Tree.
Therefore, Han Xing was quite eager about interacting with these large races.
Wu Ling’Er smiled and said: "Of course."
"However, we have to wait until the High Priest resolves the border conflict with the Shadow Legion before we can resume trade."
Listening to this, Han Xing frowned and asked: "What’s the situation at the border?"
Wu Ling’Er replied: "It’s okay, for now, the High Priest has united with several Legendary Powerhouses, disrupting the Shadow Legion’s formation."
"But in recent days, the Shadow Legion has been continuously adding troops."
"Now, the Seventh Border Region has become the main battlefield."
"Moreover, many Shadow Fangs have infiltrated various corners of the Witch Race Territory, requiring many hands to eliminate..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing felt moved.
Need manpower?
He thought of those Survivors in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Compared to the Witch Race, the number of Survivors might not be many, but all 3 billion of them possess combat capability.
Although they are not like real players who can be revived infinitely.
But they do have panels.
Han Xing had already checked, and after a month.
The global population of 3 billion Survivors has entered the era of the Third Transformation.
Though the level of the Shadow Legion is very high.
Inside, there are quite a few Ordinary Monsters of Third and Fourth Transformation.
Han Xing even considered this, allowing these Survivors to join the Witch Race’s army.
Even if they can’t defeat those Fourth Transformation monsters, following the Witch Race Legion and picking up scraps would also be excellent.
In the warfare, the strength of the Survivors would undergo a rapid metamorphosis.
As long as they are informed of the benefits, surely many Survivors would compete to come to the Witch Race Territory.
Then with some measures, get all of them to sign the Lord Contract with him.
By then, Han Xing would effectively have billions of helpers gathering resources for him.
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly asked: "By the way Ling’Er, I have another question I need to trouble you with."
Wu Ling’Er chuckled lightly: "It’s fine, Brother Xing, feel free to ask. Our relationship doesn’t need to be bound by such considerations."
Han Xing nodded, "I wanted to ask if you know where to find Void Soul Stones?"
Indeed, Void Soul Stone is the main material for crafting High-Level Teleportation Arrays.
Currently, the only known method of leaving the Land of the Abandoned Gods is the Path of the Giant Dragon.
But to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon, one needs the Ancient Fire material.
Although Han Xing started collecting them early, the total number of fires collected by his Xingyu City is less than a thousand.
Compared to the terrifying number of Human Race Survivors, this is far from sufficient.
Therefore, wanting to collectively leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the Path of the Giant Dragon is clearly not the best choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 290: The Powerful Secret Elixir and Unboxing! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Moreover, Han Xing also tried the Intermediate Teleportation Array method.
But similarly, he couldn’t teleport himself back to Xingyu City.
So, the current approach is to build a High-Level Teleportation Array.
Only through the High-Level Teleportation Array can these survivors leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods in large numbers.
Then, they can come to high-level maps like the Witch Race Territory to create more benefits for themselves.
Looking at Han Xing’s eager eyes, Wu Ling’Er pondered for a moment and replied, "Void Soul Stone..."
"It seems like, our Witch Race does have a little."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing immediately felt relieved.
He quickly asked, "Then, can you give it to me?"
"See how many Space Backpacks you need, these are negotiable."
Looking at Han Xing’s eager eyes, Wu Ling’Er hesitated: "It’s not so precious though."
"But, these Void Soul Stones, I just heard the High Priest mention them once."
"It’s just uncertain if he still has any."
"However, I can help you ask."
Han Xing was so excited that he nearly jumped up, not expecting Wu Ling’Er could solve the dilemma that troubled him.
If truly realized, Han Xing would control the only teleportable passage.
By then, imagining the benefits it could bring him was simply beyond imagination!
At this moment, he was so excited, he even subconsciously wanted to reach out and hug her.
But he quickly realized that this thought was dangerous!
Hence, Han Xing immediately withdrew his hand.
Wu Ling’Er seemed to notice Han Xing’s action too, and when he withdrew his hand, a hint of disappointment was apparent on Wu Ling’Er’s delicate face.
Han Xing awkwardly changed the topic and said, "Thank you, Ling’Er."
"No... nothing..."
"I’ll ask the High Priest for you immediately, at the latest, I can get back to you by tomorrow."
Han Xing nodded.
Then they left Wu Ling’Er’s room together.
With a flash, Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars City.
He first went to the warehouse area and placed the tens of thousands of High-tier Divine Stones from his backpack into the Storage Box.
Among them were also three Secret Elixir Formulas developed by the Witch Race and 1.7 billion Shadow Crystals.
The attributes of the three formulas were unknown and were not mentioned for now.
But those 1.7 billion Shadow Crystals made Han Xing extremely excited.
Because according to the exchange requirements in the Battle Merit Store.
He could now exchange all the Bright Moon Treasure Chests and Sun Treasure Chests at once!
If including the quota of Cheng Jianyong and the others, it was even possible to directly exchange five Sun Treasure Chests!
Currently, collecting 100 billion Shadow Crystals to exchange for that High-tier Ancient Weapon was still a distant goal.
Before that, exchanging Sun Treasure Chests might yield some Divine Artifacts to enhance everyone’s strength!
With this thought, Han Xing decided to act immediately.
He sent a message on the team channel, "Everyone, come to the Lord’s Mansion in Ten Thousand Stars City."
Upon receiving the message, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, along with four others, immediately dropped what they were doing and headed from the Witch Race Main City to Ten Thousand Stars City.
During the time they were coming, Han Xing clicked to learn the three Secret Elixir Formulas.
The system prompt appeared.
"Successfully learned Ice Element Affinity, Four Symbols Power, Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir Formulas..."
With an ordinary mindset.
Han Xing checked the attributes and crafting requirements of these three formulas.
Then upon seeing them, he was shocked!
[Ice Element Affinity Elixir (High Tier)]: After taking, it can enhance the survivor’s own Ice Element Affinity, increasing all Ice Element damage by 25%, effect lasts 180 seconds.
[Required Materials for Crafting]: Ice Crystal Leaf*1, Ice Element Creature Blood*1, Yi State*1000, Spirit Core*1000.
Note: This type of Elemental Affinity Elixir can only be taken one at a time.
[Four Symbols Power Secret Elixir Formula (High Tier)]: After taking, it can increase Strength Attribute by 1200 points, effect lasts 180 seconds...
[Required Materials for Crafting]: Four Symbols Soul Power*1, Divine Aurora*10, Yi State*5000, Spirit Core*5000
[Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir Formula (High Tier)]: After taking, it can accelerate Spiritual Absorption speed, increase experience value gained in battle by 30%, effect lasts 180 minutes.
[Required Materials for Crafting]: Elf’s Breath*1, Red Jade*10, Yi State*10000, Spirit Core*50000.
At this moment, Han Xing’s once calm eyes were now completely turned to shock.
"What the hell? These elixirs are so powerful?" he exclaimed directly.
The first Elemental Affinity Elixir needs no extra saying, 25% increase in Ice Element damage, ordinary.
But starting from the second elixir, Han Xing was stunned.
Four Symbols Power Elixir, can directly increase strength by 1200 points!
Even for someone with an agility-based profession like Han Xing, it could still boost damage by at least 20%.
For Cheng Jianyong, the increase would be even greater!
The crucial part is that this item has no notes.
In other words, the Four Symbols Power Elixir can be taken with other elixirs and still be effective!
Han Xing recalled the other blueprint he had, ’Gale Wings Secret Elixir’.
This elixir can increase agility by 25%, combined with the Four Symbols Power Elixir, the actual increase in damage might even exceed 40%!
But this isn’t the key point.
The key point is, there’s a third elixir as well...
Spiritual Absorption Elixir!
Directly increases combat experience by 30%!
For Han Xing, this is even more important than the above elixirs!
With this elixir formula, Han Xing’s leveling speed would surge tremendously once again.
At this point, Han Xing felt a bit grateful to Wu Ling’Er.
These three elixir formulas were probably carefully selected by her, specifically prepared for Han Xing.
And at this moment, the team members who received Han Xing’s message had also gathered around.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were still hand in hand, appearing as close as sisters.
One voluptuous and fiery, the other tall and sexy.
The two of them standing together formed a beautiful scenery.
This moment, Cheng Jianyong upon seeing Han Xing, smilingly asked, "Brother Xing, what’s up?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Do you want to open the Sun Treasure Chests?"
He was brief and to the point.
Everyone instantly understood what was meant.
Han Xing was preparing to exchange the rewards from the Battle Merit Store!
Cheng Jianyong immediately exclaimed, "Open! I want to open!"
Han Xing laughed.
Then he distributed 110 million Shadow Crystals to each person.
This amount was enough to exchange all the Bright Moon Treasure Chests and Sun Treasure Chests in the Battle Merit Store!
The next moment.
Dozens of sky-piercing beams of light suddenly appeared in Ten Thousand Stars City!
The next moment, 25 crystal-hued Bright Moon Treasure Chests appeared in front of everyone.
And 5 deep red, sculpted Sun Treasure Chests!
Then, everyone eagerly clicked to open them!
Buzz!
Skyward beams appeared, among a cluster of white beams, emerged 5 deep red beams.
The powerful divine power fluctuations even startled Wu Ling’Er in the Witch Race Main City below.
However, when she sensed that the place from which the divine power fluctuations were emanating was Han Xing’s location in Ten Thousand Stars City, she wasn’t surprised.
After all, that man always managed to do things beyond expectations in her impression.
The occurrence of divine power fluctuations was within expectations.
When the red light faded.
Everyone first checked the items obtained from the 25 Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
Among them, 17 pieces of Orange Armor between level 45 and 50, and some blueprints for Defense Towers.
The strength was similar to the Thunderbolt Tower, slightly weaker.
Given everyone’s current strength, the items from Bright Moon Treasure Chests no longer provided significant upgrades.
So Han Xing simply stored them all into his backpack, without examining further.
At this time, everyone turned their gaze towards the items in those two deep red chests.
These were the main attractions.
Since entering this world, nearly a year had elapsed!
Everyone’s strength had skyrocketed exponentially.
But altogether, they had just opened one Sun Treasure Chest.
Inside that chest, Han Xing got a level 35 Divine Artifact Armor.
Which he still wore to this day.
Every item obtained from a Sun Treasure Chest could bring them substantial enhancement!

These elixirs are so powerful?" he exclaimed directly.
The first Elemental Affinity Elixir needs no extra saying, 25% increase in Ice Element damage, ordinary.
But starting from the second elixir, Han Xing was stunned.
Four Symbols Power Elixir, can directly increase strength by 1200 points!
Even for someone with an agility-based profession like Han Xing, it could still boost damage by at least 20%.
For Cheng Jianyong, the increase would be even greater!
The crucial part is that this item has no notes.
In other words, the Four Symbols Power Elixir can be taken with other elixirs and still be effective!
Han Xing recalled the other blueprint he had, ’Gale Wings Secret Elixir’.
This elixir can increase agility by 25%, combined with the Four Symbols Power Elixir, the actual increase in damage might even exceed 40%!
But this isn’t the key point.
The key point is, there’s a third elixir as well...
Spiritual Absorption Elixir!
Directly increases combat experience by 30%!
For Han Xing, this is even more important than the above elixirs!
With this elixir formula, Han Xing’s leveling speed would surge tremendously once again.
At this point, Han Xing felt a bit grateful to Wu Ling’Er.
These three elixir formulas were probably carefully selected by her, specifically prepared for Han Xing.
And at this moment, the team members who received Han Xing’s message had also gathered around.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang were still hand in hand, appearing as close as sisters.
One voluptuous and fiery, the other tall and sexy.
The two of them standing together formed a beautiful scenery.
This moment, Cheng Jianyong upon seeing Han Xing, smilingly asked, "Brother Xing, what’s up?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Do you want to open the Sun Treasure Chests?"
He was brief and to the point.
Everyone instantly understood what was meant.
Han Xing was preparing to exchange the rewards from the Battle Merit Store!
Cheng Jianyong immediately exclaimed, "Open!
I want to open!"
Han Xing laughed.
Then he distributed 110 million Shadow Crystals to each person.
This amount was enough to exchange all the Bright Moon Treasure Chests and Sun Treasure Chests in the Battle Merit Store!
The next moment.
Dozens of sky-piercing beams of light suddenly appeared in Ten Thousand Stars City!
The next moment, 25 crystal-hued Bright Moon Treasure Chests appeared in front of everyone.
And 5 deep red, sculpted Sun Treasure Chests!
Then, everyone eagerly clicked to open them!
Buzz!
Skyward beams appeared, among a cluster of white beams, emerged 5 deep red beams.
The powerful divine power fluctuations even startled Wu Ling’Er in the Witch Race Main City below.
However, when she sensed that the place from which the divine power fluctuations were emanating was Han Xing’s location in Ten Thousand Stars City, she wasn’t surprised.
After all, that man always managed to do things beyond expectations in her impression.
The occurrence of divine power fluctuations was within expectations.
When the red light faded.
Everyone first checked the items obtained from the 25 Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
Among them, 17 pieces of Orange Armor between level 45 and 50, and some blueprints for Defense Towers.
The strength was similar to the Thunderbolt Tower, slightly weaker.
Given everyone’s current strength, the items from Bright Moon Treasure Chests no longer provided significant upgrades.
So Han Xing simply stored them all into his backpack, without examining further.
At this time, everyone turned their gaze towards the items in those two deep red chests.
These were the main attractions.
Since entering this world, nearly a year had elapsed!
Everyone’s strength had skyrocketed exponentially.
But altogether, they had just opened one Sun Treasure Chest.
Inside that chest, Han Xing got a level 35 Divine Artifact Armor.
Which he still wore to this day.
Every item obtained from a Sun Treasure Chest could bring them substantial enhancement!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 291: Three Divine Artifacts!
paragraphs: With an excited heart, Han Xing stepped forward directly.
The next moment, his pupils suddenly shrank.
Among the five treasure chests, he saw that three of them contained equipment.
A longsword with a silver-white blade, golden-yellow hilt, and a blue gem embedded in the middle.
The sword’s blade emitted bursts of cold light and was one and a half meters long, plus the hilt, was a total of one point seven meters long!
This sword, solely based on appearance, gave a strong sense of awe.
And a great bow with an overall dark purple hue, seemingly made of an unknown metal, with bloodline patterns appearing occasionally on it, as if just one look could ensnare you.
Next to it was a crown exuding holy radiance, with a gem encrusted at the tip.
Meanwhile, although the other two chests did not contain equipment, they did have two diagrams.
Han Xing promptly collected them all.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully opened the Sun Treasure Chest, obtained Rhythm Black Iron*56, obtained Ancient Spirit Wood*1, obtained Philosopher’s Stone*7, obtained Eternal Guardian (Red)...]
[Successfully opened the Sun Treasure Chest, obtained Rhythm Black Iron*73, obtained Ancient Spirit Wood*2, obtained Philosopher’s Stone*6, obtained Demon-Defying Battle Bow (Red)...]
[Obtained Elf Queen’s Crown (Red)...]
[Obtained Barbaric God Statue Blueprint*1...]
[Obtained Dwarf Race Technology Diagram: Miracle Tower...]
At this moment, everyone saw the contents of the five treasure chests and saw Han Xing collecting them.
Looking at the people’s yearning eyes.
Han Xing understood their intentions.
So, he first posted the attributes of the two pieces of equipment.
Namely, a great sword and a crown.
[Eternal Guardian Greatsword (Red) lv50, Quality: Divine Artifact, Attack Power 782~804, All Attributes +500, Hit Rate +15%.]

[Attached Effect]: Advanced Armor Piercing (ignores 500 Armor), Guardian (increases Armor by 500), Eternal Echoes (Epic-level Effect, has a 30% chance to amplify 200% Power when initiating a physical attack), Eternal Guardian (Divine-level Effect.)

[Eternal Guardian]: Divine-level Effect, after activating this effect, including oneself, all team members’ attack power includes a 50% armor-piercing effect, effect lasts 10 seconds (ineffective against Demigod-level and above creatures).
[Elf Queen’s Crown (Red) lv50, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor 432~473, All Attributes +400, Hit Rate +20%]

[Attached Effect]: Advanced Hunting Eye (Critical Strike Rate +50%), Advanced Elf’s Eye (increases Critical Strike Damage by 100%), Elf Bloodline (Epic-level Effect, creatures with Elf Race bloodline wearing this crown increase all attributes of the equipment by 50%),
Blessing of the Elf Queen: (Divine-level Effect, after activating this effect, increases the critical strike damage of oneself and all team members by 200%, reduces skill cooldown time by 50%).
Note: Divine-level Effect duration is 5 seconds, cooldown time is 24 hours...
Seeing the attributes of these two pieces of equipment.
Others turned their gaze to Cheng Jianyong and Su Xiaoyang.
Without a doubt, that great sword belonged to Cheng Jianyong.
Its formidable attributes were a first encounter for everyone.
Especially with a Divine-level effect, all members had a 50% armor-piercing increase for ten seconds, equivalent to at least doubling the damage!
However, even more terrifying was the second item, the Elf Queen’s Crown.
This piece of equipment was clearly tailor-made for Su Xiaoyang.
The effects on it were one more formidable than the other.
Most importantly, the Elf Bloodline effect, significantly elevating the equipment’s prowess to a higher level.
Han Xing directly threw the great sword and Elf Queen’s Crown to the two of them.
Cheng Jianyong was the first to receive them, feeling the heavy texture in his hand and the luxurious appearance of the great sword.
At this moment, he said with some disbelief, "The Divine Artifact Greatsword..."
"Old Cheng here has a Divine Artifact Greatsword too!"
"This is wonderful!"
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong raised the silver-white great sword high in his hand.
A terrifying Sword Qi burst forth from his hand.
The entire Ten Thousand Stars City, even the Witch Race Main City below.
Tens of billions of civilians felt a hair-raising sensation!
That was the true commotion of a Divine Weapon appearing.
Even Han Xing and others who were closest had a few strands of hair cut by the Sword Qi.
Although, Cheng Jianyong’s current level wasn’t enough to unleash the weapon’s full power.
But just the aura emanating from the Divine Artifact Greatsword was not to be underestimated!
Even Shen Yun looked at him with some envy and said, "Damn it, stop flaunting!"
"Hurry up and level up, such a good weapon, you can’t use it if your level isn’t high enough."
Cheng Jianyong laughed loudly, noticing the envy in Shen Yun’s eyes.
Beside him, Su Xiaoyang’s reaction wasn’t as intense as Cheng Jianyong’s.
She held in her hands the even more luxurious crown, like one carved from gems.
Nodded slightly to Han Xing, then softly said, "Thank you..."
Han Xing smiled after hearing this, "What are you thanking me for."
"Anyway, this equipment can only bring out the best effect in your hands."
Everyone expressed agreement.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Brother Xing, wasn’t there another piece of equipment in the treasure chest just now?"
"I think it looks like a longbow, let’s see what its attributes are!"
The others also curiously stared at Han Xing.
Han Xing didn’t hold back and directly posted the attributes of the last piece of equipment.
[Demon-Defying Battle Bow (Red) lv50, Quality: Divine Artifact, Attack Power: 714~745, Agility +600, Power +600, Hit Rate +20%]

[Attached Effect]: Break Magic (ignores 500 Armor), Demon Summoning (Skill damage +50%), Magic Communication (Epic-level Effect, with a 50% chance to amplify 100% damage when attacking), Descent of the Demon God’s Will (Divine-level Effect.)

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 291: Three Divine Artifacts! (Part 2)
paragraphs: [Descent of the Demon God’s Will]: Summon the will of the Demon God to descend, with oneself as the center, all enemy units are forced into an air ban (ineffective against those above Demigod level), and plunge all enemies into an extremely fearful state, reducing spirit attribute by 3000 (units below 3000 will be forcibly transformed into Demon God Attendants), armor reduced by 1000, effect lasts 100 seconds...
After reading the attributes of this longbow, everyone took a deep breath.
Undoubtedly, the attributes of this divine artifact longbow are extremely formidable.
In fact, it even rivaled Cheng Jianyong’s Eternal Guardian.
Looking at those increasingly terrifying weapon effects, everyone congratulated Han Xing one after another.
After the attributes of the ’Demon Communication Battle Merit’ were posted.
All the weapons obtained from the Sun Treasure Chest have been distributed.
Inside the chest, there were also two blueprints; except for Han Xing, no one seemed interested.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, when are we heading back to the Abyssal Rift?"
He is now extremely eager to reach level 50 quickly, and then equip that impressive great sword.
Han Xing glanced at him and said, "Don’t rush, let me prepare for a bit; we’ll gather in half an hour."
Before Cheng Jianyong could continue speaking, Shen Yun put an arm around his shoulder and walked off into the distance.
After everyone had left.
Han Xing walked alone on the streets of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Looking at the Tower of Death Light he had crafted a few days ago, spending over a thousand Philosopher’s Stones and other precious materials.
Now, it is all finally complete.
The Tower of Death Light, compared to other defense towers in the territory, exceeds over three hundred meters in height and has become the tallest building in the entire Ten Thousand Stars City.
Its entire body is pitch black, with red and gold patterns running from top to bottom all over it.
From a distance, one can tell that these Towers of Death Light contain incredibly lethal power.
Han Xing looked at the defense towers with satisfaction and nodded, saying, "Not bad!"
"Just with these hundred Towers of Death Light, it’s enough to heavily injure or even kill legendary-level existences."
"The firepower of my Ten Thousand Stars City has surged once again."
Thinking of this, Han Xing also recalled that a few days ago he had constructed an Abyss Technology.
Cemetery.
Han Xing thought, "Let’s see how that cemetery is doing."
With that, Han Xing headed to a plain behind Ten Thousand Stars City.
Originally, the place Han Xing chose for building the cemetery was a picturesque area.
But now, it has become barren, desolate.
Even the air is filled with the smell of decay.
Han Xing frowned, "Damn, in just a week, it’s been turned into such a mess?"
Saying this, Han Xing walked over.
Ahead, a stretch of rotting black land spanning a hundred thousand square meters appeared.
On the black land, small mounds could be seen.
No, those are not mounds, but graves!
Occasionally, skeletal frames would emerge from those graves.
These skeletal frames are just ordinary Skeleton Soldiers.
However, among them, Han Xing also saw some elite monsters and leader monsters crawling out of the graves.
Like Skeleton Generals and Skeleton Generals.
And various Ghouls, Demon Eyes, Resentful Spirits, and other monsters...
The quality of monsters summoned within the cemetery is quite varied.
But occasionally, there would be some extremely terrifying creatures.
For instance, right now, Han Xing saw one or two Abyss Knights and Fear Wanderers.
They are level 47 lord-level creatures, the same level as Han Xing.
These abyssal monsters are gathered together, emitting a towering evil aura.
Without Han Xing’s command, they would not make any unnecessary movements.
"A cemetery maxed out with graveyard technology, covering an area of about 120,000 square meters, which means I can simultaneously produce 60,000 graves."
"Calculating that one grave can incubate one abyssal monster, with a 22-hour incubation time, which is about 60,000 abyssal monsters produced per day."
"This efficiency is quite good."
"It’s much faster than summoning Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs."
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
In this way, the troop types in Ten Thousand Stars City also become more diverse.
At this point, he frowned again.
"However, I need to allocate a specific area for these abyssal monsters to stay in."
"Otherwise, their evil aura will pollute the ecosystem in Ten Thousand Stars City."
"If it’s not contained, the entire Ten Thousand Stars City will become an Abyssal City!"
Thus, Han Xing ordered these abyssal monsters.
When idle, don’t wander around the Ten Thousand Stars City.
Their activity range is limited to this plain.
Those terrifying-looking abyssal monsters looked blankly at Han Xing.
However, they all received Han Xing’s orders.
After examining these two Abyss Technologies.
Han Xing seemed to recall something.
In the two Sun Treasure Chests just now, he had also acquired two blueprints.
One was the Divine Spirit’s statue blueprint.
The other was even more impressive, actually a Dwarf Race building.
With a thoughtful look, Han Xing took them out, thinking, "The blueprints from the Sun Treasure Chest shouldn’t have bad attributes."
Thus, Han Xing tentatively checked the attributes of these two blueprints.
[Barbaric God Statue Blueprint]: Can be used to construct a Barbaric God Statue within the territory.
Note: The Barbaric God is one of the four oldest divine spirits in the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, and his statue possesses miraculous power!
It can shorten the summoning or incubation time of all encampment-type buildings within the territory by 50%.
Seeing the attributes of this blueprint, Han Xing’s pupils shrank.
He looked at this blueprint, then looked at the cemetery on the ground.
Then directly exclaimed.
"Damn!"
The effect of this blueprint far exceeded his expectations.
Shortening the summon time of encampment-type buildings by 50% is no joke.
Because in this way.
The number of troops that can be summoned on the territory daily can almost double!
His pace of expanding troops will undergo a qualitative change!
From now on, unless encountering some major warfare, he won’t worry about troop casualties anymore!
"Good, good, good! Worthy of a blueprint from the Sun Treasure Chest, really freaking awesome!"
Han Xing directly clicked to learn, then checked the materials required for construction.
[Materials needed to construct the Barbaric God Statue]: Philosopher’s Stone*2000, Shadow Divine Stone*10000, Refined Iron*5 million, Mithril*600,000, Permanent Gold Ingot*50,000...
Seeing the required materials, Han Xing couldn’t help gritting his teeth.
Again, it needs so many Philosopher’s Stones?
This time, if it weren’t for Wu Ling’Er replenishing his resources, Han Xing really couldn’t craft this thing.
Moreover, the resources in Ten Thousand Stars City are intended for crafting the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele.
If used now, it would be somewhat insufficient.
After pondering for some time, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Forget it, let’s build it first."
"After all, I haven’t found the Dragon Spirit of legendary level yet, and it takes some time to craft the Sun Crown Stele."
"During this time, I can totally collect more Philosopher’s Stones."
Han Xing’s figure flashed and returned to the town square of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Just as he was about to click to build, his hands stopped in mid-air.
Han Xing pondered, "The Barbaric God, this name sounds like a relatively rough existence."
"It doesn’t match the style of these goddess statues in my town square."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing decided to build the Barbaric God’s statue in another place in Ten Thousand Stars City.
His figure flashed.
Han Xing casually found a piece of vacant land and then clicked to build.
[Building the Barbaric God Statue, remaining time: 41 hours and 17 minutes...]
Han Xing nodded and then checked the last blueprint obtained.
It was the Dwarf Race building—the Tower of Miracles!

Just as he was about to click to build, his hands stopped in mid-air.
Han Xing pondered, "The Barbaric God, this name sounds like a relatively rough existence."
"It doesn’t match the style of these goddess statues in my town square."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing decided to build the Barbaric God’s statue in another place in Ten Thousand Stars City.
His figure flashed.
Han Xing casually found a piece of vacant land and then clicked to build.
[Building the Barbaric God Statue, remaining time: 41 hours and 17 minutes...]
Han Xing nodded and then checked the last blueprint obtained.
It was the Dwarf Race building—the Tower of Miracles!

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 292: The Saintess’s Decision
paragraphs: [Dwarven Technology: Miracle Tower Blueprint]: A Miracle Tower can be constructed within the territory.
[Building Effect]: Every 48 hours, by sacrificing the Philosopher’s Stone and Rhythm Black Iron, one random miracle effect of the tower can be obtained.

The miracle effects are: Construction speed increased by 50%, item crafting success rate +25%, construction consumption reduced by 20%, all territory buildings’ Defense Value increased by 100%, all territory buildings’ Attack Power increased by 100%.
Note: The probability of obtaining each of the five miracle effects is the same, and each miracle lasts for 24 hours.
"This thing..." Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
It can be powerful, but also somewhat of a white elephant.
Among the five miracle effects, only two or three are useful for Han Xing.
Moreover, the miracle effect appears only once every 48 hours.
Which means, there’s a day of cooldown time in between.
However, if he can trigger the miracle effect that reduces construction consumption by 20%, Han Xing would have hit the jackpot!
After all, the high-level defense towers and buildings Han Xing is currently crafting require an enormous amount of materials.
With a 20% reduction in consumption, the materials Han Xing saves would be enough to craft dozens more Towers of Death Light.
But no matter what, building this Miracle Tower won’t be a loss for Han Xing.
Han Xing clapped his hands and clicked on the "Learn".
Then he checked the materials needed for crafting.

[Materials required for constructing the Miracle Tower]: Rhythm Black Iron*180,000, Philosopher’s Stone 1,200, Stone of Miracles*6,000, Purple Gold Stone*30,000, Permanent Gold Ingot*100,000, Spirit Core...
Seeing the material list above, Han Xing felt a toothache again.
These high-level blueprints are all money pits.
For ordinary people, or rather ordinary powers, they simply can’t afford to build like this.
Still, he clicked on build directly.
[Constructing Miracle Tower, time remaining 53 hours 24 minutes...]
After dealing with these, Han Xing almost finished assimilating the rewards from the five Sun Treasure Chests.
The gains were truly abundant.
Three Divine Artifacts, two super powerful blueprints, value immeasurable.
Tasting the sweetness of victory, Han Xing couldn’t help but think.
"It seems like there’s no need to exchange for the Bright Moon Treasure Chest anymore; the items inside don’t enhance me much."
"I need to find a way to open a few more Sun Treasure Chests."
Though, this time in the Battle Merit Store, each person was limited to exchange only one Sun Treasure Chest.
And the quota for five people was already used up.
Han Xing could still look for others to help exchange.
For example, his companions in Xingyu City, like Lanlan and Mu Qing.
Let them exchange Sun Treasure Chests; he could also take the items they open.
However, to fulfill this plan, Han Xing faced two problems.
The first problem is to bring Lanlan and others from the Land of the Abandoned Gods to the Witch Race Territory to participate in the faction wars to access the Battle Merit Store.
The second problem is that the Sun Treasure Chests exchanged by the Survivors are bound and must be opened by themselves.
And the item level inside the chest depends on the opener’s level.
Lanlan and others’ levels are relatively low, not having completed the Fourth Transformation yet.
Which means, even if they open the Sun Treasure Chest, the item level inside will be quite low.

At this point, Han Xing also thought: "Moreover, I have to wait until I exchange the High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint, and after trading the surplus Shadow Crystals, to trade with others for the Sun Treasure Chest."
After all, no matter what.
The High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint is the main item in this Battle Merit Store!
But these are all things to consider later.
Right now, Han Xing still needs to hurry up and level up.
He then made many bottles of Secret Elixirs in one go.
Such as the Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir, Four Symbols Power Secret Elixir, Gale Wings Secret Elixir, and so on.
Half an hour passed quickly.
Cheng Jianyong and the others arrived as promised.
Then, Han Xing led them to continue exploring the Abyssal Rift.
Upon entering the 50th layer of the Abyssal Rift, Han Xing handed out several bottles of Secret Elixirs to each person based on their Attributes.
Cheng Jianyong weighed the few bottles of red-glowing Secret Elixirs in his hand and exclaimed: "Damn, these Secret Elixirs’ Attributes are so strong?"
"1,200 points of Power, almost on par with Xiaoyunzi’s Blessing!"
Shen Yun also agreed and said: "And that Gale Wings Secret Elixir, and Sister Lian Meng’s Elemental Affinity Secret Elixir really offer a terrifying boost!"
At this point, he regretfully shook his head, "Unfortunately... if there were Secret Elixirs to increase Spirit or Constitution, my Blessing Effect would be even more powerful."
Everyone was taken aback.
Indeed.
The Secret Elixirs distributed by Han Xing this time helped everyone.
Except for Shen Yun, who didn’t have a suitable Secret Elixir.
However, Shen Yun’s Profession is a supportive one, so his dependence on these Secret Elixirs isn’t that strong anyway.
Han Xing patted him on the shoulder and said, "Don’t worry, with the Witch Race’s heritage, this kind of Secret Elixir formula should also exist."
"During the trades, I’ll talk to Wu Ling’Er and ask her to help me look for such a formula."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun’s eyes instantly lit up.
"That’s great, Brother Xing!"
Han Xing nodded, and then, amidst their puzzled looks, gave each of the four a bottle of Green Secret Elixir.
"What is this, another new Secret Elixir?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask.
When he saw the Attributes listed, he exclaimed.
"Whoa! Battle Experience increased by 30%!"
At this moment, everyone’s pupils shrank abruptly.
They all knew what this Secret Elixir issued by Han Xing represented!
