chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 292: The Saintess’s Decision (Part 2)
paragraphs: Next, everyone began to quickly navigate the Abyssal Rift once again.
With the aid of these secret elixirs, their combat power increased significantly, speeding up their progress.
Now, they can clear from level 50 to level 60 and defeat the final boss in about an hour and a half.
Everyone kept teleporting in and out.
Once again, they entered high-intensity battles.
Time passed like this for ten days...
During this period, Han Xing had two more transactions with Wu Ling’Er.
He gained a large amount of high-level materials again.
That day
Han Xing received a message from Wu Ling’Er asking him to visit the Royal Palace.
Han Xing summoned the Oracle Throne, and with a flash, arrived in the Royal City.
Ever since the invasion of the Shadow Legion was resolved, Han Xing’s comings and goings from the Royal City became very casual, without any obstruction.
Moreover, he headed straight for Wu Ling’Er’s private chamber, completely ignored by the Witch Race soldiers.
Lately, these Witch Race soldiers often saw Han Xing entering and exiting Wu Ling’Er’s room.
Previously, Wu Ling’Er set her chamber as a forbidden area.
Anything that needed discussing would have to be handled in the grand hall.
Even her most trusted person, Commander Kathy, had only been there once or twice.
But now, Han Xing visited Wu Ling’Er’s room almost every two or three days.
The expressions of the Witch Race soldiers were somewhat peculiar.
However, they didn’t dare look or think too much.
After all, neither Wu Ling’Er nor Han Xing the human were figures they could speculate about.
At this moment, Han Xing was unaware of the Witch Race soldiers’ thoughts.
Recently, he indeed frequently visited Wu Ling’Er’s room.
But it was mostly to discuss matters.
Sometimes, Han Xing needed to talk to her about something.
Other times, Wu Ling’Er contacted him through a Communication Jade.
Today, it was Wu Ling’Er who actively reached out to Han Xing.
Upon pushing open the door.
Han Xing saw Wu Ling’Er in a black silk dress, with black gauze draped over her shoulders.
She lay sideways at the edge of the bed, her long black hair cascading like a waterfall across the bed.
In this state, Wu Ling’Er had a dreamy beauty.
"Ling’Er, what’s the matter you wanted to see me about?" Han Xing asked straightforwardly.
Seeing Han Xing arrive, Wu Ling’Er nodded softly, "Hm, there are two things."
"The first thing is about the Void Soul Stones you asked me about yesterday; I’ve already asked."
"The High Priest indeed has some, and they’ve been expedited, probably arriving tomorrow."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s expression suddenly brightened.
"That’s great! How many Void Soul Stones did he send?"
"About 120 stones, is that enough?"
Wu Ling’Er asked a bit cautiously.
She knows the quantities Han Xing requires are often enormous, worrying that over a hundred Void Soul Stones might not be sufficient.
However, it couldn’t be helped, as the High Priest only had over a hundred Void Soul Stones in total, and they’ve all been sent.
More than that, there were none.
Han Xing, hearing this, looked pleased and said, "Enough! More than enough!"
Void Soul Stones could build 12 High-Level Teleportation Arrays!
Although it’s unclear how long the teleportation cooldown for High-Level Arrays is, it’s likely shorter than that of Intermediate Teleportation Arrays.
Even if distributed between two main cities, with six arrays on each side, it should sufficiently teleport a large batch of survivors over.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s response, Wu Ling’Er also smiled.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to remember something and asked, "By the way, Ling’Er, what conditions did the High Priest set for those over a hundred Void Soul Stones?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "No conditions, I personally asked for them, so it’s considered a personal favor."
"How could I let you owe a favor like that," Han Xing said hastily.
Wu Ling’Er chuckled softly, "No worries, Brother Han Xing needn’t mind that."
"Besides, I’m happy to be of help to you."
Han Xing said no more, merely kept Wu Ling’Er’s assistance in mind.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er suddenly said shyly, "Brother Han Xing, could you come sit with me for a while?"
She gestured to the edge of the bed, inviting him with her hand.
After spending time together, Wu Ling’Er increasingly understood Han Xing.
Their relationship also gradually grew closer.
Looking at the divine-like maiden before him extending her hand to invite him.
Han Xing did not refuse, and sat down beside Wu Ling’Er’s bed.
Feeling the soft touch of the mattress and the scent unique to a woman’s chamber.
Suddenly, Han Xing felt the atmosphere in the room becoming somewhat subtle.
Wu Ling’Er saw Han Xing maintained a distance from her as he sat.
She covered her mouth and chuckled softly, her hips shifting slightly, then sat next to Han Xing.
The two of them felt each other’s warmth through the thin clothing.
Neither one spoke.
A moment later.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly spoke, "Brother Han Xing, soon, I will have to leave for a while."
Upon hearing these words, all sorts of thoughts in Han Xing’s mind instantly disappeared.
He quickly asked, "Leave? Where are you going?"
As soon as Han Xing turned his head, he saw Wu Ling’Er’s delicate, girlish face.
She was looking at him with a complex gaze.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, seemingly guessing where Wu Ling’Er was headed.
"Are you going to the border battlefield to participate in support?"
Wu Ling’Er was not surprised when Han Xing guessed correctly.
She nodded lightly, "Yes, the seventh defense line area has become the last battleground for the Witch Race and Shadow Legion."
"Every day, countless Witch Race soldiers are being dispatched there."
"But you know, our overall strength is not actually comparable to the Shadow Legion."
"Our advantage is relying on those high-tier defense towers and ancient weapons."
"But now, the Shadow Legion has found ways to counter these defense towers."
"So, the crucial power deciding the battlefield’s direction falls on us, the legendary powerhouses."
"In times of crisis, each one of us Witch Race people has a responsibility."
Han Xing furrowed his brow upon hearing this, "I’ll go with you."
Before he could continue, Wu Ling’Er suddenly extended her small hand, covering Han Xing’s mouth to stop him from speaking further.
This intimate gesture was something Wu Ling’Er wouldn’t show in front of outsiders.
Only when alone with Han Xing did she seem especially bold.
Then, she gazed at Han Xing, removing her small hand from his lips.
The softness of her touch still lingered at his mouth.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly saw an exquisite face rapidly magnifying before him.
Before Han Xing could say anything, he found his lips blocked by a soft touch.
"Brother Han Xing, don’t say anything..."
At that moment, Han Xing’s mind buzzed.
He forgot what he was thinking about.
He only felt the sweet taste and fragrance constantly wafting to his nose.
He subconsciously embraced Wu Ling’Er.
Through the light veil, he felt her slender figure and tender skin.
At that moment, Wu Ling’Er’s body gently trembled.
As a soft moan escaped the girl’s mouth.
Her actions not only didn’t stop, but became even more passionate.
The two of them were tightly entwined.
For a long time...
Only then did they separate from their entanglement.
At this moment, the desire within Han Xing had been stirred, and he kept breathing heavily, watching Wu Ling’Er.
Wu Ling’Er smiled charmingly, stood up from the edge of the bed, and then came to Han Xing.
The next moment.
The black veil on Wu Ling’Er’s shoulders slid down.
Her graceful body was completely revealed to Han Xing.
Han Xing’s breathing became even heavier.
He reached out and embraced her.
Their body temperatures instantly rose.
However, Wu Ling’Er’s earlier expressions seemed bold.
Yet at this point, she appeared incredibly shy.
Only her mosquito-like voice was heard saying softly, "Brother Han Xing... be... gentle..."
Beneath the bed, the sound of their breathing continued...
Two hours later, the movements gradually ceased.
Han Xing leaned against the bed, looking at the girl resting on his chest, love flowing in his eyes.
He stroked Wu Ling’Er’s waterfall-like black hair, with a strange feeling in his heart.
This Witch Race Saintess, who appeared untouched by the smoke of life, with a cool temperament, was unexpectedly so... passionate in bed.
Although it was her first time, her movements were quite inexperienced.
Yet she continuously tried to accommodate Han Xing.
In this regard, it quite matched the character of Witch Race people.
"Brother Han Xing..."

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 293: Return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods
paragraphs: Wu Ling’Er suddenly spoke up, her voice very gentle.
After hearing this, Han Xing held the girl in his arms once more, then kissed her forehead.
Smelling the fragrance from her hair ends, Han Xing said.
"Ling’Er, I should go with you to the border."
"The Shadow Legion’s strength cannot be underestimated, I can’t rest easy about you."
Wu Ling’Er snuggled into Han Xing’s arms, her small hand gently pressed against his chest, shaking her head, "Brother Xing, you don’t need to come with me."
"I know you are very powerful, and can even defeat Legendary Powerhouses."
"But ultimately, this is our Witch Race’s own war."
"There are many Legendary Powerhouses at the seventh border, I don’t want Brother Xing to be in any danger."
After saying this, Wu Ling’Er sincerely looked at Han Xing.
Listening to Wu Ling’Er’s words, Han Xing frowned and asked, "Has the situation over there gotten this bad?"
Wu Ling’Er showed a bitter smile, then tried to act fine as she said, "It’s not too bad, we can still hold on for now."
Seeing her like this, Han Xing knew Wu Ling’Er was just enduring.
Han Xing’s hand reached down, stroking her tender skin, then gave it a slight, firm pat.
Slap!
Wu Ling’Er’s body trembled instantly, then looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing said, "Still not telling me the truth?"
Wu Ling’Er smiled gracefully, "I really didn’t lie to you, Brother Xing."
"Currently, the situation at the seventh border can indeed be sustained. We have dealt with the Shadow Legion for so many years, and they haven’t defeated us."
"As long as Lord Saint Master can resist the Shadow Monarch, we can barely maintain."
"So, Brother Xing can rest assured."
Han Xing nodded.
At this time, Wu Ling’Er cupped Han Xing’s face, carefully observed him and said, "Brother Xing, don’t worry about me. Ling’Er is really strong."
"However, during the time I’m not here, the Witch Race Main City will need you to help look after it~"
Han Xing understood what she meant.
Wu Ling’Er went to the border, and if there are any leftover Shadow Legends or other Shadow Legion invading the main city during this time.
Then it would need Han Xing to defend here.
After a moment, Han Xing nodded, "That’s fine."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s agreement, Wu Ling’Er’s face broke into a bright smile.
"Thank you, Brother Xing."
After speaking, she suddenly lifted the blanket and directly straddled Han Xing’s abdomen.
The girl was weak and boneless, and Han Xing could only feel a slight weight.
Han Xing’s eyes widened.
The next moment, Wu Ling’Er leaned down.
About an hour later.
Han Xing got dressed again and walked out from Wu Ling’Er’s chamber.
The next moment, Han Xing’s figure flashed, returning to Ten Thousand Stars.
The other four team members were already waiting there, ready to continue the challenge of the Abyssal Rift.
Though they didn’t know where Han Xing had been these past hours.
No one asked more about it.
Including Zhang Lianmeng, who also couldn’t see anything unusual.
Only Su Xiaoyang, who keenly noticed a slight oddity on Han Xing.
She looked at Han Xing and then at the Witch Race Main City below, showing a thoughtful expression in her eyes.
At this moment, Han Xing’s words interrupted her thoughts.
"Next, Wu Ling’Er will leave the main city and go to the border to participate in the war."
"She entrusted the main city to me to look after for a while."
After hearing this, everyone didn’t say anything.
After all, Wu Ling’Er was also their friend.
However, it seemed strange to them that the border’s war situation was so severe that even Wu Ling’Er had to go to war.
Shen Yun then asked, "Brother Xing, should we go to the border too?"
"There must be many Shadow Monsters there, right? We can also acquire Shadow Crystals faster."
The others also looked at Han Xing.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Maybe later, Ling’Er told us not to go there for now."
"Currently, the border defenses cannot be completely watertight."
"Every day, there are still numerous Shadow Legion forces invading the Witch Race Territory, so even if we don’t go to the border, battling the Shadow Legion is inevitable."
Speaking here, Han Xing continued, "Moreover, our strengths still have a rapid enhancement period."
"Once we advance our power to the limit, going to the border will yield greater results."
Everyone nodded together, agreeing with Han Xing’s reasoning.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong hurriedly said, "So what are we waiting for? Let’s continue charging at the Abyssal Rift!"
Han Xing nodded.
The group was once again fueled with motivation to level up!
However, among the crowd, only Su Xiaoyang still seemed lost in thought.
After hearing Han Xing’s words, she seemed to confirm her suspicion.
Staring at Han Xing’s back, Su Xiaoyang bit her lip lightly, seeming to have made some kind of decision.
Then, the five of them teleported together into the Abyssal Rift.
Wu Ling’Er’s actions were swift.
After Han Xing and others entered the Abyssal Rift, she convened an emergency meeting.
All Witch Race officers, even those currently involved in the war outside, received Wu Ling’Er’s orders.
She would proceed to the border.
While all affairs regarding the Witch Race Main City would be managed by Han Xing.
This included all Witch Race officers and soldiers who were to follow Han Xing’s directions.
In other words, Han Xing’s status had instantly risen to be on par with the Saintess.
Momentarily, the officers exchanged puzzled glances.
But, given Wu Ling’Er’s orders, they dared not say much.
Each of them hastily responded affirmatively.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 293: Return to the Land of the Abandoned Gods
paragraphs: Then, Wu Ling’Er left the Witch Race Sky Island alone, without bringing any subordinates.
The next day.
Han Xing’s figure flickered and suddenly appeared above the main city.
The soldiers gazed at the figure standing on the throne in the sky, their eyes filled with respect.
Now, the entire Witch Race Main City, with billions of people, knew that Han Xing was going to manage the main city on behalf of Wu Ling’Er.
In other words.
Currently, whatever Han Xing said went in the Witch Race Main City.
Even Commander Kathy had to obey him.
This status is indeed unparalleled.
However, even without Wu Ling’Er’s special instructions.
Han Xing’s friendliness rating of over nine thousand naturally made these soldiers highly respectful of him.
But Han Xing wasn’t here to enjoy the adoring gazes of the Witch Race soldiers and civilians.
He was here to handle an important matter.
"I’m here, where are you?"
Han Xing opened the Communication Jade and asked for the other’s location.
The response came quickly: "Lord Han Xing, inside the royal palace hall."
Looking at the grand palace, Han Xing’s figure flickered again, appearing directly in the royal palace hall.
In front of him appeared a Witch Race woman, dressed in a red and black officer’s uniform, standing straight.
Commander, Kathy.
She was different from all the other Witch Race women Han Xing had met before.
With just one contact, Han Xing knew this woman was rather bold and daring.
However, Han Xing didn’t care much about her personality.
He approached Kathy to retrieve something.
"Is it here?" Han Xing asked straightforwardly.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, Kathy trembled lightly and turned around gently.
She hadn’t even noticed when Han Xing had entered the hall.
Kathy had intended to say something but recalled Wu Ling’Er’s orders.
As a soldier, she maintained good conduct.
Kathy placed her right hand on her chest, then bent slightly, performing a Witch Race salute.
"Greetings, Lord Han Xing."
Han Xing nodded slightly.
Kathy knew Han Xing disliked wasting time and replied, "The item has been brought."
Then, she presented a sandalwood box from behind her and said, "These are the items the High Priest sent over, and Lady Saintess instructed me to hand them to you personally."
Han Xing nodded and took the box from Kathy’s hands.
Opening it right in front of her.
Inside were over a hundred thumb-sized black stones exuding a void aura.
These were the Void Soul Stones.
Counting them, there were precisely 120 pieces.
The corners of Han Xing’s lips lifted in delight.
With these, he could construct an Advanced Teleportation Array to evacuate the survivors from the Land Abandoned by Gods.
He packed all the stones into his backpack, and a system notification appeared,
"Acquired Void Soul Stone *120...
Finished with this, Han Xing prepared to leave.
However, seeing Kathy looking as if she had something to say, Han Xing asked curiously, "What’s the matter?"
Upon Han Xing’s inquiry, a look of panic crossed Kathy’s face.
She quickly waved her hands, saying, "No... nothing..."
Seeing her odd reaction, Han Xing paid it no mind.
Nodding, he promptly left the hall.
It was only after Han Xing had disappeared that Kathy exhaled in relief.
Meanwhile, Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars City.
Preparing to construct the Advanced Teleportation Array.

"Do you wish to use materials: Mithril *100,000, Refined Iron *50,000, Permanent Gold Ingot *1,000, Yi State *700,000, Spirit Core *1,000,000, Void Soul Stone *10... to construct an Advanced Teleportation Array?"
Han Xing immediately clicked yes.
"Construction in progress, remaining time 17 hours 13 minutes..."
Seventeen hours until completion, by tomorrow it’ll be done.
Han Xing clicked five more times.
All six teleportation arrays in Ten Thousand Stars City had been selected for placement.

At this time, Han Xing pondered: "For Advanced Teleportation Arrays to perform cross-space teleportation with each other, an Advanced Teleportation Array must also be established in another territory."
"In other words, besides Ten Thousand Stars City, a teleportation array also needs to be built at Xingyu City."
"Looks like I must make a trip back to the Land Abandoned by Gods."
"Coincidentally, I also want to discuss with Luo Chan and Lanlan about developing plans in the Witch Race Territory."
However, to return to the Land Abandoned by Gods, he also needed to pass through the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Han Xing recalled, after they emerged from the Path of the Giant Dragon, Wu Ling’Er guided them swiftly, reaching the Witch Race Main City in just a few hours.
This suggested the Path of the Giant Dragon was not far from Han Xing.
According to his calculations.
With the tenfold speed boost from the Oracle Throne, getting from the main city to the exit of the Path of the Giant Dragon should take less than a day.
However, the Oracle Throne was personal and couldn’t carry teammates.
That divine-level effect: Divine Oracle Sign, could only be used once a day.
With this in mind, Han Xing decided to go alone.
After all, a round trip would take less than two days.
Thus, Han Xing posted a message in the team channel, explaining his upcoming itinerary.
Hearing Han Xing was returning to the Land Abandoned by Gods, some were surprised.
But upon learning it would only take a day or two, they felt relieved.
Then.
Han Xing packed a few core lands into his backpack and sat on the Oracle Throne, departing Ten Thousand Stars City.
The scenery in the sky sped past rapidly.
With the tenfold movement speed bonus of the Oracle Throne, he now matched the speed of Legendary Powerhouses.
Along the way.
Han Xing also noticed, within the Witch Race Territory, there were several areas filled with black smoke from time to time.
Those were places under invasion by the Shadow Legion.
Han Xing frowned.
Indeed, as Wu Ling’Er had mentioned, the situation in the Witch Race Territory was not optimistic.
Almost everywhere, signs of Shadow Legion activity were comparable to the height of the Blood Tide.
A large number of soldiers were busy dealing with these Shadow Monsters.
However, Han Xing was hurrying and had no time to bother with these issues.
Once he brought people over from the Land Abandoned by Gods, there would naturally be someone to deal with the Shadow Monsters.
Eight hours later...
Guided by the Ancient Fire, Han Xing reached a dim area.
Above, the sun was gradually blocked by heavy clouds.
Moreover, the further Han Xing delved, the more deteriorated the surrounding environment became.
Han Xing knew he had found the place.
At this moment, Han Xing hesitated.
"Wu Ling’Er told me that to return from the Witch Race Territory to the Land Abandoned by Gods, one needs the protection of the Ancient Fire and to traverse the Path of the Giant Dragon again."
"That means I have to interact with those dragons once more..."
"But... damn it, those dragons seem to despise me?"
Han Xing muttered indignantly.
He bore no grievances with those giant dragons.
The last time, a Red Dragon almost attacked him.
Even with Wu Ling’Er by his side, it was barely enough to protect him.
Although he had grown stronger since.
Han Xing dared not claim he was a match for that Red Dragon.
However, traversing the Path of the Giant Dragon would inevitably mean interaction with it.
Unless there was a way to skip it entirely.
Just then, Han Xing thought of something.
He pondered, "Back then, we traveled about a day within the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon."
"Based on the travel speed then, the whole Path of the Giant Dragon shouldn’t exceed 700,000 kilometers in length."
"And my Oracle Throne’s teleportation effect boasts a teleportation distance of up to one million kilometers!"
The next moment, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
"Does this mean I can use the Oracle Throne’s teleportation function to bypass the Path of the Giant Dragon directly?"
This method was likely feasible.
This way, he could avoid further contact with those dragons.
Han Xing was quick to act.
The next moment, he clicked to activate.
It was, indeed, his first time using the Oracle Throne’s teleportation effect.
A peculiar sensation washed over him.
He felt as if he had merged into space entirely.
In a split second, Han Xing traversed hundreds of thousands of miles of the Path of the Giant Dragon, brushing past those dragons.
The other side didn’t notice him at all.
In another blink, Han Xing emerged from the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The surrounding scenes flashed by like slideshow frames.
When Han Xing reappeared.
He found himself back within the familiar rubble field.
A system notification appeared.
"You have arrived at the Land Abandoned by Gods..."

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 294: Flourishing Blossoms, Xingyu City Booming
paragraphs: System prompt: "You have arrived at the Land of the Abandoned Gods..."
Han Xing’s face lit up with joy, clenching his fist and saying, "Hahaha, it worked!"
"The oracle transmission can really bypass the Path of the Giant Dragon and directly transport me back!"
Finishing his words, he turned around, glancing back at the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Silently in his heart, he thought: "Great, great, in the future, whenever I leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, I won’t have to deal with those dragons anymore!"
Then, Han Xing quickly controlled the Oracle Throne to move away from the Path of the Giant Dragon.
One hour later.
Han Xing casually found a Sky Island, then took out the monsters inside and merged it.
On this new Sky Island, Han Xing immediately started constructing a Basic Teleportation Array.
A few hours later.
The Basic Teleportation Array was completed.
Within the same map, no matter how far apart, the Basic Teleportation Array can transport you there.
Xingyu City is too far from his current location.
Even if Han Xing has the Oracle Throne now, capable of traveling hundreds of thousands of kilometers a day, it would still take him a day or two to get there.
Therefore, building a Basic Teleportation Array undeniably saves a lot of time.
Because he knows all the teleportation array numbers of Xingyu City.
Han Xing put away the Oracle Throne into his backpack, then randomly selected an Intermediate Teleportation Array and clicked teleport.
Seconds later.
In the bustling Xingyu City, a certain teleportation array suddenly emitted a burst of white light.
For such a teleportation scene, tourists passing by weren’t surprised at all.
As of today.
The number of Intermediate Teleportation Arrays in Xingyu City has expanded tenfold.
More than 30,000 teleportation arrays can transfer countless survivors daily.
Therefore, Han Xing’s appearance seemed quite unremarkable.
Only, those survivors felt that Han Xing’s appearance looked somewhat familiar, as if they had seen him somewhere before.
But after thinking for a while, they thought it was unlikely.
It had already been a few months since Han Xing last publicly appeared.
As he gradually faded from public view, naturally, many people forgot what Han Xing looked like.
Blending into the crowd, Han Xing casually strolled the streets of Xingyu City without attracting attention.
It was then he realized that the prosperity of Xingyu City had somewhat exceeded his expectations.
Now, he was in some corner of this colossal Xingyu City.
From afar, he could see the tall buildings and statues of the city center.
This place was clearly still several kilometers away from the central district.
Yet, even such a remote corner was bustling with life.
Shops on both sides were in business, and the streets were crowded with people coming and going.
Survivors with various equipment and unique styles were entering and exiting these shops.
Everyone wore a relaxed smile.
And this was the unique charm of Xingyu City.
Here, you don’t need to worry about Sky Island Monsters invading, or being harmed by other survivors.
In this relaxed atmosphere, Han Xing felt somewhat influenced.
He chuckled lightly, "During this time, Luo Chan and Lanlan have indeed developed Xingyu City quite well."
He knew that the development of Xingyu City to this extent was partly due to Lanlan’s constant urban planning and expansion.
The other part was thanks to Luo Chan’s overarching commercial management.
Their contributions were invaluable.
Han Xing continued to wander.
The streets were bustling with people coming and going.
The shops on both sides were teeming with customers.
Sounds of conversations, shouts, broadcasts...
It was like scenes from the Blue Star, reappearing at this moment.
At this moment, Han Xing knew.
His initial decision to turn Xingyu City into a human city was indeed the right one.
Xingyu City allowed the global human race to find a sense of home again.
No matter what dangers you encountered while exploring outside, as long as you returned to Xingyu City, it was like a warm refuge.
As such, the number of permanent residents in Xingyu City also increased.
Han Xing continued to stroll leisurely.
After half an hour, he hadn’t finished exploring the nearby blocks.
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch his mouth, "At this rate, it’ll be impossible to explore every corner of Xingyu City in less than a month or two."
However, this was understandable.
After all, the current scale of Xingyu City was already comparable to the size of a first-tier city on the Blue Star.
Walking from here to the central district would take a long time.
Let alone, every corner of this city was infused with the efforts of many people.
Although there were many similar shops, this was unavoidable.
Just like supermarkets on the Blue Star, you could find them almost every 100 or 200 meters.
But even so, Luo Chan tried her best to ensure each shop had its unique characteristics and style.
At this moment, Han Xing remembered something.
He smacked his head, "Damn, I was so busy shopping that I forgot I came here to do something!"
After saying this, Han Xing quickly found an empty spot and constructed six High-Level Teleportation Arrays.
According to the regulations of Xingyu City, besides Lanlan and the others, no one else could construct any buildings in Xingyu City.
Even Luo Chan and the others, if they wanted to construct certain buildings, needed to consult Lanlan first.
But Han Xing didn’t need to.
The entire Xingyu City was his; he could build whatever he wanted.
After handling these tasks, Han Xing suddenly remembered that he had also acquired some new building plans.
They could also help Xingyu City develop.
Then, Han Xing blended into the crowd, heading towards the central district.
As he walked, he suddenly heard the survivors nearby shouting.
"Brothers, the Rune Shop in the central district has just stocked a batch of Destruction Runes, limited to five hundred pieces, hurry and grab them!"

sentences.text: System prompt: "You have arrived at the Land of the Abandoned Gods..."
Han Xing’s face lit up with joy, clenching his fist and saying, "Hahaha, it worked!"
"The oracle transmission can really bypass the Path of the Giant Dragon and directly transport me back!"
Finishing his words, he turned around, glancing back at the depths of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
Silently in his heart, he thought: "Great, great, in the future, whenever I leave the Land of the Abandoned Gods, I won’t have to deal with those dragons anymore!"
Then, Han Xing quickly controlled the Oracle Throne to move away from the Path of the Giant Dragon.
One hour later.
Han Xing casually found a Sky Island, then took out the monsters inside and merged it.
On this new Sky Island, Han Xing immediately started constructing a Basic Teleportation Array.
A few hours later.
The Basic Teleportation Array was completed.
Within the same map, no matter how far apart, the Basic Teleportation Array can transport you there.
Xingyu City is too far from his current location.
Even if Han Xing has the Oracle Throne now, capable of traveling hundreds of thousands of kilometers a day, it would still take him a day or two to get there.
Therefore, building a Basic Teleportation Array undeniably saves a lot of time.
Because he knows all the teleportation array numbers of Xingyu City.
Han Xing put away the Oracle Throne into his backpack, then randomly selected an Intermediate Teleportation Array and clicked teleport.
Seconds later.
In the bustling Xingyu City, a certain teleportation array suddenly emitted a burst of white light.
For such a teleportation scene, tourists passing by weren’t surprised at all.
As of today.
The number of Intermediate Teleportation Arrays in Xingyu City has expanded tenfold.
More than 30,000 teleportation arrays can transfer countless survivors daily.
Therefore, Han Xing’s appearance seemed quite unremarkable.
Only, those survivors felt that Han Xing’s appearance looked somewhat familiar, as if they had seen him somewhere before.
But after thinking for a while, they thought it was unlikely.
It had already been a few months since Han Xing last publicly appeared.
As he gradually faded from public view, naturally, many people forgot what Han Xing looked like.
Blending into the crowd, Han Xing casually strolled the streets of Xingyu City without attracting attention.
It was then he realized that the prosperity of Xingyu City had somewhat exceeded his expectations.
Now, he was in some corner of this colossal Xingyu City.
From afar, he could see the tall buildings and statues of the city center.
This place was clearly still several kilometers away from the central district.
Yet, even such a remote corner was bustling with life.
Shops on both sides were in business, and the streets were crowded with people coming and going.
Survivors with various equipment and unique styles were entering and exiting these shops.
Everyone wore a relaxed smile.
And this was the unique charm of Xingyu City.
Here, you don’t need to worry about Sky Island Monsters invading, or being harmed by other survivors.
In this relaxed atmosphere, Han Xing felt somewhat influenced.
He chuckled lightly, "During this time, Luo Chan and Lanlan have indeed developed Xingyu City quite well."
He knew that the development of Xingyu City to this extent was partly due to Lanlan’s constant urban planning and expansion.
The other part was thanks to Luo Chan’s overarching commercial management.
Their contributions were invaluable.
Han Xing continued to wander.
The streets were bustling with people coming and going.
The shops on both sides were teeming with customers.
Sounds of conversations, shouts, broadcasts...
It was like scenes from the Blue Star, reappearing at this moment.
